༄༅/ /dpal rwa tshar gnyis kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bzhed pa rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum pa'i mngon dkyil lhan thabs cha lag bcas phyogs gcig tu bkod

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rwa tshar gnyis kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bzhed pa rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum pa'i mngon dkyil lhan thabs cha lag bcas phyogs gcig tu bkod pa zab don rab gsal zhes bya ba zhugs so// na mo gu ru mañju gho ṣā ya/ rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus 'jam pa'i dpal/ /sau ma pū rir dbang phyug gdul don du/ /rab khros dkyil 'khor sprul nas dus dgra'i rgyud/ /gsung mdzad bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dus 'dir stsol/ /de dang lhan cig zhal sbyor bcom ldan ma/ /ma lus rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum mchog ma/ /dharmā gha dza'i ḍā ka'i ded dpon ma/ /gsang chen mnga' bdag rdo rje ro langs mar/ /gsol ba 'debs so /mchog dang thun /u rgyan gnas nas rgyud chen spyan drangs te/ /lho phyogs thod pa can gyi dur khrod du/ /'jam khros zhal gzigs mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /lam 'di'i rtsa lag grub chen la li ta/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /mkha' 'gros lung bstan bla ma 'jigs byed du/ /mngon sum zhal gzigs dbang dang gdams pa thob/ /mtha' dmag dpung bcom rdo rje gdan pa'i zhabs/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug a mo gha badz+ra/ /gsol ba 'debs /mchog dang thun /phyi nang rig gnas kun mkhyen paṇ+ḍi ta/ /bla ma lha yis rjes bzung gdams pa thob/ /ha ha rgod par phyag chen dngos grub brnyes/ /gri gug 'bar bas bdud 'joms ye 'byung zhabs/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /phag mos lung bstan dam pas rjes su bzung / /pad+ma bkod par 'jam dpal gshin rje grub/ /bi dhi pa las gdug can rgyal po btul/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma badz+ra la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /u rgyan pad+ma bkod pa'i dur khrod du/ /dus dgra'i zhal gzigs gnyis spangs spyod pa mdzad/ /seng ga'i rgyal po dbang bsdus legs lam sbyar/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug bal po bha ra'i zhabs/

/gsol ba /mchog /'jam dpal rnam sprul skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang / /rgya bal yul byon gsang chen gdams pa blangs/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir mthu chen bstan pa'i bdag /rje btsun rwa lo rdo rje grags pa la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /rwa chen sras mchog ha la nag po sogs/ /chig brgyud gdams pa kun gyi bka' babs thob/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i thugs bcud dus 'khor gyi/ /bstan pa rgyas mdzad rwa lo chos rab la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /rje btsun yab las gdams pa'i bcud thob nas/ /rtse gcig bsgrub pas bde chen ye shes brnyes/ /zab don smra ba'i seng ge rigs sngags 'chang / /rwa ban dbang po ye shes seṅge la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /'bum phrag rgyud sde'i snying po gshin rje'i gshed/ /nag po skor gsum sngon byung rnam pa gsum/ /dus kyi 'khor lo chos 'byung dug la sogs/ /yab chos smra ba'i seng ge 'bum seng la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ded dpon gsang ba'i mdzod/ /grub pa mchog gi rnam 'phrul bye ba brgya/ /ston mdzad rje btsun rong pa rga lo la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /shes rab chen pos zab rgyas chos rnams kyi/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum drang nges don gzigs nas/ /gsang chen smra ba'i seng ge dus 'khor ba/ /mtshungs bral rong pa shes rab seng ge la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /gzhon nu nyid nas shes bya'i gnas la sbyangs/ /tshul khrims sdom ldan dam par yongs su grags/ /zab dang rgya che'i dam chos bdud rtsi yis/ /skal ldan skyong mdzad bag ston chen po la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /tshul khrims rnam dag rgya mtsho yangs pa'i ljongs/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i yid bzhin rin chen dbang / /mkhas dang grub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser son pa'i/ /skye dgu'i gdung sel tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /shes bya rab 'byams mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /byang chub thugs gnyis 'byongs pa'i dpal dang ldan/

/gsang chen phrin las bzang pos bstan pa skyong / /kun mkhyen chen po shes rab dpal bzang la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /rig gnas kun la spobs pa'i dge ba can/ /rgyal mtshan tog ltar gangs can mkhas grub kyi/ /gtsug na mngon par mtho ba grub pa'i dbang / /rwa lo gnyis pa dge ba rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /mtshungs med shes rab chen pos chos kun mkhyen/ /smra ba'i zla ba phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ /lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung grwa thang pa/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug shes rab zla ba la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /kun bzang rigs brgya'i gar mkhan rdo rje 'chang / /gsang chen chos kyi mnga' bdag grub pa'i gtso/ /skal bzang pad+mo bzhad pa nyi ma'i dbang / /bka' drin mnyam med kun spangs chos rje la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang yang brgyud pa gnyis pa ni/ rong pa shes rab seng ge'i rjes su/ lam 'di'i gdams pa'i gter mdzod 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag grags chen pa/ /kun mkhyen bstan pa'i rtsa lag gangs khrod pa/ /mtshungs bral sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /gsang chen smra ba gzhon nu blo gros zhabs/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang rje btsun e wam̐ pa/ /thugs kyi sras mchog paṇa chen grags rgyal ba/ /rje btsun bla ma nam mkha' brtan pa la/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /dkyil 'khor kun gyi rigs bdag drin chen rje/ /dga' chen yan lag bdun ldan he ru ka /nges gsang legs pa'i lam ston blo gros can/ /bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun sgo rum pa/ /gsol ba /mchog dang brgyud pa gsum pa ni/ rwa 'bum seng nas/ /rwa ban 'bum seng zhal slob dbang phyug grags/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug ldong ston shes rab dpal/ /'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che/ /rgyal mtshan bzang po zhes grags shar chen pa/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /mtshungs med dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sgo rum pa/ /mgon des rjes bzung tshul khrims rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /bdag nyid chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/

/mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ /gsol ba /mchog /mkhas grub dam pa rje btsun brag thog pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa 'jigs med dpa' bo'i zhabs/ /sngags 'chang dbang po bsod nams mchog ldan pa/ /drin chen bla ma tshe dbang bkra shis la/ /gsol ba /mchog kha skong ni/ /blo mchog gsung gi dbang phyug ngur smrig gar/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i snying gi mun bsal nas/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho'i dga' ston stsol ba'i rje/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug tshar chen rdo rje 'chang / /gsol ba /mchog /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos shes bya thams cad mkhyen/ /brtse chen snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pu/ /byin rlabs nus mthu'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsang chen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /gsol ba /mchog /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis mthar phyin nas/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis skal bzang gi /grub rigs nyams rtogs ye shes 'phel mdzad pa/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang po dgon gsar ba/ /gsol ba /mchog dang /bslab gsum sde snod gzhung lugs mthar phyin nas/ /zab don gsang sngags rgya mtshor dbang 'byor ba/ /grub gnyis 'bras bu'i dpal gyis phyug gyur pa'i/ /mkhan chen grub pa'i dbang phyug lding ma ba/ /gsol ba /mchog /mtha' yas rgyud sde'i dbang phyug rdor 'dzin gtso/ /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i ting 'dzin rab brtan pas/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs ming gi mthar mdzad pa/ /tshe mtha' yas dang dngos khyab bdag bla ma/ /gsol ba /mchog /rnam mang 'gro ba kun gyi mgon gcig po/ /bsod nams gter chen rnam grol mchog ldan pa'i/ /rgyal sras byang sems ngur smrig 'chang ba'i gtso/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba/ /gsol ba /mchog /dam pa'i zhabs bsten gsung ngag gdams pa phyug /smin grol dbang bzhi'i bdud rtsi'i skal ldan kun/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal thar pa'i pho brang cher/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon mtshungs med chos kyi rje/

/gsol ba /mchog /dpag yas tshogs gnyis smon lam bzang po'i mthus/ /dam pa'i rigs 'khrungs mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i bdag /thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa rgyal ba'i sras/ /grub gnyis mngon gyur snyigs dus rdor 'dzin mgon/ /gsol ba /mchog /'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug rab khros sku/ /bdud dpung skrag mdzad skal bzang kun dga'i gsung / /mchog thun grub gnyis lhun grub stsol ba'i thugs/ /'dren mchog sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang / /gsol ba /mchog /ngag gi dbang phyug bla ma yi dam lhas/ /dus kun rjes 'dzin dga' bzhi legs pa'i lam/ /rnam grol thar pa'i 'byung gnas smin grol chos/ /stsol mkhas drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dus 'dir stsol/ /de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /snying nas dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /tshe rabs kun tu thugs rjes bzung gyur nas/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi rtag tu 'thung bar shog /zhal gyi pad+mo las 'ongs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /gshin rje gshed dpal rgyud don zab mo'i bcud/ /legs par thob nas nyams su blangs pa'i mthus/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i dbang po 'grub par shog /lho phyogs sa 'og gnas pa'i gshin rje sogs/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad 'byung po'i tshogs/ /gdug can phyi yi gshin rje kun 'joms pa'i/ /khro rgyal ma he'i zhal can 'grub par shog /ro rkyang rtsa dang dkar dmar nyi zla'i khams/ /'byung 'jug rlung gi rgyu ba ma lus pa/ /a wa dhu tir zhugs nas thim pa yi/ /nang gi gshin rje gshed po 'grub par shog /gzung 'dzin gnyis snang kun rtog ma lus pa/ /gsal stong zung 'jug bde ba chen po yi/ /dbyibs su zhugs pa'i gnyis med ye shes mchog /gsang ba'i gshin rje mthar byed 'grub par shog /spros bral brjod med stong nyid rdo rje che/

/'gyur med bde ba chen po 'jigs mdzad zhabs/ /dbyer med zung 'jug badz+ra bhai ra wa/ /bdag dang 'gro ba tshe 'dir 'grub par shog /gnas skabs zab mo'i 'khrul 'khor sbyor ba yis/ /rab 'byams las bzhi thogs med 'grub gyur nas/ /lam mchog sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / /mthun rkyen ma lus bde blag 'grub par shog /ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud la gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub rin po che'i snye ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ shes bya rab 'byams la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs thogs pa med par 'jug cing snyan brgyud zab mo'i bcud kyis yongs su gtams pa 'di ni rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung gis rgyang ring po nas nan tan gyis bskul ba la brten nas/ gshin rje gshed kyi sbyor ba blo gsal rgya mtshos mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel gyi dgon par sbyar ba 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ ༈ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs brgyud pa gsum 'dus tshar chen rdo rje 'chang man gyi gsol 'debs kha skong 'di lha rigs 'a zhwa'i gnas gsar rdo rje legs pa'i mtshan can no// rigs sngags 'chang bas sbyar ba'o// ༈ /na ma shrī mañju badz+ra shrī badz+ra bhai ra wā ya/ 'jigs byed 'jigs pa rab tu ston pas 'jigs/ /za tshul za bar ston mdzad khams gsum za/ /khro mdog khro tshul bdud rnams khros pas gsod/ /rdo rje'i gzugs can rdo rje grags par 'dud/ /dpal ldan rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse ni/ /gur gum gzhon nu'i zol gyis yid 'phrog sku/ /dran pas snying gi mun sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bla ma mchog dang dbyer med gang des skyongs/

/gang sku mthong bas rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs/ /phyag mtshan lhung zhing bdud dang gshin rje'i dpung / /klad pa 'thor nas snying dmar tshal par 'gas/ /skal bzang snying la bdud rtsi'i dpal ster ba/ /'jigs rung dus dgra'i dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs rgod pa ma he'i zhal/ /ro langs dga' mas 'khyud pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /khyod zhabs pad+mo gtsug gi chu mtshor rol/ /gang de'i rnam 'phrul rwa chen lo tsā ba'i/ /zhal 'od bcu gsum lha yi 'khor lo yi/ /sgrub thabs dkyil 'khor cho ga'i gsal byed ni/ /zab don rab gsal dga' ston deng 'dir spro/ /e ma rnam dpyod nags kyi tshal yangs na/ /skal bzang gtsug phud g.yo ba'i gnyis skyes bu/ /gsang chen sprin sngon gsar pa'i rdza rnga'i sgra/ /snying dbus bdud rtsi'i mchod sbyin 'di na ko /dbang gi rgyal po dang mtshungs dbang gi chu/ /mi chad mi nub rgyun du bzlas pa'i lugs/ /mi 'gal nyung gsal gab 'khrugs med par ni/ /'jug pa bde phyir 'di la skyon yod min/ /de la 'dir/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul par skyes bu dam pa dag gis lung bstan zhing / rang nyid kyis zhal gyis 'ches pa'i/ bla ma rwa lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags pas/ rgyud sde dri ma med pa'i dgongs pa mthar thug pa/ rgya bal gyi paṇa grub tshad ldan gcig nas gcig tu rim par brgyud pa'i zhal gyi drod ma yal ba'i gdams ngag la brten nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i chos skor gyi yi ge yongs su grags pa bcu bdun tsam mdzad pa rnams bsdu na/ smin byed dbang gi skor/ grol byed lam gyi lam skor/ las tshogs sna tshogs kyi skor/ rgyab brten lung gi skor rnams su 'dus pa las/ grol byed lam gyi chos skor la/ rwa chen nyid kyi dkar chag las/ mngon rtogs rim pa lnga yang yod/ /ces dang / ha la nag po'i shog dril las/ lnga po gang du legs bsgoms la/

/zhes gsungs pa'i don lha bcu gsum gyi mngon rtogs rgyas pa rin po che'i gter mdzod/ gtso bo'i sgrub thabs dri med snang ba/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs khams gsum za byed/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs dri med chu rgyun/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs rin chen don 'dus dang lnga yod pa'i/ dang po lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa dang / dkar chag las/ smin byed dkyil chog yig sna yod/ /ces gsungs pa'i don/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang gi dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba nyid/ rwa chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge gzhir bzhag la cung zad kha 'phang ba dang / don gyi thob pa'i lag len dang / ngag 'don gyi rim pa lugs 'di pa la tshad mar gyur pa'i yi ge dag dang / brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma'i gsung sgros las byung ba ni/ 'di ltar/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i sngags pas/ rang smin par byed pa la gsum/ sa'i cho ga sta gon/ dngos gzhi'o/ /de yang phyi rgyud las/ rnam dpyad dang po na gzhi bzung / /gnyis pa sta gon gnas bcas te/ /nub gsum pa la 'jug pa shis/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la nub dang po sa yi cho ga la bzhi ste/ sa brtag pa dang / sa slong ba dang / sbyang ba dang / bsrung ba'o/ /dang po la brgyad de/ phyogs dang / kha dog dang / dbyibs dang / sa dang / chu dang / me tog dang / me dang / rmi lam mo/ /dang po ni/ zhi ba shar/ rgyas pa la byang / dbang la nub/ drag po la lho nas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ zhi ba la dkar la snum pa/ rgyas pa la ser la brjid pa/ dbang la dmar la 'bol ba/ drag po la nag la rtsub pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ zhi ba la dar dkar gyi yol ba bres pa lta bu dang / zla ba rgyas pa lta bu'o/ /rgyas pa la rgyal po gser gyi khri la gnas pa lta bu dang / dbang la btsun mo'i bha ga lta bu dang / drag po la srin po za res babs pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sa de 'dom gang gru bzhir/

pus mo'i lte ba nub tsam du brkos la/ slar khung bu de sa des bkang bas gang na bzang la ma gang na der mi bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ khung bu de nyid chus bkang ste/ rkang 'dom lnga bcu rtsa gcig phyir phyin la nang du log ste bltas pas/ dma' bar ma song na bzang / cung zad dma' na dngos grub chung / ye ma chags na ngan no/ /drug pa ni/ khung bu'i nang nas byung ba'i sa rnams phung por byas la/ me tog gtor bas kun chags na bzang / ma chags na mi bya/ bdun pa ni/ sa phyogs der zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byas la/ me pra bzang na bya/ ngan na mi bya/ brgyad pa ni/ sa phyogs der phyin te/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs 'og gi sa lha'i skabs ltar byas/ gzhi bdag la/ a kā ros gtor ma byin la/ gang dag khams gsum 'dir bzhugs pa'i/ /mgon po che ba'i che ba rnams/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin rnams/ /dri za dang ni lha min sogs/ /de dag rnams kyis mkhyen par mdzod/ /sems can rnams kyi don bsgrub phyir/ /sa gzhi mnyam zhing yid 'ong 'dir/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar 'tshal/ /gal te khyod kyis gnang ba na/ /bgyid de gzhan du ma lags so/ /rmi lam la sogs mtshan ma yi/ /legs nyes ltas rnams bstan du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum dang / 'dir rjes chog byas nas nyal ba'am/ yang na gnyid sad nas bya/ oṃ mu tse le swāhā/ oṃ mo ha ri ti swāhā/ oṃ ta ti li ni swāhā/ zhes brjod nas/ mgo lhor bstan la shar phyogs su nyal nas rmi lam bzang na bya/ ngan na mi bya/ gnyis pa sa slong ba la gnyis te/ snang ba la slong ba dang / mi snang ba la slong ba'o/ /snang ba la gnyis te/ spyi sa bdag rgyal po la slong ba/ sgos sa de'i bdag po la slong ba'o/ /de yang rnyed bkur la sogs pas mnyes par byas la/ sa phyogs 'dir ngas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ces bya ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas/ slob ma smin par byas pas yul phyogs 'dir yang dge zhing bkra shis par 'gyur bas sa gzhi nga la byin cig

ces brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa mi snang ba la slong ba gsum te/ sa bdag lto 'phye dang / lo zla ba zhag dus gnas pa dang / sa'i lha mo'o/ /dang po ni/ sa bdag lto 'phye'i 'khor phyogs brtsis te lto ba gshags la slong / gnyis pa ni/ yul de'i gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin la/ 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag dang / /de dag rnams kyis sa 'di ni/ /dkyil 'khor don du bdag la byin/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas slong ngo / /gsum pa ni/ man+ḍal dbus su dri'i thig le'i steng du/ oṃ pṛ thi wī bh+ya ཿye swāhā/ ces brjod la me tog tshom bu gcig bya/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan la sor mo gsum bskyang ste/ sa la lan gsum brdabs pas/ sa yi lha mo bstan ma ser mo dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ g.yas pas khas len pa la nye bar 'jog pa'i phyag rgya/ g.yon pas bum pa 'dzin pa/ sku lte ba yan chad thon pa gcig spyan drangs/ de nas ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan pa la/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wī lo ke tā ra ye/ zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye/ badz+ra puṣ+pe la sogs phyi'i mchod pa dang / nang bdud rtsi dang / a kā ro'i sngags lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī lo ki tā ra e daṃ bha ling kha kha khā hi kha hi zhes pas mnyes par byas la/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes brjod pas gnang ba sbyin par bsam/ slar yang mchod nas/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī badz+ra mu/ gshegs su gsol/ gsum pa/ sa sbyang ba la gnyis te/

las dang bya bas sbyong ba dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyong ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sa'i ro lnga bsal te/ rje'u dang / gyo mo dang / rus pa dang / sol ba dang / sbangs rnams bsal te sa stegs gru bzhi pa/ dbus yid tsam mtho ba/ byang shar yid tsam dma' ba/ chags kyis 'thems pa/ me long gi ngos ltar bya/ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ bhu khaṃ/ zhes pas sa gzhi stong par bsam/ hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsam/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas lag mthil gnyis las 'od 'phros pas/ ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs bar bsam la/ lag mthil sa la rdeg go /de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug ste/ bsod nams kyi tshogs nas lha bcu gsum bskyed pa dang / bzlas pa mchod bstod yan chad byas pa'i rjes la/ spos snod dang rdo rje dril bu bzung la/ lce hūm̐ las rdo rjer bskyed de/ phyogs rnams kun na gnas pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'di ni rdo rje che ge bdag /dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad byon nas ni/ /'di ni dngos grub gnang bar mdzod/ /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo rje slob dpon gyis chas brgyad dang ldan par byas te/ dbu rgyan dang / dar gyi cod pan dang / dar gyi ral kha dang / dar gyi ske rags dang / bum pa dang / rdo rje dril bu dang / dung zhal dang / rtsa ku sha'i chun po rnams dang ldan par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma bzhi'am bcu gnyis kyis dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi nas dbu rgyan la sogs pa'i rgyan dang / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i nga rgyal du langs pa las slob dpon gyis bstod pa/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /ces pa la sogs pas phyogs bzhir rim pas bstod/ de nas slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal du gnas pa la/ phyogs kyi slob ma rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang yang rung bas bstod pa'i rjes la gsol ba gdab pa ni/

shar gyi slob mas/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /mtshan nyid bral ba rnam par spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /lho nas/ sems can kun la brtse chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pas dri ma med/ /kun tu bzang po thugs kyi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /nub nas/ chos rnams zhi ba las byung mchog /rnam par dag pa ye shes spyod/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /byang nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun rang bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /slob ma kun gyis thun mong du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor 'jigs/ /sdig pa thams cad zad par byed/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ni/ /mgon pos dkyil 'khor bri bar mdzod/ /ces gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas slob dpon gyis gung mo rtse sprad/ lhag ma bsnol ba spyi bor bcings la/ oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha ya hūm̐/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la btegs/ bzhi pa srung ba la bzhi ste/ lta stangs dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / rdo rje'i 'gros dang / phur bus bsrung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi nga rgyal gyis langs te/ lag pa gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phyag byas nas/ sems can rnams ma rig pa'i mun par song zhing / bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs par bltas la/ bdud bsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ mig g.yas g.yon du ma dang ḍa las nyi ma zla bar bsam/ mig 'bras gnyis hūm̐ las dus mtha'i me lta bur bsam la phyogs kun tu bltas pas/ bgegs rnams bsreg par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbus su gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis/ hūm̐ lus ngag yid la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po/

/rdo rje 'bar ba'i lus 'di yis/ /rigs gsum las skyes sreg par byed/ /'di ru ma gnas gzhan du dengs/ /rdul phran bzhin du bgegs rnams 'joms/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis/ hūm̐ lus ngag yid la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi /nga ni dpal ldan 'khor lo /bsrung ba'i /'khor lo 'bar ba'i /rigs gsum /'di ru /rdul phran /oṃ tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis/ hūm̐ lus ngag yid /bgegs kyi /nga ni dpal ldan rin chen /bsrung ba'i /rin chen 'bar /rigs gsum /'di ru /rdul phran /oṃ rat+na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis/ hūm̐ lus ngag yid /bgegs kyi /nga ni dpal ldan pad+ma /bsrung ba'i /pad+ma 'bar /rigs gsum /'di ru /rdul phran /oṃ pad+ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis/ hūm̐ lus ngag /bgegs kyi /nga ni dpal ldan ral gri /bsrung ba'i /ral gri /rigs gsum /'di ru /rdul phran /oṃ kharga rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ gsum pa ni/ rdo rje rtse mo'am/ dpal mchog legs pa nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ yang na rkang pa hūm̐ las rdo rjer bsam la/ byang shar mtshams nas g.yas bskor du gsor/ dril bu dkrol zhing / sa phyogs bzang po nam mkha' ltar dri ma med pa 'dir/ rdo rje slob dpon che ge mo bdag gis slob ma rnams la mngon par byang chub pa dang / sems can thams cad kyis bla na med pa'i ye shes bskyed par bya ba'i phyir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor bri bas/ 'dir 'du ba la ma gtogs pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dwags dang / sha za dang / brjed byed dang / 'byung po dang / mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / sa bdag rgan po dang / rgan mo 'khor dang bcas pa dang / bya khyung dang / dri za dang / gsang sngags grub pa rnams dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bka' thos nas sa phyogs gzhan du myur du dengs shig

gal te gang zhig mi 'gro bar gyur na de'i spyi bor rdo rje chen po 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing lus dum bu stong du 'gas par gyur ta re hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod do/ /bzhi pa ni/ phur bu mdun du bzhag la/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis bstod par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i khro bo stod ral gri gshin rje gshed la/ smad phur bu zur gsum pa rtse gcig pa/ bskyed la phyogs mtshams steng 'og rnams su gdab pa ni/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya gha tā ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa/ sarba bigh+nan kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra dha rod adz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nan kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas/ g.yon gyi phyogs skyong bcu'i spyi bor phur bu gdab/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas lag pa g.yas kyi tho bas brdung ngo / /de nas tshogs la longs spyod gtor ma btang / nub dang po'i cho ga'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di dag byed dgos pa'i phyogs su mi snang ba las blang ba dang / sbyong srung rnams kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i bcu gsum ma'i lhan thabs gsal ba'i me long bzhin no/ /nub gnyis pa sta gon gyi cho ga grub ste/ sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod gtor sta gon dang / sa'i lha mo sta gon dang / lha sta gon dang / bum pa sta gon dang / slob ma sta gon dang / thig tshon sta gon no/ /dang po ni/ sa phyogs bzang por phyag bdar dang / skyang nul byas la/ bla re dang / gdugs dang / lda ldi dang / rnga yab dang / 'phan dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ka rgyan dang / gdong g.yogs dang / logs yol dang / gos zung la sogs pas mdzes par bya/ khyad par gyi mchod pa zhing chen gyi bla re dang / zhing chung gi 'phan gdugs dang / rgyu ma'i lda ldi/ snying gi pho lod/ tshar chen rin po che'i lhan thabs las/

gong du dkyil 'khor bri ba'i gnas su chag chag dang skyang nul la sogs pa legs par byas/ gnam sa bar gsum gyi rgyan rnams bkram/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i gzhir dri bzang dang bdud rtsi ril bu la sogs pas byugs/ thig chen brgyad dam/ las thig yongs su rdzogs par btab ste/ cha chen bzhi pa phan chad kyai rdor bzhin/ cha chen gsum pa gru bzhi btab pas lha snam/ de la thig sor gcig dang de'i nang du cha phran phyed dang gnyis spangs par zlum skor gnyis hreg ni gdung zlum/ tshangs thig las g.yas g.yon du cha phran gsum dang / de nas phyed dang gnyis spangs par thig brgyad bsnol mar btab pa gdung bzhi mig mang thig rtsa 'di tshar chen gyi gsung yin/ ris kyi thig go /lha gnas rnams su dbus su dri bzang po'i thig le gru bzhi/ 'khor rnams kyi gnas su zlum po bya/ de dag gi steng du 'bras sam nas la sogs pa'i 'bru dri bzang gis sbags pa'i me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ gtso bo'i steng ngam/ dkyil 'khor byang shar du mañji'i steng du lha'i tshom bu'ang bkod/ rwa chen gyi gsung la mi gsal ba rnams tshar chen gyis gsung 'dis gsal bar byas pa ni 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /khrag gi ar+ghaṃ/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi du ba/ zhun chen gyi snang gsal/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang dung gi gling bu/ thod pa ltag sprod kyi ḍā ma ru/ thod pa'i rnga chung / thod pa'i cha langs/ gzhan yang mchod pa dang rol mo sna tshogs pa bshams/ de rnams kyi mtha' skor 'dod snam gyi steng du lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa/ spos mar me/ lha bshos gsum tshan pa bcu gsum bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar dang shar lhor chu gnyis/ lhor me tog lho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du zhal zas rnams bshams/ 'di rnams drag mchod du bshams na legs/

gtor ma yang 'das pa'i dang / phyogs skyong dang / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang / las gshin dang / srung ma spyi gtor dang / gzhi bdag gi dang / drug la rgyan bzang po dang bcas pa bshams/ drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i gtor ma'ang cho ga bzhin dang / sngon 'gro'i gtor ma zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba sogs ma tshang ba med pa dang / nang gi byang shar du sa lha'i gtor ma dang mchod pa sum tshan kyang bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du 'das gtor/ shar lhor 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma/ de gnyis kyi bar du las kyi gshin rje dang / dgos kyi chos skyong gang byed kyi gtor ma sogs skabs dang sbyar la bshams so/ /de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer mchod lnga'ang sgrengs tshar du bshams/ yang na gtor ma mchod pa bcas pa 'di/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab phyogs sogs gang bder bshams pa'i phyag len kyang mdzad/ sbyor ba rnams kyi mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu ḍā ma ru sogs dang / bum pa gnyis gzungs thag rdo rje sogs nye bar mkho ba thams cad kyang bshams/ de nas bsod nams kyi tshogs nas bzung ste bdag bskyed bzlas pa mchod bstod dang bcas pa byas la phyi rol du drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i gtor mas mchod/ nang du log te dpon slob rnams rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /ces pa la sogs pa 'dud kyi bstod pa lan gsum bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i ngag 'don gyi rim pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma chu chang yi dam nas bzung gzhi bdag gtor ma'i bar/ nang mchod chu chang gsum gyis legs sbyangs la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma chu chang gnyis kyis sbyangs/ zhes bshad/ 'di yi dgongs pa ji ltar yin/ zhes dang por dri ba'i lan ni/ 'di la dgongs pa khyad par can zhig yod pa kho bo cag gis sems te/ sngon 'gro gtor ma ni dkyil 'khor khang pa der gnas pa'i 'byung po gsang spyod lta bar dbang ba dang mi dbang ba kun la thun mong du byin nas lta bar dbang ba rnams la bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las bcol/

lta bar mi dbang ba rnams la nang mchod mi thob pas chu chang tsam gyis sbyong ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin no// gis bran la las kyi rdo rjes phyag 'tshal te/ dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub cing mchod pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs te 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis thog drangs thams cad kyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor ba'i stangs ka bya zhing / oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod thod pa'i nang du gtor rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ lag pa g.yon pa bstan la/ oṃ/ g.yas pa bstan la/ āḥ gnyis ka bstan la/ hūm̐/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la/ hoḥ ces dang / slar yang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ lag pa gnyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis cung zad bkug la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ in+d+ra ā di sa pā ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas gtor mgron spyan drangs/ lag pa rdo rje thal mo kha phye la mthar se gol gtog cing / oṃ in+d+ra ya hrīḥ ya ma yaṣ+ṭī/ bā ru ṇa ya wi/ ku bai ra ya kṛ/ i shwa na ya ta/ ag+na ya a/ nai ri ta ya na/ bā ya be na/ tsan+d+rā ya hūm̐/ brah+ma na ya phaṭa/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ e daṃ ba liṃ grih+ṇa pā ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyi mthar/ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ badz+ra paṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas phyi mchod/ sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum sbyar ba'i nang mchod phul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /lugs 'di'i sngon 'gro gtor ma mchod bstod skabs/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan zhes sogs kyi/

bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin de ltar na/ 'bul yul zhe sdang gshed por thal min nam/ sngon 'gro gtor ma 'bul yul gyi gtso bo dkar phyogs skyong ba'i phyogs skyong bcu skad cig gi rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par bsam nas/ dur khrod rgyan gyis bstod cing mjug tu bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las bcol ba la ni 'gal ba med cing skabs don yin la/ gtor mgron gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba rnams la de ltar bstod na/ mjug tu sngags dang rol mos bskrad pa dang 'gal bas cho ga phyag len rnams zab zub tsam ma yin par thugs brtse'i gtad mtshams ma 'khrul ba gal che/ dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /thugs rje sprul pa'i skur ston pa'i/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun 'jigs khyod la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / 'di yi sngon 'gro gtor ma rtogs pa na/ 'jig rten skyong ba 'khor bcas rnams zhes pa ni/ tshig mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhig yin/ 'bul yul phyogs skyong 'khor bcas ma yin nam/ zhes pa'i lan/ zhes pa tshar chen rin po che'i lhan thabs kyi dpe mang por tshig 'di chad pas de'i dkyus shor ba yin gyi don la tshig 'di ma chad pa zhig dgos te/ phyi mchod dang / nang mchod kyi tshe'ang lo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra zhes dngos su yod pas so/ /de la lo ka ni 'jig rten/ pā la ni skyong ba/ sa pa ri wā ra ni 'khor dang bcas pa la 'jug pa yin no/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /gi bar dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ sa yi phyogs 'dir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/

srung ma dam tshig can khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang / de nas kyang bdag cag rnal 'byor pa dpon slob rnams kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung ba dang sdong grogs mdzod cig/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can de dag sa yi phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig badz+ra muḥhrīḥṣ+ṭiḥ brjod cing rol mo drag tu bya'o/ /de nas gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i/ khrag chen po'i ar+ghaṃ/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug pa/ zhun chen gyi snang gsal/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang dung gi gling bu/ thod pa ltag sprod kyi ḍā ma ru/ thod pa'i rnga chung / thod pa'i cha lang / gzhan yang zhing chen gyi bla re/ zhing chung gi 'phan gdugs/ rgyu ma'i lda lde/ snying gi pho long / mi rus kyi rgyan drug la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad gang ba/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi has mchod yon/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa swāhās zhal bsil/ oṃ ku ma ra rū pi ni dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ phaṭa kyis me tog

oṃ hrīḥhā he phaṭa swāhā/ bdug spos/ oṃ dip+ta lo tsā ni bi kṛ tā na na ma hā aṭ+ṭaṭ+ṭa ha sa na dī ni dīp+ta ya swāhās mar me/ oṃ bi kṛ ta na na duṣ+ṭān satwa da ma ka gaḥgaḥgaḥs dri chab/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi te āḥhūm̐ swāhās zhal zas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo rnams la mchod yon nyer spyod lnga dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya rim bzhin bya zhing mthar/ oṃ badz+ra gheṇ+ḍa ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta nā da sam+bha we na/ badz+ra dhar+m+ma hri da ya/ san+to ṣa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ho ho ho/ a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes rol chen dang bcas pa bya'o/ /skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal zhu 'bul byed na/ phyag bco brgyad ma la sogs pa rgyas bsdus skabs su gang babs bla med spyi ltar bya/ bdag bskyed ni/ rā lo'i gsung las/ gdug pa 'dul phyir drag po'i gzugs 'chang ba/ /'jam dpal khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal nas/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yi/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa bshad par bya/ /de la dang po/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ gnas gang yang rung bar stan bde ba la 'dug la/ rten dang mchod rdzas rdo rje dril bu rnams sta gon byas te/ ༈ skyabs yul mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum bzhugs pa'i gtso bo'i sku lhor bstan dang zhal shar gcus kyi dbang du btang nas gtso bo'i rgyab phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi mdun chos po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu ste gtso bo ni bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog po ti rnams ni chos dkon mchog 'khor rnams ni dge 'dun dkon mchog rā tshar gnyis ka'i gsung min kho bo'i yin/ sgrub thabs kyi ngag 'don ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/

phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dam pa'i chos rnams 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la zhes pa brgya rtsa'am/ nyer gcig la sogs pa bya/ mthar lag pa rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod pas skyabs yul rnams rang la thim par bsam/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor sgom zhing mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod par bya'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs pad+ma'i skyil krung gis yab dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs hūm̐ la thim/

bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gang / de nas yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs/ rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag srog chags mi sdug pa'i rnam pas/ bshang gci dang rkang mthil gnyis nas thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar bsam la/ oṃ shrī ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ ya mān+ta ka twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dri ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wān ya mān+ta ka ma me muñca/ ya mān+ta ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ phyag 'tshal bstod cing phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gus pas sku la bdag gsol 'debs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sgrubs shig /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas/ lus shel sgong g.ya' dag pa ltar bsam/ de nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis pad+ma nyi ma ma he'i steng du/ rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin par gnas pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu brgyan pa la/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab nang gnas pa/ /thugs rje'i phyag gis drangs mdzad nas/ /ye shes bdud rtsis tshim mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pas bla ma la phyag bya/ oṃ badz+ra bai ra wa ya maṇ+ḍal na maḥ dang por me tog phog pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /ces pas lhag pa'i lha la phyag bya/ de nas rang gi thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams spros te/ mchod par bsam zhing ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐ḥ sgeg mo dkar mo/ om̐ badz+ra ma le traṃ/ phreng ba ma ser mo/ oṃ badz+ra gīrti hrīḥ glu ma dmar mo/ oṃ badz+ra nirti āḥ gar ma ljang gu/ oṃ badz+ra dhup+pe hūm̐/ bdug spos ma dkar mo/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ me tog ma ser mo/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ mar me ma dmar skya/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥ dri chab ma ljang gu rnams kyis mchod/ lā s+ye sogs bzhi la rim bzhin dku g.yas g.yon du khu tshur kha gyen bstan smin ma g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi thad nas kha phyir blta/ khu tshur gnyis kha nas 'byin tshul/ rdor thal spyi bor bskor ba'i phyag rgya dang / dhūpe sogs bzhi la spos me tog mar me dri'i phyag rgya bya/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/

/sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad ltar/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung / sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig

sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig ces tshar gcig brjod/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dhar+m+mā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing ga la hūm̐ yig 'od zer 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer steng du 'phros pas/ steng mtho ba yangs shing rgya che ba rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ 'og tu 'phros pas sra zhing brtan pa rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams rnams su 'phros pas rdo rje 'greng bur gyur pa/ brtan zhing go skabs med pa/ mi phyed pa'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang 'dra ba/ phyi rol kun tu 'phros pas bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me ri rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ skabs 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i rā lugs kyi uṣ+ṇi ṣa khro bo bcu'i srung 'khor bsgom par 'dod pas ngag 'don ni/ de'i dbus su bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa gur stabs kyi rnam pa brten zhing go skabs med pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lte ba dang rtsibs rnams su raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi nyi ma'i steng du rang nyid hūm̐ las gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur ba ser po g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ de'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ bcu spros pa las shar du nyi ma'i steng du gshin rje gshed sngo nag g.yas rdo rje tho ba/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po g.yas dbyug pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sngo nag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs pa/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngo nag g.yas lcags kyu/

lho nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po g.yas dbyug tho/ nub byang du stobs po che sngo nag g.yas rtse gsum/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba sngo nag g.yas ral gri/ steng du hūm̐ mdzad sngo nag g.yas rdo rje/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngo nag g.yas gtun shing 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas phyag mtshan 'phyar zhing g.yon pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'khor rnams zhal nang du blta ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de rnams kyi mig tu k+ṣiṃ/ rna bar dziṃ/ snar khaṃ/ lcer gaṃ dpral bar thakaṃ/ lte bar saṃ/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo bcu gcig bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta ā hūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ gong ltar/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni /lha yi chu ni /de bzhin bdag gis /oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ shes rab mthar byed la rnam snang / pad+ma mthar byed la snang ba mtha' yas/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ri ṇī hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ shap+ta/ ghan+dhe/ ra sa/ par+she/ rnams so so'i phyag rgya bcas pas mchod/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bar brgyad du/ me rlung gi steng du dgra bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan spyi tshugs su bsam/ 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor bas dgra bgegs nyal nyal bcad cing gtub/

khro bo thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs par bsam la/ oṃ āḥ.uṣ+ṇi ṣa badz+ra tsakra warti/ sku ye shes gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ 'jig rten thams cad/ sarba lo ki ka lo kod tā ra ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ yan+t+ra man+t+ra 'khrul 'khor sngags rgyud/ tan+t+ra/ byad kyi sbyor ba/ pra yo ga ti/ pra yo gi ni 'dug dug thams cad kyi phye mar gyis/ sarba bi ṣa bi tsur+ṇa ya bi tsur+ṇa ya/ phye mar gyis/ ma ma kṛ te/ bdag la byed pa po/ ye na ke na/ byed pa dang byed pa po/ tsit+ta kṛ ta ni/ yid kyis byed pa/ sarba bigh+nan/ bgegs thams cad/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ chod chod/ bhin+da bhin+da/ phug phug kaṃ pa ya kaṃ pa ya/ khos khos/ ha na ha na/ rgyob rgyob/ da ha da ha/ bsnun bsnun/ pa tsa pa tsa/ tshos tshos/ bi dh+wan+pa ya/ rnam par choms/ bi dh+wan+pa ya/ rnam par choms/ sha ta sa ha pra brgya stong gi sarba bi ṣa bi tsur+ṇa ya bi tsur+ṇa ya/ dug thams cad phye mar gyis phye mar gyis/ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa/ rdo rje gtsug tor/ tsakra warta/ 'khor los bsgyur ba/ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ/ sku gsung rdo rje gsal btab/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ srung bya gsal btab/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ lhar gsal btab/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa dmigs bya gnod byed gsal btab/ swāhā/ gzhi tshugs/ rwa lugs kyi uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i bsrung sngags rdo rje 'chang mkhyen brtse'i phyag bris las dag par zhus pa yin no/ /nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ bha ya nā sa ni/ 'jigs pa thams cad nyams par byed/ trā sa ni/ skrag par byed/ sar+b+ba mā ra/ bdud thams cad/ pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ phyir bzlog par byed/ bi nā sa ni/ rnam par nyams par byed/ yi ge tsit+ta/ gang ci yang rung ba/ duṣ+ṭan satwa/ gdug pa'i sems/

ma ma bi rū pa kaṃ kurban+ti ta ni/ bdag la ngan pa byed pa de dag dang / sar+b+ba mā ra ṇi/ bdud thams cad/ phyir bzlog par gyis shig pra t+yaṃ ka ri ṇi pā ta tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum bzlas/ su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan pa rtsom par byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur na/ de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o/ /ngag bcing bar bgyi'o/ /yid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /mthu brlag par gyur cig stobs brlag par gyur cig rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cig des bsgrubs pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha za bar gyur cig sbyor ba ngan pa byas pa'i 'bras bu de nyid la 'byung bar gyur cig ces brjod cing thal mo lan gsum brdab pa'i mthar/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdud pham mdzad/ /chos ma yin pa chos kyis so/ /dge 'dun gyis ni mu stegs pham/ /dbang pos lha min pham par 'gyur/ /lha min rnams kyis zla ba pham/ /nam mkha' lding gis rgya mtsho yi/ /klu rnams rab tu pham par 'gyur/ /chu yis me ni pham par byed/ /me yis bud shing sreg pa dang / /rlung gis sprin rnams gtor ba dang / /rdo rjes rin chen phug pa dang / /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas/ /bden pa 'di dag thams cad kyis/ /deng 'dir bden pa 'grub gyur cig /khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /zhes brjod/ de nas sgrub thabs dngos la 'jug pa ni/

dbus kyi khro bo zhu ba las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ kun tu bzang po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ de'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa/ de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang / gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i rtsig pa nang nas rim pa bzhin du/ nag po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po ste rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rtsig pa'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu ser po la/ phyi nang kun tu rin po che'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ mu tig gi phreng ba dang / rdo rje'i srad bu dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / me long dang / rnga yab dang / dril bu dang / g.yer kha la sogs pa'i rgyan mang po 'khrol zhing 'phyang ba/ pha gu'i steng na rin po che'i mda' yab dang / pu shu mchod rten gyis rnam par mdzes pa/ pu shu'i steng gi khor yug kun tu yang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sna tshogs bsgreng ba/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing steng rdo rje'i gdung chen po bzhi dang / gdung zlum gyis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus gtsang khang phyur bur phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis mtshan pa/

sgo bzhi'i thad ka nas ka ba bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa/ pad+ma la gnas pa'i ri dwags dang / chos kyi 'khor lo char kheb tog dang bcas pas sgo'i steng brgyan pa/ ka ba'i phyi na bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i steng na glang po che/ de'i steng nas seng ge'i phrug gu lag pa brkyangs pas sgo'i phyi stod la slebs pa/ sgo'i phyi nas rin po che'i them skas rim pa lngas mdzes par byas pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi nang 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas gar byed pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad gnas pa ni/ shar du gtum drag gi dur khrod/ lhor drag tu rgod pa/ nub tu sgo ra a dha ka dang / byang du ki li ki li/ shar lhor ni bi tsi sha lho nub tu 'bar ba'i rigs/ nub byang du dmyal sogs/ byang shar du dbyibs can te/ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag tu shing chen po brgyad gnas pa ni/ shar du nā ga ge sar/ lhor pak+sha/ nub tu a shwad ta/ byang du pa ta la/ shar lhor ardzu na/ lho nub tu pa la sha nub byang du u dum wā ra/ byang shar du a smra ste/ shing chen po brgyad/ de dag tu phyogs skyong ba brgyad/ shing la rgyab bsten pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa ni/ shar du brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa thod dbyug 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa ne'u le 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po sngo nag ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha dud kha sha ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ byang shar du 'byung po dkar po khyung mchog la zhon pa mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/

thams cad kyang phyag g.yon pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /de dag na zhing skyong ba brgyad gnas pa ni/ shar du a dha ha sa dkar po glang po che'i mgo can/ lhor tsā ri tra sngon po ma he'i mgo can/ nub tu ko la gi ri nag po chu srin gyi mgo can/ byang du dza yan ta ser po rta yi mgo can/ shar lhor pra yan ta dmar po ra yi mgo can/ lho nub tu sna dzu ma sngon mo ro langs kyi mgo can/ nub byang du de wa tsakra ljang gu sha ba'i mgo can/ byang shar du u tsu ya ni dud kha khyu mchog gi mgo can/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi phyogs kyi shing gi steng na lus phyed 'thon pa/ skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi steng gi nam mkha' la sprin chen po brgyad gnas pa ni/ shar du sgrog byed ser po/ lhor ldog byed sngon po/ nub tu 'jigs byed dkar po/ byang du 'khor byed ser po/ shar lhor 'gengs byed dmar po/ lhor nub tu char 'bebs sngon po/ nub byang du gtum po nag po/ byang shar du 'thug po dkar po'o/ /klu chen brgyad gnas pa ni/ shar du nor rgyas ser po/ lhor pad+ma dkar po/ nub tu karko ṭa dmar po/ byang du tak+ṣa ka nag po/ shar lhor hu lun+ta ser skya/ lho nub tu rigs ldan dkar po/ nub byang du dung skyong ser po/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po ljang khu rnams te thams cad kyang phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar nor bu rin po che 'dzin pa/ stod lha'i lus can sbrul mgo'i gdeng ka bdun dang ldan zhing smad sbrul mjug g.yas su 'khyil ba'o/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa brgyad/ me brgyad/ chu brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ bya dang sha za sna tshogs dang / mi ro sna tshogs dang / ro langs dang / srin po dang / 'dre rnams gnas pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus ling tshe dgur gnas pa'i dbus su/ mi mgo'i 'khor gyi lha dang gtso bo'i bar mtshams su thod pa'i gur khang byed 'di sgrub thabs su ling tshe dgur gnas dbus su mi mgo yi rwa ba zhes pa'i tshig dang /

rwa ba zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba sgo 'di dpe phal cher la mi 'dug kyang don la dgos/ gcig dang ldan pa/ steng keng rus kyis phub pa/ g.yang gzhi'i bla re/ rgyu rlon gyi lda lde/ 'grig snang yang / dbyibs zlum yangs shing rgya che la sogs kyi/ khyad chos dang ldan thod rwa de'i dbus/ yaṃ las rlung dang shar du mgo bo sogs/ so so'i gdan rnams bskyed dang mi 'gal lo/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ de lta bu'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes sogs kyi tshig 'gres ltar na/ zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba nas/ phyi nang kun tu khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'i thod rwa/ de lta bu'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung sogs/ shar du mgo bo/ lhor lag pa nas/ byang shar du skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa'i bar 'byung bas/ de kun thod rwa nyid kyi nang du tshud dgos pa ltar snang la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang thod rwa'i dbus su gtso bo'i gdan smos pa'i shugs las/ shar du mgo bo sogs kyang thod rwa'i nang gi shar sogs su yin pa las 'os med pa yin no/ /snyam du dogs so/ /de nas rang gi bsam tshod ni/ mngon rtogs kyi tshig de la 'bras bu myong shes na dogs pa rang grol du 'gro ba yin te/ ling tshe dgur gnas pa'i dbus su mi mgo'i rwa ba zhes pa ltar thod rwa gtso/ yab yum nyid la byed pa 'thad cing / de lta bu'i dbus su zhes sogs ni khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus dang shar sogs yin gyi/ thod rwa rang gi dbus dang shar sogs kyi 'bru mi byed pa ni gnad dam pa yin pas so/ /de ltar byas na khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho'i steng du ling tshe dgu char 'byung ba dngos su gsal bas 'khrul pa med cing phyi nang kun tu khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa zhes pa dang / de lta bu'i dbus su zhes pa gnyis tshig snga phyi 'brel chags pa yin no// rus pa'i phreng ba rnams kyis brgyan pa/ phyi nang kun tu khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa de lta bu'i dbus su/

yaṃ las rlung rā lo'i mngon rtogs rgyas par gtso gdan la/ rlung ro pad nyi rim brtsegs bshad snang ba gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can/ gtso bo dpa' gcig yongs rdzogs sgrub thabs su/ /pad nyi tsam las ma bshad dgongs gzhi ci/ /dpa' gcig zhal phyag yongs rdzogs sgrub thabs su/ /khrag zhag 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor bshad/ /mngon rtogs chen mor rlung gi steng du bshad/ /'di gnyis dgongs gzhi so sor 'grel tshul cing / /zhes pa'i lan ni/ spyir btang rwa lugs 'di la mngon rtogs rgyas pa ltar du rlung ro pad nyi'i gdan bzhi brtsegs mdzad pa yin te/ rlung gi gdan ni rgyud nyid las nam mkha'i dbyings su yaṃ gyi rnam pa las grub pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor mdog du ba'i rnam par bsam ste zhes dang / de'i 'grel par mi bskyod pas/ nam mkha'i dkyil du yi ge yaṃ sngon po las grub pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i mdog can bsams te/ 'di ni khro bo chen po'i gdan te/ rgyud 'di ni mngon spyod gtso bor gyur pa yin pas/ gdug pa can thams cad rab tu 'thor bar byed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas bstan/ ro gdan ni/ rtog pa dang po las/ sgo gcig pa ni dbye bar bya/ /lhag ma yongs su gcad par bya/ /de dbus mi ro bri bar bya/ /zhes dang / slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i 'grel par/ ro bri 'o zhes pa ni gdan te/ zhes gsungs pas bstan/ pad gdan ni rgyud kyi dngos bstan la mi gsal yang / la li ta badz+ra gyis/ lnga bcur gcig gi ma tshang gdan/ /pad+ma rlung ni yang dag gnas/ /zhes gsungs pas bstan/ nyi gdan ni lha khro bo'i gdan la nyi gdan bsam pas/ rwa ltar na pad+ma'i steng du dang po nyi gdan bskyed/ khrag zhag gi 'og tu byed pa ni sngar bshad pa ltar rten dang brten par bcas pa'i 'og gzhi byas nas/ lha'i gdan tsam du mi byed par dpa' gcig yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs su khrag zhag gi 'og tu rlung byed pa de la dgongs la/

mngon rtogs chen mo khrag zhag steng du rlung bshad pa ni/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan ltar lha'i gdan la dgongs pa yin pas/ dgongs gzhi so sor 'grel tshul de ltar yin no/ /de'i steng du ro mgo med/ lag med/ shar du mgo bo/ lhor lag pa/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang pa/ shar lhor thod pa/ lho nub tu thod tshal/ nub byang du rlung ras/ byang shar du skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa/ khyams kyi nang du shar sgo'i g.yas nas mtshams la thug gi bar du/ gri gug dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa dang / gtun shing ngo / /shar sgo'i g.yon nas mtshams la thug gi bar du/ chu gri dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / lcags kyu rnams so/ /lho sgo'i g.yas nas mtshams la thug gi bar du/ dgra satwa/ mda' dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'o/ /lho sgo'i g.yon nas mtshams la thug gi bar du/ dbyug tho dang / 'khor lo dang / rdo rje zhags pa rnams so/ /nub sgo'i g.yas nas mtshams la thug gi bar du/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / rnge'u chung dang / phub rnams so/ /nub sgo'i g.yon nas mtshams la thug gi bar du/ gzhu dang / dril bu dang / rlung gi ras rnams so/ /byang sgo'i g.yas nas mtshams la thug gi bar du/ sdigs mdzub dang / 'phan rtse gsum pa dang / glang po che'i lpags pa rnams so/ /byang sgo'i g.yon nas mtshams la thug gi bar du/ rdo rje tho ba dang / mdung thung dang / me thab rnams so/ /shar sgor tho ba/ lho sgor dbyug pa/ nub sgor pad+ma/ byang sgor ral gri/ grwa bzhir ro langs mgo gsum lag pa gsum/ rkang pa gsum yod pas gar byed pa'o/ /dbus su paṃ las pad+ma'i sdong po 'dab dkyil 'khor nang gi phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi ru/ mgo dang lag sogs bkod 'di rigs bzhi dang / /lha mo bzhi yi gdan la dgongs yin nam/ /yang na lha'i mtshan ma gzhan zhig yin/ /sgo bzhi'i g.yas g.yon mtshams la gri gug sogs/ /phyag mtshan 'bri zhing sgom la dgos pa ci/ /'di dag lha ru bskyed pa yod dam med/

/yod na de tshe lha grangs ji tsam 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ gti mug gshin rje sogs kyi rigs bzhi dang / lha mo bzhi'i gdan rang la dgongs pa ni ma yin no/ /'o na 'di dag ci zhe na/ gtso bo'i phyag g.yon gyi gnyis pa'i mgo bo dang / g.yon gyi dgu pa'i brdeg don lag pa dang / bdun pa'i rgyu ma dang / bzhi ba'i rkang pa dang / g.yon dang po'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / bcu gsum pa'i thod tshal dang / bcu pa'i dur khrod kyi ras dang / bcu gcig pa'i skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa ste/ g.yon gyi phyag mtshan rnams kyi nang nas brgyad/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi re'u mig brgyad la 'god pa yin te/ rgyud las shar du mgo bo zhes pa nas/ 'di dag ni 'khor lo'i dbus su phyag rgya'i mtshan ma'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ phyag rgya'i mtshan ma zhes pa yang / spyir lha'i phyag mtshan dang / bye brag skabs 'dir gtso bo nyid kyi phyag mtshan la bya rigs pas so/ /phyag mtshan 'di dag bri ba ni rgyud las/ de nas 'khor lo'i phyi rim gyi phyag rgya rnams ni/ shar gyi snam bu la gri gug dang zhags pa nas/ byang gi snam bu la sdigs mdzub dang / 'phan rtse gsum pa dang / glang po che'i pags pa dang / rdo rje tho ba dang / mdung dang / me thab la sogs pa bri bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yin la/ bris pa'i dgos pa ni/ bcu gsum ma dang ro langs brgyad bskor lta bu la ni/ de dag ltar mi bskyed pas/ tshig tsam gyi sgo nas gsal btab nas phyag mtshan rang gi ngo bo sgom pa tsam las gzhan mi snang zhing phyag mtshan rang gi ngo bo dkyil 'khor la bsgoms pa lha 'di ma gtogs dkyil 'khor gzhan la cher mi snang bas/ lugs 'di'i khyad chos su bya dgos la/ de nas phyag mtshan bsgoms pa'i dgos pa ji ltar yin blo gros dang ldan pa dag gis sngon gyi 'grel ba tshad ldan las btsal bar bya ste/ rang bzo tsam gyi bshad pas ni/ rang gzhan nges shes bskyed mi nus shing /

chos la dbang za ba ba'i sdig shin tu lci bas so/ /phyag mtshan lhar bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams la ni/ lha bskyed pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i lha mtshan yin pas dgos pa gzhan zur du mi dgos la/ 'o na de'i tshe lha grangs ji tsam du 'gyur snyam na/ lha grangs la bod kyi rtog bzo sna tshogs yod kyang / khungs thub ni la li ta badz+ra kyis bzhed pa rdo rje 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma yin no// ma stong dang ldan pa'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bar zhing tsha ba/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ raṃ las nyi steng 'jam dbyangs bskyed pa 'di/ rtog bdun rgyud las rgyu yi 'jam dpal gyi gdan la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs pa dang / 'gal zhes rgol na lan 'debs ji ltar 'os/ /ces pa'i lan ni/ zla gdan 'di rang gi bsam tshod ni/ ro mgo med lag med nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bar zhing tsha ba'i bar/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'jigs byed bzhengs dus kyi gdan yin pas rwa lo'i mngon rtogs ltar ma chad par byas nas/ de'i steng du re zhig la zla ba'i gdan yang bsam nas rgyu'i 'jam dpal bskyed pa yin te/ lha zhi ba'i gdan la zla gdan 'os pa'i phyir dang / khyad par rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog bdun las/ dang po'i dbyangs yig las gyur pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dmigs te/ de'i steng du dhī'i rnam pa las 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i gzugs su gyur par bsam/ zhes gsal bar gsungs pas so// shar du mgo bo'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ lhor lag pa gnyis kyi steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ nub tu rgyu ma'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma 'od dang bral ba/ byang du rkang pa gnyis kyi steng du pad+ma dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ 'gor rkang pa gnyis zhes 'byung bas lag pa gnyis zhes kho bos bkod/ mtshams bzhi pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ sgo bzhir pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan no/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las/

rang nyid rgyu'i tshar chen rin po che'i lam rim du/ mngon byang lnga las rgyu yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi skur langs te/ /zhes gsungs pa'i khungs gang yin/ zhes mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis dri ba mdzad nas/ rang lan la 'di'i khungs mkhan chen nams lhun pa'i 'grel bar 'dug kyang / mngon byang lnga bskyed rnam dag tu mi 'gro/ des na rgyu'i 'jam dbyangs kyang rdo rje'i cho ga gsum bskyed yin par bzhed/ 'jam dpal sku mdog gser gyi mdog can/ phyag g.yas ral gri dpung pa'i thad du 'dzin zhing / g.yon pas ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar mtheb srin gyis 'dzin pa'i steng du po ti 'dzin pa/ zhi ba 'dzum pa sgeg pa'i nyams can ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing / zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'/ rig pa'i lha mo khro bo gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la thim pas 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i 'od kyi phung po chen por gyur pa ni/ sku'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa'i dga' ba'o/ /de las 'od zer 'phros pas de dag gi thugs ka nas/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ oṃ ya ma ra dza/ sa do me ya/ ya me do ru/ ṇa yo da na/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya k+ṣe ya/ ya k+ṣe yats+tsha/ ni ra ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams 'dus/ rang la phog pa'i rkyen gyis/ 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i hūm̐ nag po 'od zer lnga dang bcas par bsams pa ni/

gsung gi zhing khams rnam par dag pa'i dga' ba'o/ /de las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas gri gug dang thod pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi bye brag dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ rang la phog pa'i rkyen gyis rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa rwa gdengs pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa ni/ thugs kyi zhing khams rnam par dag par dag pa'i dga' ba'o/ sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha sku spyan drangs nas thugs ka'i nyi ma la bstim par gsungs pa'i 'gros sbyar nas/ yig 'bru dang phyag mtshan yang spyan drangs nas bstim pa las hūm̐ dang phyag mtshan du gyur pa don gyi thob pa la dgongs pa yin pas rgyud don bla ma'i man ngag gis phye ba'i gnad dam pa'o snyam du kho bo cag gis sems so/ /des na 'di la dpyad pa mi dgos so/ /'on kyang rwa'i rjes 'brangs phal cher mngon rtogs dkyus na sku'i dga' ba sogs/ dga' ba gsum gyi tha snyad mdzad pa la brten nas/ dga' ba gsum las lha bskyed pa yin gsungs pa mang dag snang yang / rgyud las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du zhes pa nas/ de'i steng du hūm̐ mdog sngon po zhes sogs gsungs pas/ 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i nyi dkyil rgya che ba de'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las bskyed pa dngos su gsal bas/ don la rdo rje cho ga gsum bskyed kyi rigs su 'gro/ de las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyi don byas dgra bgegs rwa chen gyi gsung yig 'bru dang thugs phyag mtshan spyan drangs nas bstim pa yang rgyud nyid las/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ snod bcud thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por gyur/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog char sprin gyi mdog ltar gnag cing nam mkha'i 'od ltar gsal ba/

zhal dgu phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi pa/ zhabs bcu drug dang ldan pa/ rtsa zhal nag po ma he'i gdong can mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ khro gnyer dang bcas pa rwa sngon po rno zengs pa la rus pa'i rgyan khrol ba/ phaṭa dang pheṃ gyi sgra sgrog pa/ de'i steng du srin po'i zhal dmar po khrag 'dzag cing mche ba gtsigs pa'i steng na/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po 'dzum zhing cung zad khro ba/ snyan gong na ut+pal dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rwa'i g.yas kyi zhal dang po sngon po mche ba gtsigs pa/ de'i steng na gnyis pa dmar po ljags 'dril ba/ de'i steng na gsum pa ser po khro gnyer bsdus pa/ rwa'i g.yon gyi zhal dang po dkar pos rmongs par byed pa/ de'i steng na gnyis pa dud khas rengs par byed pa/ de'i steng na gsum pa nag pos gsod par byed pa/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum me stag gi phung po ltar dmar la zlum pa mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ thod skam lnga lngas khro zhal rnams kyis dbu la brgyan pa/ thams cad kyi dbu skra kham nag 'jam dpal gyi spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba/ hūm̐ dang phaṭa dang ha ha'i gad rgyangs rnams par sgrog pa'o/ /phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi'i g.yas pa 'jigs byed la ma he'i zhal dang phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi sogs 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gti mug can gyi gtso bo tshangs pa yin pas phyi ltar na tshangs pa 'dul ba'i gnyen po dang / nang ltar na gti mug 'dul ba'i gnyen po phyag mang po dag 'byung ba yin te/ dper na pha rol du phyin pa dag rten 'brel dang khams kyi dbye ba mtha' yas pa gsungs pa dag nyon mongs pa gti mug gi gnyen por sbyor ba bzhin no/ /des na 'di'i phyag mtshan la tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'byung ba'i gnad kyang de ltar yin/ de bzhin dbang phyug 'dul ba'i phyir gsang ba gyen 'greng dang /

khyab 'jug 'dul ba'i phyir ma he'i zhal byung bar bshad pa shin tu legs te/ 'dod chags can gyi gtso bo dbang phyug zhe sdang can gyi gtso bo khyab 'jug yin pas don la sbyang gzhi 'dod chags kyi gnyen por sbyang byed gsang ba gyen 'greng dang sbyang gzhi zhe sdang gi gnyen por sbyang byed ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa byung ba ni/ gnyen po spang bya'i rnam par shar ba'am/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed rigs mthun pa'i gnad dam pa bla med spyi'i khyad chos yin bsam/ rtog bdun las/ rwa'i g.yas su zhal gsum pa/ dang po sngon po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa ser po/ zhal gsum ka yang shin tu khros pa'o/ /rwa g.yon par zhal gsum dang po dkar po/ gnyis pa dud kha/ gsum pa nag po rab tu khros pa/ brtsegs pa'i zhal bsam par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ brtsegs zhal dang 'khor zhal gyi rnam gzhag ma gsungs pa la/ mkhas grub phal cher la li ta dang / a mo gha sogs rgya gzhung sgrub thabs rnams las 'khor zhal gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'khor zhal mdzad pa mang la rwa lo chen pos brtsigs zhal mdzad pa 'di kha cig rwa lo'i gzigs snang tsam las rgyud kyi dngos bstan la med gsungs yang / saṃ bu ṭa'i rtog pa bdun pa'i rab byed bzhi pa las/ dang po ni ma he'i gdong / /g.yas pa'i rwa'i zhal gsum ni/ sngon po dang dmar po dang ser po ste/ /khro gnyer dang zhal brtsegs pa'o/ /g.yon pa ni/ dkar po dang / du ba dang / nag po'o/ /de dag gi dbus su zhal shin tu dmar zhing khrag 'dzag pa'o/ /de'i steng du 'jam dpal gyi gzugs shin tu ser zhing cung zad khro ba zhes gsungs pas/ g.yas g.yon gnyis kyang brtsegs zhal du bstan pa kho bo cag gis sems te/ gzhan du 'khor zhal byed na g.yas g.yon gyi zhal de dag gi dbus su/ ma he'i zhal steng gi srin po'i zhal dmar po de'ang don med pa'i phyir brtsegs zhal la rgyud kyi zin so med par 'dod pa dag legs par dpyod cig

rwa chen po'i lugs la ni/ ma he'i rwa phan tshun gyi logs la g.yas g.yon gyi zhal rnams rim brtsegs byas pas/ de dag gi dbus su srin po'i zhal dmar po khrag 'dzag pa yong ba bsnyon med du grub pa yin la de bas na/ rwa chen po'i bzhed pa 'di dag ni dkyil 'khor gtso bo nyid kyi gsung dang khyad par med pas/ 'di las gzhan du rtogs par mi rigs so// rnams kyi rim pa bzhin du/ gri gug dang mtshon rtse gcig pa dang / gtun shing dang / chu gri dang / rdo rje rtse gcig dang / dgra satwa dang / mdung dang / mda' dang / lcags kyu dang / dbyug pa dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ka dang / 'khor lo dang / rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / rdo rje tho ba dang / ral gri dang / rnge'u chung rnams bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / mgo bo dang / phub dang / rkang pa dang / zhags pa dang / gzhu dang / rgyu ma dang / dril bu dang / lag pa dang / dur khrod kyi ras dang / skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa dang / me thab dang / thod tshal dang / sdigs mdzub dang / 'phan rtse gsum pa dang / rlung gis 'phyar ba'i ras rnams bsnams pa'o/ /phyag tha ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa rlon pa brgyangs nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams bskum pas rim pa bzhin du mi dang / ma he dang / glang dang / bong bu dang / rnga mong dang / khyi dang / lug dang / wa rnams mnan pa'o/ /g.yon pa brgyad brkyangs pas/ rim pa bzhin du/ bya rgod/ 'ug pa/ khwa ta/ ne tso/ khra dang / khyung dang / ri skegs dang / bzhad rnams mnan pa'o/ /de rnams kyi 'og tu tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po/ gzhon nu gdong drug ljang gu rnams kha sbub tu mnan pa/ gcer bu mtshan ma gyen du 'greng ba/ mi'i khrag dang tshil dang / zhag dang / rkang rnams zhal du gsol ba/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la bsdigs par mdzad pa/ mi mgo rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i 'phyang 'phrul dang /

sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ thal chen gyi tshom bu dang / khrag gi thig le dang / zhag gi zo ris dang ldan pa/ khams gsum za bar nus pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod pa drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba ste/ /gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /de dag gi 'bras bu'i gshin rje gshed do/ /de'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog gser gyi mdog can nas/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /bar rgyu'i 'jam dpal ltar bskyed/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon pas bcom ldan 'das la 'khril ba/ 'di la mkhas dbang ngag dbang chos grags kyis yum yod med kyi dpyad pa mkhas grub du ma'i bzhed pa rnams gsungs pa'i mthar/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan la yum ma bshad pa'i pho rkyang gi sgrub thabs la dgongs pa bzhin dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs rnams su yum med pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin la/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi skabs su rwa lo'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa bzhin yum yod pa med de/ mnyam nyid rnam rgyal le'u bcu bdun pa las/ lha mo rdo rje bde ba ma/ /gnyis su med par gnas pa'o/ /de nyid zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa yi/ /zhes dngos su bstan pas/ rdo rje myu gu las/ yum sbyor na dgra nag gi yum zhal gsum phyag drug ma de rig kyang / gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sbyor ba mi 'thad ces skyon brjod mdzad kyang /

mnyam nyid rnam rgyal nas gsungs pa'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma 'di yod pas dgra nag gi yum kha bskang ma dgos shing / 'khor bcu gnyis ni 'jigs byed la sbyar ba rgyud gang gi'ang zin so med pas/ dgra nag nas kha bskang ba bla ma'i man ngag yin la/ des na rwa lugs bcu gsum ma 'di ni gtso bo la dngos yum 'thad cing / bskyed rim gyi skabs su mngal 'byin rgyas pa dang / dbang gnyis pa dang / gsum pa'i tshe/ slob dpon dang slob ma 'jigs byed yab yum du bskyed nas gsang rdzas sgrub cing / dga' gzhi nyams su myong ba gsungs pas kyang dngos yum yod pa grub bo/ /rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs bzhed kyi snying po lha 'di la mtshan ma gyen 'greng byung ba'i gnad kyi gnas skabs kun tu dngos yum med pa yin gsungs pa 'di shes byed rtsar rgyag la shin tu bzang ba zhig 'dug kyang / kho bo cag rwa pa'i rjes 'brang du khas 'che ba dag gis khas len mi nus la/ 'o na ci zhe na/ phyi ltar na dbang phyug chen po dang / nang ltar na chags pa'i gnyen por gsang ba'i mtshan ma de ltar du bskyed pa gnas skabs kun tu yin zhing / de yang rwa lo'i bcu gsum ma lta bu la gtso bo sems dpa' sum brtsegs bskyed pa yan mtshan ma gyen langs byas nas/ pang du yum bskyed de mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa nas bzung gsang ba'i mtshan ma rdo rje'i rnam pa can yum gyi pad+ma dang lhan cig tu sbyar te yod pas/ gong du mtshan ma gyen 'greng smos kyang dngos su med par 'gyur ba'i nges pa mi snang ba'i gnad 'di snying la 'chang rig pa yin no/ /dngos yum dang rang 'od kyi yum gyi khyad par ni/ rgyud rnams las/ sku mdog sogs dngos su gsungs pa bzhin nyams len gyi tshe yang bskyed chog gi ngag 'don la dngos su yod cing ras bris la de 'dri ba dang / rdul tshon la de'i phyag mtshan bkod pa rnams ni dngos yum yin par rwa lugs bcu gsum ma 'di'i bri cha la gtso bo'i yum ma chad pa zhig nges par dgos shing /

rang 'od dam rang snang gi rig ma ni lha de dang rnam pa 'dra ba'i rig ma zhig skad cig gis bsam pa tsam las bskyed chog dngos su med pa rnams yin pas bcu gsum ma 'di'i rigs bzhi dang sgo ba bzhi la/ dngos yum mi 'bri zhing yum bzhi la dngos yab mi 'bri'o/ /'o na dbang gi tshe yid kyis rig ma lha mor bskyed chog byed pas ji ltar zhe na/ 'bab dbang gi skabs su dngos kyi rig ma dang ye shes kyi rig ma gnyis bshad pa de dang / bskyed rim gyi skabs 'dir dngos yum dang rang 'od kyi rig ma bshad pa gnyis 'jog mtshams gcig zhig dgos pa ltar snang yang rgya che chung dang bsdu lugs kyi dbang gis mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po yod de/ dbang gi skabs kyi ye shes kyi rig ma 'di dbang rang gi skabs su dngos rgya dang yid rgya gnyis su phye ba'i dngos yum ma yin kyang / spyir dngos yum du song ba'i phyir te/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya de nyid ro langs mar bskyed chog dngos su byas nas thabs sgrub pa po de dang snyoms 'jug gi bde ba bsgom pas so/ /des na dbang dus kyi dngos kyi rig ma dang bskyed rim gyi dngos kyi rig ma la rgya che chung gi khyad par yod cing / de'i rgyu mtshan dbang dus kyi ye shes kyi rig ma yang lus lha'i 'du shes bsgom pa'i tshe dngos yum du song bas dbang dus kyi gnyis char yang bskyed rim gyi skabs kyi dngos yum du 'dus pa yin no// gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas mi dmigs te hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te aṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa ze'u 'bru la aṃ gis mtshan pa/ gnyis ka'i bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/

yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka nas srog dag pa'i lam nas brgyud/ yum gyi mkhar babs pas/ thig le bcu gnyis su gyur te/ de dag gnas gyur pa las shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi shes rab ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na rin po che/ gsum pa na pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed sku mdog ser po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser ba/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis sogs g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rin po che/ gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ gsum pa na pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar ba/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar/ phyag dang po gnyis sogs g.yas kyi gnyis pa na pad+ma/ gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na nor bu/ gsum pa na 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed sku mdog ljang gu/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal ljang ba/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis sogs g.yas kyi gnyis pa na ral gri/ gsum pa na 'khor lo/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma/ gsum pa na nor bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor tsa tsi ka sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yab dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ phyag lhag ma gti mug gshin rje gshed dang 'dra'o/ /lho nub tu phag mo sku mdog sngon mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal sngo ba'i steng na phag zhal gyen du blta ba/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis sogs g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rdo rje/ gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na 'khor lo/
