gsum pa na pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dbyangs can ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu'o/ /byang shar du gau rī sku mdog ljang khu/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu'o/ /shar sgor tho ba gshin rje gshed sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo ba g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa rang 'od kyi shes rab ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na tho ba/ gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na nor bu/ gsum pa na pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lho sgor dbyug pa gshin rje gshed sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ phyag dang po gnyis sogs g.yas kyi gnyis pa na dbyug pa/ gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma/ gsum pa na 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ nub sgor pad+ma gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar ba/ g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis sogs g.yas kyi gnyis pa na pad+ma/ gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ gsum pa na nor bu 'dzin pa/ byang sgor ral gri gshin rje gshed sku mdog ljang gu zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal ljang ba/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis/ gong bzhin la/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na ral gri/ gsum pa na 'khor lo/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na nor bu/ gsum pa na pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang thod pa dang / sbrul dang / mi sdug pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de nas/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor du spro bar bya ste/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga ji snyed yod pa nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skur gyur te/

gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ rlung dang / pad+ma dang / nyi ma'i steng du bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ dzi na dzika hūm̐ phaṭa/ gti mug gshin rje gshed dpag des phal cher la 'di bzhin snang yang / 'og ma rnams la dpag na rlung dang ro mgo med lag med dang / pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du zhes mi dgos sam snyam du kho bos sems so/ /tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi skur gyur te/ shar du mgo bo dang / pad+ma dang / zla ba'i steng du zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis 'khod par gyur/ oṃ rat+na dh+rig hūm̐ phaṭa/ ser sna gshin rje gshed dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi ser sna'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ ser sna gshin rje gshed kyi gong 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus ser sna gshin rje gshed kyi skur gyur te/ lhor lag pa dang / pad+ma dang / nyi ma'i steng du zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis 'khod par gyur/ oṃ a ro lika hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi sku gyur te/ nub tu rgyu ma dang pad+ma dang nyi ma 'od dang bral ba'i steng du zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis 'khod par gyur/ oṃ pradz+nyā dh+rika hūm̐ phaṭa/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi phrag dog gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi skur gyur te/ byang du rkang pa/ pad+ma dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis 'khod par gyur/ oṃ mo ha ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ byams pa tshad med pa'i ngo bo tsa tsi ka dpag tu med pa spros/

sems can thams cad kyi sa yi khams su 'dzin pa'i bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ tsa tsi ka'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus tsa tsi ka'i skur gyur te/ shar lho'i mtshams su thod pa dang pad zla'i steng du 'khod/ oṃ dwe ṣa ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ snying rje tshad med pa'i ngo bo phag mo dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi chu'i khams su 'dzin pa'i bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ phag mo'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus phag mo'i skur gyur te/ lho nub mtshams su thod tshal dang pad zla'i steng du 'khod/ oṃ ra ga ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ dga' ba tshad med pa'i ngo bo dbyangs can ma dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi me'i khams su 'dzin pa'i bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ dbyangs can ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus dbyangs can ma'i skur gyur te/ nub byang mtshams su rlung ras dang pad zla'i steng du 'khod/ oṃ badz+ra ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ btang snyoms tshad med pa'i ngo bo gau rī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi rlung gi khams su 'dzin pa'i bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ gau rī'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus gau rī'i skur gyur te/ byang shar mtshams su skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa dang pad zla'i steng du 'khod/ oṃ murga ra dh+rika hūm̐ phaṭa/ tho ba gshin rje gshed dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi phung po'i bdud dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / 'jigs tshogs la lta ba rnams bcom/ tho ba gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus tho ba gshin rje gshed kyi sku gyur te/ shar sgor pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du 'khod/ oṃ dan+ḍa dhṛka hūm̐ phaṭa/ dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba rnams bcom/ dbyug pa gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus dbyug pa gshin rje gshed kyi skur gyur te/

lho sgor pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du 'khod/ oṃ pad+ma dh+rika hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma gshin rje gshed dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi 'chi bdag gi bdud dang / skye ba'i sgrib pa dang log par lta ba rnams bcom/ pad+ma gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus pad+ma gshin rje gshed kyi skur gyur te nub sgor pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du 'khod/ oṃ khad+ga dh+rika hūm̐ phaṭa/ ral gri gshin rje gshed dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi lha'i bu'i bdud dang / las kyi sgrib pa dang / lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa rnams bcom/ ral gri gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus ral gri gshin rje gshed kyi skur gyur te/ byang sgor pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du 'khod pa/ 'khor gyi lha rnams yum gyi mkha' nang du/ bskyed dam rang rang gdan gyi steng du bskyed/ mkha' nang bskyed na sgo bzhi'i tshig dang 'gal/ gdan steng bskyed na gdan la slar 'khod cing / zhes pa'i lan ni/ de ltar mkha' nang du bskyed kyang shar sgo sogs kyi tshig 'byung ba ni/ tho ba gshin rje gshed sogs kyi/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'khod pa na/ sgo nang so sor bzhugs pa yin pas de tsam la dgongs pa'am yang na yi ge pas tshig zur cung zad lhag pa yin no/ /lha de rnams thams cad kyi mig gnyis su k+ṣiṃ dang 'khor lo las sa'i snying po/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na rin po che/ gsum pa na pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rna bar dziṃ dang rdo rje las phyag na rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rdo rje/ gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na 'khor lo/

gsum pa na pad+ma 'dzin pa/ snar khaṃ dang / rin po che las nam mkha'i snying po sku mdog ser po/ ser sna gshin rje gshed lta bu/ lcer gaṃ dang pad+ma las/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu/ dpral bar thakaṃ dang / ral gri las sgrib pa rnams sel sku mdog ljang khu/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu/ lte bar saṃ dang 'khor lo las kun tu bzang po sku mdog dkar po/ gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje sku mdog dkar po/ gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje sku mdog dmar mo/ /'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje sku mdog nag po/ phyag na rdo rje lta bu/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs rjes su skye mched dang / sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams gsal 'debs pa'i go rim ltar na ye sems thugs ka ru/ thugs kyi rdo rje bskyed dgos ma yin no/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ dpa' bo gcig pa dang / dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i mngon rtogs gnyis ka las go rim de lta bu bshad pas snying kar ye sems sngon las bskyed pa'i phyir na/ slar yang thugs kar thugs rdo rje bskyed pa nas/ ye sems kyi thugs kar bskyed pa las 'os med do snyam pa'i dogs pa 'byung rigs la/ 'on kyang dngos gsal la de lta bu mi 'thad la/ 'o na ci zhe na/ ye sems sngon la bskyed kyang ye shes 'beb pa na snying ga'i nang du 'jam dpal gzhon nu zhes 'byung ba ltar 'dir yang snying gi nang gi dbus su ye sems bskyed nas slar thugs kar thugs rdo rje bskyed pa'i tshe/ ye sems nang du chud par byas nas snying rang gi ngo bo thugs rdo rjer bskyed pa yin pas thugs rdo rje'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' 'byung ba yin no// de rnams kyi thugs kar yang rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'khor lo la sogs pa rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/

de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra wa maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra wa maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra puṣ+pe ā hūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke badz+ra ghan+dhe/ badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ/ rnams nas/ ā hūm̐/ sbyar nas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra mud+ga ra dza/ zhes pas shar gyi sgo ba las lcags kyu'i 'od byung ye shes pa dam tshig pa'i spyi bor spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ḍaṇ+ṭa hūm̐ḥ zhes pas lho'i sgo ba la zhags pa lta bu'i 'od byung bas gnyis su med par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra pad+ma baṃḥ zhes pas nub kyi sgo ba las lcags sgrogs lta bu'i 'od byung bas chu la chu 'dres pa lta bur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kharka hoḥ zhes byang gi sgo ba la dril bu lta bu'i 'od byung ba mnyes te bzhu bar bsam/ lcags kyu zhags pa sogs kyi phyag rgyar bcas pas dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang skur gyi lha rigs lnga yum bzhi/ sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ rig pa'i lha mo drug dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañca ku la sa pā ri wā ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sogs lngas mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis/ /khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum bzhis bum pa thogs te dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo bcus bgegs bskrad/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta u da ka a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/

zhes dbang bskur bas chu rgyun spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ rkang mthil yan chad gang / lus ngag yid gsum dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las dbang rtags su gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ gti mug gshin rje gshed tsa rtsi ka tho ba gshin rje gshed yab yum rnam par snang mdzad/ shar phyogs pa'i lha rnams la rgyas btab kyi skabs su rwa los 'di bzhin gsungs pas 'og ma rnams la rigs 'gre sbyar ba skabs su bab cing 'grel chags par sems so/ /ser sna gshin rje gshed/ phag mo/ dbyug pa gshin rje gshed yab yum rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed/ dbyangs can ma/ pad+ma gshin rje gshed yab yum rnams la 'od dpag med/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed/ gau rī/ ral gri gshin rje gshed yab yum rnams la don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya waka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo bdag yin no snyam du nga rgyal bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa bya ste/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams spros te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la mchod par bsam ste/ stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag na/ /dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba yi/ /khrag zhags ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs la/ /gus pas sems kyis bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas kyang / /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don/ /ma lus par ni 'grub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra wa maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ rwa chen gyi zhabs bsil gyi sngags gsungs pa dang / tshar chen lhan thabs las gnas yo byin rlabs kyi skabs su'ang zhabs bsil gsungs par dpag na/

tshigs bcad kyi skabs su/ khrag zhag zhabs bsil la sogs pa'i/ /zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /zhes dgos rgyur snang yang / da lta ngag 'don la ni mchod yon gyi rjes su me tog yod do/ /gzhan rnams 'dra ba la/ dbang po lnga yi puṣ+pe sogs/ /me tog ji snyed yod pa dang / /puṣ+pe tshil chen dhup+pe la sogs pa/ /bdug spos /dhup+pe zhun chen dī paṃ la sogs pa/ /snang gsal /ā lo ke mkhris pa'i ghan+dhe la sogs pa/ /dri mchog /ghan+dhe sha rus bza' ba la sogs pa/ /zhal zas /nai wi d+ye rkang dung gling bu la sogs pa/ /rol mo /shap+ta zhes pa'i tshig rnams kyis mchod/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /ma lus gshin rje gshed la bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes nas bla med dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra wa maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wā ra ru pa pū tsa āḥhūm̐/ gzugs rdo rje mas mchod/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /ma lus /bzhes nas /shap+ta pū tsa āḥhūm̐/ sgra rdo rje mas/ phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang / /a kar la sogs dbang po tshim byed pa/ /ma lus /bzhes nas /ghan+dhe pū tsa āḥhūm̐/ dri rdo rje mas mchod/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems tshim byed ro mchog thams cad kyang / /ma lus /bzhes nas /ra sa pū tsa āḥhūm̐/ ro rdo rje mas/ phyogs dus kun nas 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed pa/ /ma lus /bzhes /par+she pū tsa āḥhūm̐/ zhes reg rdo rje mas mchod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra wa maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wā ra dharma dha tu a kā sha ya ho/ zhes chos rdo rje mas mchod/ de rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ lag g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyi/ /steng du g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma bzhag /sor mo brkyang ba gzugs kyi'o/

/pi waṃ 'dren tshul sgra yi ste/ /lag g.yon dri yi dung chos dang / /g.yas pas dbyug tshul dri yi'o/ /rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i/ /snyim pa ro mchog 'bul ba'i steng / /na bza' 'bul tshul reg bya dang / /thal sbyar so so'i mtheb mdzub sbyar/ /dbyings las chos 'byung phyag rgya'o/ /de nas mchod pa'i glu blangs te/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang / /shel la mtshon ni ji bzhin no/ /'dod yon lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho rol du gsol/ /mnyes par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol bar mdzod/ /reg bya 'gags pa med pa la/ /mi g.yo bzhin du rol bar mdzod/ /ho/ chags pa med bzhin chags par mdzod/ /de nas mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnams mi dmigs par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa ni mchod pa'o/ /tshigs su bcad pa rnams kyi tshe thal mo sbyar zhing / sngags la slob pa na pad kor sngon du 'gro bas so so'i phyag rgya mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas pa bya/ gzugs sgra sogs yid las byung ba'i mchod pa'i glu blang ba la rol chen bya/ de nas 'khor rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu gtso bo la bstod par bsam zhing / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur ston pa'i/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun 'jigs khyod la bstod/ /mi thung sgeg pa sprin lta'i mdog /'od zer 'phro ba rnam par bzhengs/ /mtshan ma legs po ma he'i zhal/ /'jigs mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni ma he khros/ /bar pa srin po khros dmar zhal/ /steng ma gser mdog 'jam dbyangs zhal/ /sngon po dmar po ser po la/

/dkar po dud kha nag pos te/ /zhal dgu ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug 'dzin/ /gnyis pas mtshon rtse gcig pa 'dzin/ /gsum pa'i phyag gis gtun shing 'dzin/ /bzhi pa chu gri bzang po 'dzin/ /lnga pas rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ /drug pa na ni satwa re ste/ /bdun pa'i phyag gis mdung thung 'dzin/ /brgyad pa yis ni mda' 'dzin cing / /dgu pa'i phyag gis lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bcu pa'i phyag gis dbyug tho 'dzin/ /bcu gcig pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bcu gnyis pa yis 'khor lo 'dzin/ /bcu gsum pa yis rdo rje 'dzin/ /bcu bzhis rdo rje tho ba 'dzin/ /bco lnga dgra gsod ral gri 'dzin/ /bcu drug pa na cang te'u 'dzin/ /de ltar 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag 'dzin/ /gnyis pas tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin/ /gsum pas shes rab phub chung 'dzin/ /bzhi pas bsgrub bya'i rkang pa 'dzin/ /lnga pas rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin/ /drug pas gzhu 'dzin thabs kyi don/ /bdun pas nyon mongs rgyu ma 'dzin/ /brgyad pas shes rab dril bu 'dzin/ /dgu pas brdeg don lag pa 'dzin/ /bcu pas 'bri don dur khrod ras/ /skyes bu gsal shing bcu gcig pa/ /bcu gnyis bsreg don me thab 'dzin/ /bcu gsum pa yis thod tshal 'dzin/ /bcu bzhis sdigs mdzub sdigs par mdzad/ /bco lngas 'phan rtse dug gsum 'joms/ /bsgrub bya rlung bskur bcu drug ras/ /tha ma'i phyag gnyis glang chen gyi/ /ko rlon brgyangs pa na bzar gsol/ /yon tan 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi dang ma he glang bong bu/ /rnga mong khyi lug wa dang brgyad/ /'di brgyad g.yas pa'i thabs brgyad kyis/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i steng nas gnon/ /nad brgyad 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bya rgod 'ug pa khwa ne tso/ /khra dang khyung dang ri skegs bzhad/ /'di brgyad g.yon pa'i zhabs brgyad kyis/ /khyab 'jug drag po'i steng nas gnon/ /gdon brgyad 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/

/dur khrod chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan/ /gzhal yas me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /'jigs mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brgya phyed mgo bo'i do shal byas/ /dbu la thod skam lnga lngas brgyan/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /zhal dgu ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan mig nyi shu rtsa bdun dmar/ /ljags 'dril zhal nas ha ha bzhad/ /mtshan dang dpe byad yang dag ldan/ /ma he'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /gzhan yang gang rung gis bstod/ gtso bo'i 'khor rnams la bstod pa ni/ gti mug rdo rje rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po rab mtshungs pa/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phra ma rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /rdo rje'i sku dang rab ldan pa'i/ /rin chen rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed/ /rdo rje'i sku dang rab mtshungs pa/ /phyag na ral gri phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces rigs bzhi la bstod/ 'byung bzhi rnam dag tshad med bzhi/ /phrin las bzhi dang sku bzhir ldan/ /'gying bag ldan pa'i shes rab ma/ /mnyes mdzad yum bzhi'i sku la bstod/ /ces yum bzhi la bstod/ bdud bzhi sgrib pa bzhi skyong zhing / /lta ba bzhi las rnam grol ba/ /'gugs 'dzin 'ching sdom gzir byed pa'i/ /gshed po bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod do/ /de nas bstod yul/ bstod pa/ bstod mkhan gsum po mi dmigs par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū ti ra badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/ /dur khrod rgyan gyis/ zhes sogs gtso 'khor rnams kyi bstod pa la/ g.yas phyag 'tshal ba'i steng nas rdo rje bzung zhing /

g.yon pas dril bu tshigs bcad kyi mtshams su gsil/ mang na bdag bskyed kyi skabs su ting nge 'dzin gtso che bas/ mchod bstod la rol mo rnams ma byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /mnyes mchod ni/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te aṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa ze'u 'bru la aṃ gis mtshan pa/ gnyis ka'i bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas sgyu ma lta bu'i dga' ba'i sgra ha ha si si ku dhu ru zhes bsgrags pas mnyes par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swā bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing lag pa gnyis snying gar bsnol ba 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya bya/ de nas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa thogs la/ oṃ āḥbighān ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ oṃ swā bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dhar+m+ma swa bha wa shudho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa'i snod phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du dbus su na las mi'i sha shar du gau las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta yi sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha de rnams sbyong byed kyi yi ge dbus su ya/ shar du k+ṣe/ lhor ma/ nub tu me/ byang du da rnams bsam/ yang dbus su shu las byang chub kyi sems/ shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu mu las dri chu/ nub byang du ma las klad pa/ byang shar du ra las rak+ta/ de rnams sbyong byed kyi yi ge dbus su hūm̐/ shar lhor dzaḥ lho nub tu sa/ nub byang du do/ byang shar du ru rnams bsam/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/

rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ yi ge rnams zhu spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i tshul du chags pa'i lte ba la zhe sdang gshin rje gshed/ shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed/ lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed rnams rang rang gi yum dang bcas pa/ yab lnga yum lnga snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba sgyu ma lta bu'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud srog dag pa'i lam rdo rje'i rtse mo nas thon/ yum gyi mkhar babs rjes chags kyi mes yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i rdzas/ kha dog dri ro nus pa bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ lag pa g.yon g.yas gnyis ka bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams bstan/ de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis bdud rtsi 'thor zhing / mchod yul rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bar bsam/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsang sngags phyi nang gi yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dam can gshin rje rgyal po la sogs pa srung ma gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rigs drug thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas tshim par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rang gi lce thog myang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ bzlas pa byed par 'dod pas/ phreng ba byin rlabs ni/ phreng ba gsar pa yin na chu dang nang mchod kyis bkrus/ gu gul gyis bdug

chang la bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar bas byugs la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phreng rdog 'bru re re nas gzhal yas khang gi nang du rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gang rung du skad cig gis bskyed/ ces 'dam bdar gsungs pas/ 'dir de'i gsal byed cung zad bkod na phreng ba las sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ phreng ba mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las phreng rdog 'bru re re nas yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon sra zhing brtan pa'i sa gzhi/ khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil du/ kaṃ yongs su gyur pa las mi mgo skam po'i rwa ba zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba/ sgo gcig dang ldan pa/ steng keng rus kyis phub pa/ g.yang gzhi'i bla re dang / rgyu rlon gyi lda lde dang / rus pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ maṃ sngo nag yongs su gyur pa las ma he sngon po rus pa'i drwa bas rgyab g.yogs pa/ rmig pa 'bar bas sa rko ba/ rwa sngon po gdengs pa/ sma ra rno zhing me lce 'gyur ba/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed gcer bu sku mdog mthing ga ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can/ rwa sngon po rno zengs pa la rus pa'i rgyan khrol ba/ pheṃ zhes pa'i sgra sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mtshan ma gyen du 'greng ba/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing / thod pa rlon pa dang sbrul gyi 'phyang 'phrul byas pa/ khrag gi thig le dang / zhag gi zo ris dang / thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/

zhabs g.yas bskum pas ma he'i rwa bar dang / g.yon brkyang bas tshang ra'i steng nas brdzis pa mi'i khrag dang tshil dang zhag la dges pa/ khams gsum za bar nus pa/ de rnams kyi mig tu k+ṣiṃ/ rna bar dziṃ/ snar khaṃ/ lcer gaṃ dpral ba thakaṃ/ lte ba saṃ/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par thim/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ra ud da ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chus lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ de rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mi mgo rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa'i phreng ba bsgrang ba tsam gyis las thams cad thogs med du 'grub pa'i nus ldan du bsam la hrīḥṣ+ṭi brgya rtsa brgyad dang / oṃ pa de pa de ma hā dz+nyā naṃ sarba bud+dha ma yaṃ bhā wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes nyer gcig gis byin brlabs/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ni/ pra warta ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'ang ci rigs pa bzlas pas/ phan yon 'bum du 'gro bar bshad do/ /dus rgyun pa la ni thun gyi 'gor/ byin rlabs dran pa tsam bya ba'o/ /'grub na rgyas pa byas la/ sngags gsum po bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa bzla'o/ /sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ mthe bong rdo rje lcags kyu/ dngos grub thams cad bkug nas rang la thim par bsam zhing phreng ba bgrang ngo / /bzlas dus kyi dmigs pa ni/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing kha de'i mtha' mar nye snying snying po rtsa sngags kyi phreng ba rnams kha dog mthing kha rang sgra sgrog cing 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba la sems gtad/ de dag las me rlung gi khrod na rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku phra mo grangs med pa 'phros/ ma he'i zhal gyi shangs bug g.yas nas phyir 'thon/

byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas/ de thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ 'od zer sku dang bcas pa tshur 'dus/ shangs bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ sngags phreng rnams la thim par bsam/ 'di ni thun mong gi dmigs pa yin/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i thugs kar thugs rdo rje/ de'i thugs kar rgyu'i 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa/ de'i lte bar 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa khog stong gur stabs su yod pa de'i nang steng 'og tu pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa gnyis kha sbyor du yod pa'i 'dab ma brgyad/ rtsibs brgyad kyi nang du son pa/ 'og gi pad+ma'i lte bar rang gi rnam shes dang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi thugs dbyer med pa'i hūm̐ yig mthing nag gsal zhing dwangs la 'od zer 'phro ba gyen du langs pa'i rnam pa can/ de'i mthar mdun nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du/ oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ de'i phyi rol du/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bskor ba/ phyogs mtshams kyi pad 'dab rnams kyi nang gi bar snang la/ shar du ya ma ra dzaḥ shar lhor sa do me ya/ lhor ya mo do ru/ lho nub tu ṇa yo da ya/ nub tu ya da yo ni/ nub byang du ra ya k+ṣe ya/ byang du ya k+ṣe yats+tsha/ byang shar du ni ra ma ya/ zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi po re re'i steng du/ oṃ dang / zhabs su hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyi nang gi yig 'bru thams cad kha dog mthing nag 'od 'bar zhing rang sgra sgrog pa/ de dag las me rlung gi khrod nas/ zhes sogs thun mong ba ltar bsgom mo/ /thugs ka'i sngags 'khor gyi gdams ngag 'di med par snying kar bsgom pa na tshe srog la gnod cing / smyo 'bog la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa byung bar gsungs pas 'di bsgom pa shin tu gal che'o/

/bzlas dmigs gong ltar na'ang sngags gsum po rim pas bzla/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ so so'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon dang sngags kyis bskor ba las/ 'od zer spro bsdu sngar bzhin byas nas sngags bzla/ de la bsnyen pa'i tshad ni/ ya man+ta ka drug 'bum/ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ gsum 'bum/ ya ma rā dzaḥ 'bum tsho gcig te 'di gsum gang mos pa bzlas pa'o/ /lha gzhan rnams kyi sngags kyang ci nus bzlas te/ oṃ dzi na dzika hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na dhṛka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a ro lika hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pradz+nyā dh+ṝka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mo ha ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dwe ṣa ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rā ga ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mud+ga ra dhṛka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṇ+ḍa dh+ṝka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma dh+ṝka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kharga dh+ṝka hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bzlas pa'i mthar/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang / phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob cing / gnas skabs su las bzhi'i phrin las thams cad 'bad med du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang / oṃ shrī ya man+ta ka sa ma ya/ zhes sogs gshin rje gshed kyi yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum bzlas pas byin brlabs brtan par byas/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rang gi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang du gyur pa rnams 'od du zhu nas rang gi sgom pa'i gzhal yas khang dur khrod bsrung 'khor dang bcas pa la thim/ srung 'khor mi bsdu bar bzhag dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang dang bcud kyi sems can/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs su gyur pa rnams 'od du zhu nas 'khor gyi lha rnams la thim/ 'khor gyi lha rnams yum la yum yab yab kyi zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim pas rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gyur/

zhes brjod nas rwa chen dang mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags mngon rdzogs chen por dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i skabs/ bsnyen pa lha yi bsdu tshul tsam bshad nas/ srung 'khor dur khrod dang gzhal yas khang gang la bsdu yi gsal kha mi gnang zhing / gnyis kyi dgongs pa dang shin tu mthun te/ dkyil 'khor bsdu tshul 'di bzhin ngag dbang chos grags bzhed cing / rwa chen ltar na gong tshogs zhing spyan 'dren/ zhabs lhag ma'ang / bsdus nas zhabs gnyis pa yin/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ mngon rtogs chen mor rten gyi bsdu tshul mi snang ba ni yi ge nas cung zad chad pa las 'os med pas da lta lag len ni/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang bcud thams cad lhar bltas nas bdag gi bsgom pa'i rten dang brten pa so sor thim/ rten bsrung khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang rnams 'khor rnams la thim/ 'khor rnams yum la/ yum rnams yab la/ yab thugs ka'i 'jam dpal la bsdu ba sogs bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ yab thugs ka'i 'jam dpal la bsdu ba sogs ni nyal ba'i sbyor la dgos so/ /'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsungs pa 'di thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal la dgos par sems so/ /mthong thos rgyud gzhung bsdu pa'i e ran+d+ra/ /yid 'ong lo 'dab bye bas g.yur zar yang / /dngos grub snying po'i dga' ston smig rgyu'i chus/ /dad ldan tsha gdung sel bar ga la nus/ /brgyud ldan bar ma chod pa'i yongs 'du'i shing / /bsre lhad rang bzos dben pa'i 'bab stegs las/ /'ongs pa'i gsang chen bdud rtsi'i mchod sbyin gyis/ /skal bzang snying la 'dod 'jo'i dpal rab ster/ /de phyir dus dgra'i ded dpon ma he'i zhal/ /sgrub thabs rgyal bal mkhas pa'i zhal kyi bcud/ /rwa chen la ci'i gsung rgyun ma nyams pa/ /'di 'dra nyams len rnal 'byor skal ba bzang / /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gtor ma sta gon dngos ni/ de nas sgrub khang gi phyi rol lam/

yol ba'i phyi rol la sogs pa sar/ drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa'i gtor ma 'og nas 'byung ba ltar btang / nang du log te rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal /sangs rgyas dges pa khyod la /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la /sangs rgyas bzhad pa khyod la /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal /med pa las byung khyod la /sangs rgyas byung ba khyod la /nam mkha' las byung khyod la /ye shes las byung khyod la /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khyod la /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la /thams cad thams cad khyod la /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /ces 'dud bstod lan gsum bya'o/ /'di ni gtor ma sta gon zhes bya ba rwa chen gyi dkyil chog na gsal bar bzhugs pas nges par bya dgos kyang / kha cig la de dgos pa'i the tshom tsam yang ma skyes shing / kha cig gi sngon 'gro gtor ma go ba sogs ni/ rwa lugs kyi yig cha la ma sbyangs shing rnam par 'khyams par shes par bya'o/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi phyi rol du btang nas nang du rdo rje dril bu 'dzin bzhin pas 'jam dpal mtshan brjod nas 'byung 'dud nyi shus/ bstod par byed 'di'i bstod yul ci zhig yin/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ bdag bskyed rdzogs mtshams dang sta gon gyi bar 'dir phyi rol gtor ma nges par ma chad par bya dgos pa tshar chen rdo rje 'chang bzhed pa ni rwa chen gyi dgongs pa rma med pa yin la/ de ltar phyi rol pa tshar nas nang du dpon slob rnams dril gsil dang bcas 'dud kyi bstod pa byas pa na bstod yul de ci yin/ mdun gyi tshom bu sogs ni lhar bskyed ma tshar bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs yang ni sngar bsdus zin pas ji ltar yin snyam na/

cung zad bden mod kyang 'di'i bstod yul ni rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sprul gzhi 'phags pa 'jam dpal nyid mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis bsams nas gus 'dud byed pa yin la/ de'i dgos pa yang gtor ma tshar rjes su rgyab brten gyi rim gro bsod nams gsog cing / lha la gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir rgyas par na mtshan brjod rang 'don/ bsdu na 'dud kyi bstod pa bya ba 'di skabs su bab cing 'grel chags pa yin no/ /'og dngos gzhi'i skabs su yang 'dud nyi shu'i bstod yul mdun gyi nam mkhar 'jam dpal bsam pa nyid yin pas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la ma 'khrul ba nyid gal che'o/ /gnyis pa sta gon ni/ tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo gos dkar po can dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa khas len pa la nye bar 'jog pa'i phyag rgya/ g.yon pas bum pa 'dzin pa/ sku lte ba yan chad thon pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas sa 'og nas sa yi lha mo badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ zhes brjod cing sor mo gsum sa la brdabs pa'i phyag rgya bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes brjod cing / nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rigs lnga'i lha tshogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wi lo ki tā ra ye ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ la sogs pa phyag rgyar bcas pa dang / shap+ta'i skabs su rol chen bya/ gong gi sngags kyi mjug tu/ 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ a kā ro nas/ na twat+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bar lan gsum dang / rdo rje bsdom pa'i phyag rgyas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/

oṃ pṛ thi wi lo ki tā ra ye i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi/ zhes rdor thal kha phye'i phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtogs pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ rdo rje snying kar phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs kas bzung / tshigs bcad kyi mtshams su dril bu gsil zhing / gser mdog sa yi lha mo ni/ /pad+ma la gnas mdangs dang ldan/ /bum pa mdun na lag gnyis kyis/ /bdud tshul 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ spos rdol dril dang bcas pas/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyobs pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / zhes pa nas/ dbang blang bar 'tshal na sa yi phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba sbyin par bsam lag pa g.yas pa sa la reg ste/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas/ sa yi lha mo sa de nyid la thim par bsam/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya sa la reg cing / oṃ badz+ra bhā wa hūm̐ gsum/ rdo rje bsdoms pa'i phyag rgya sa la reg cing / oṃ badz+ra daṣ+ṭi tiṣ+ṭha/ gsum/ sa phyogs thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces brjod do/ /gsum pa lha sta gon ni/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ zhes pa nas/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar gyur gyi bar/ de'i dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du kun tu bzang po/ zhes pa nas/ sgo bzhir pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan/ ces pa'i bar/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa las rgyu'i 'jam dpal/

zhes pa nas/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams 'dus 'od kyi gong bu la phog pa'i rkyen gyis/ zhes dang / phyag mtshan gyi bye brag dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te hūm̐ la phog pa'i rkyen gyis/ zhes dang / tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog char sprin gyi mdog ltar gnag cing nam mkha'i 'od ltar gsal ba/ zhes dang / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i ba spu'i bu ga ji snyed yod pa nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skur gyur te gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rlung dang ro mgo med lag med dang / pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la thim par gyur/ zhes bdag mdun gyi tshig 'di tsam gyi khyad ma gtogs gzhan tshang ma bdag bskyed sor bzhag bsgoms nas/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ rdo rje dril bu dang spos 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ 'jam dbyangs khros pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /srin po'i gzugs su sku sprul pa/ /gdug pa can kun 'dul ba'i phyir/ /'jigs pa'i khro rgyal gshegs su gsol/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /khro bo gshin rje gshed po'i tshogs/ /'jam dpal khro bo mi bzad pa/ /mthu rtsal drag pos 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ hrīḥha bho ma hā kro dhā a gats+tsha a gats+tsha asmad pū dza pra ti gṛh+ṇan+tu pra sa ri me dhi man ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dril gsil me tog 'thor bzhin pas/ 'dir bzhugs 'dir bzhugs 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /khro bo gshin rje gshed po'i tshogs/ /'jam dpal khro bo mi bzad pa/ /mthu rtsal drag pos 'dir bzhugs shig /pad+ma ka ma la ya staṃ/

zhes pas gdan dbul/ oṃ shrī bhai ra wa maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ ral gri gshin rje gshed yab yum la don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ nga rgyal bzung ba'i sngags mi dgos/ 'dir kha cig gis lha rnams snying po tshig tsam las bskyed pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis rdo rje cho ga gsum las bskyed pa sogs ni rwa chen gyi dgongs pa ma yin te/ de nyid kyi dkyil chog gi yi ge las/ de nas bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal gyis/ mdun du lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs rgyas pa ltar bsgom zhes gsungs pa'i skabs kyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa rwa chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs 'di la ngos 'dzin rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dkyil chog las lha rnams rang rang gi sngags brjod cing me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ ces pa ni/ thog mar tshom bu bkod pa'i skabs kyi ngag 'don la dgongs pa yin pas gzu bor gnas pa'i sems kyis zhib tu dpyad par rigs so/ /de nas gtso bo'i sngags gsum dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha so so'i sngags rnams lan gsum re tsam bzlas pa ni don gyi sngags mchod lta bur snang la/ de'ang dkyil chog las gong du smos pa bzhin/ lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs rgyas pa ltar sgom bzlas pa dang lha re re bzhin mchod pa rgyas pa dang / dngos su mchod bstod bya/ zhes gsungs pas nges par ma chad par bya'o/ /de nas mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa bsangs sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i khrag chen po'i ar+ghaṃ/ zhes pa nas/ rkang gling gi rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na/ /zhes sogs nyer spyod rol mor bcas pa'i rjes su/ g.yang gzhi bla re nam 'di nas nang mchod mdor bsdus su 'bul ba'i bar ḍā ma ru rgyun chags dril bu sum rdung byed/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyi sngags rnams gong gnas yo byin rlabs dang mi 'dra bas 'chugs so snyam na ma yin te/ mchod sngags rgyas bsdus kyi khyad tsam las khyad par med do// mkha'i rgyan/ /rgyu rlon lda lde bar snang rgyan/ /keng rus phreng ba sa gzhi'i rgyan/ /phyag rgya rnam drug sku yi rgyan/ /'jigs byed chen po mnyes byed pa'i/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / /zhes sogs sngags kyi rjes su/ gu h+ya laṃ kṛ te āḥhūm̐/ zhes rgyan gyi mchod pa dang / myos byed stong gi bcud bsdus pa/ /lcags kyu lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang rab sbyar ba/ /ye shes lnga yis byin brlabs pa/ /dngos grub pad+mo 'byung ba'i gnas/ /mkha' 'gro bung ba 'du ba'i gzhi/ /gsang ba bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di/ /bcom ldan sogs sngags kyi mjug tu/ a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod mdor bsdus kyang phul/ 'di dang rwa chen gyis drag po'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge las bshad do/ /kha dog dbyibs legs sogs 'dod yon lnga/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ /sogs yid byung gi mchod pa/ dur khrod rgyan gyi sogs bstod pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ snyoms 'jug gi mnyes mchod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing 'khyud rgya bya/ nang gi mchod pa ni/ mchod bstod gnyis la'ang nga rgyal bzung ba'i sngags mi dgos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas byin rlabs dran par bya/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod 'thor zhing /

dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rdo rje ro langs ma/ grub chen la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa'i dpal/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra rak+ṣi ta/ rā lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags pa/ rā chos rab/ rā ye shes seng ge rā 'bum seng / rje btsun rga lo/ /rong pa shes rab seng ge bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang / chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang / 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ chos rje grags pa dpal/ kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang chen po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje nam mkha' brtan pa/ rje btsun dam pa kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang / bla ma dbang phyug grags/ ldong ston shes rab dpal/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ shar gling pa rgyal mtshan bzang po/ sgo rum pa dkon mchog rgya mtshan/ bla ma tshul khrims rgya mtshan/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal ba/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ sngags 'chang 'jigs med dpa' bo/ bla ma bsod nams mchog ldan/ drin chen tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen bslab gsum dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rmor chen chos kyi rgyal po/ kun dga' lhun grub/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal gnas gsar pa chen po 'jam mgon bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnang ba'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥsogs/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sogs/ oṃ dzi na dzika hūm̐ phaṭa nas/ oṃ kharga dh+ṝka hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyi bar lha bcu gsum gyi sngags tshang bar brjod pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gsang sngags phyi nang gi yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas bar phud blangs la/ rang gi lce rtse smin mtshams spyi bo rnams su thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lus kyi lha mchod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi ye/ dharmā pā la tsa turmu kha sa pā ri wā ra/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gdong bzhi pa sogs dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ kā la rū pa hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong ba'i bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ 'jigs byed dgu ste gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ mkha' 'gro/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig

de nas rang gis myong la/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas spos bzung / g.yon pas dril bu gsil/ gzhan rnams kyis me tog bzung zhing rol mo dang bcas pas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyod rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /bcom ldan 'das la bdag gus pas/ /bka' drin zhu bas gnang ba dang / /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang / /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang / /sngags kyi lha gzhan gang lags dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ni rig pa 'dzin pa yis/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor chen po'i ming / /rdo rje 'jigs byed ces bya ba/ /cho ga bzhin du bgyid lags na/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas ni/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /re re'i mthar me tog 'thor zhing rol chen dang bcas pa lan gsum brjod/ bzhi pa bum pa sta gon la/ rgyas par ni rwa lo'i dbang chu las/ lha bum bcu gsum/ rnam rgyal dang / las thams cad pa'i bum pa dang bco lnga/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab cing bgegs bskrad/ bum pa bcu gsum la lha rang rang gi mtshan ma 'god/ rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ las bum la rdo rje rgya gram bri/ ras kha tshar ma nyams pas mgul chings srog lnga'am bdun bya/ chu gtsang ma srog chags med pa dang / sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ spos lnga/ rin po che lnga/ snying po lnga/ dri lnga la sogs pa blugs/ ku sha'am/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha rgyan dang / steng nas sku tsa ka li dang gdugs la sogs pas brgyan/

kha rgyan gseb tu dri'i dung zhal steng du rdo rje la gzungs thag btags la bzhag go /de nas/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis bum pa stong par bsgoms pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bzas mgul pa dkris pa/ phyi bum pa la/ nang gzhal yas khang gi rnam par bskyed/ lha bum bcu gsum du lha so sor bskyed/ rnam rgyal du lha tshang bar bsgom/ las bum du gtso bo phyag gnyis pa bsgom/ de nas ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa'i bar bya/ de nas gzungs thag bzung ste/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril bum pa'i nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas gang bar bsam zhing bzlas pa bya/ de nas mchod bstod byas la/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba'i chur gyur par bsams la/ dri'i dung chos bum par blug par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas 'di'i ngag 'don ni/ bsangs sbyangs nas bzung / dkris pa zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ phyi bum pa la nang gzhal yas khang gi rnam par gyur pa'i lha bum bcu gsum du lha so so'i gdan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zhes pa nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ gtso bum dang rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa/ zhes sogs kyis gtso bo yab yum bskyed pa nas bzung / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad drangs/ zhes pa'i bar gong bdag bskyed bzhin la/ yab yum gnyis kyi zhal nas zhugs thugs ka nas srog dag pa'i lam nas brgyud so so'i yum gyi mkhar babs pas thig le bcu gnyis su gyur/ sogs 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ shar bum dang rnam rgyal bum pa'i shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed sogs/ lho bum dang rnam rgyal bum pa'i lhor/

ser sna gshin rje gshed/ sogs 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre shes par byas la/ rigs bzhi dang yum bzhi bskyed/ sgo ba bzhi bskyed pa'i skabs kyang / shar bum dang rnam rgyal bum pa'i shar/ sogs phyogs gong bzhin shes par byas la bskyed/ las bum bskyed chog nas bzung gzhan tshang ma 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ lha bum so so'i rnam rgyal bum pa la dmigs nas gtso sngags gsum/ brgya rtsa re dang 'khor sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla ba sogs ni 'og nas bshad pa bzhin gyi go chod do/ /mthar mchod yon 'bul ba'i tshe bum pa thams cad la thigs pa re blug go /bsdu na tshar chen rin po che'i lhan thabs las/ dkyil chog gi bum pa bco lngar bshad kyang deng sang lag len la/ rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis su bsdu bar mdzad pas/ de gnyis sum cha man chad chu gtsang mas dgang / mgul chings kha rgyan/ lha mtshan sogs tshul bzhin bshams/ de'i nang du sle tres/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ shu dag dkar po/ rgya mtsho'i lbu ba/ dbang lag ste sman lnga/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ gla rtsi/ gur gum/ ga pur/ dzā ti ste dri lnga/ gser/ dngul/ byu ru/ mu ti mug men ste rin po che lnga/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ so ba/ til dkar po ste 'bru lnga/ lan tshwa/ bu ram/ 'o ma/ mar/ sbrang rtsi ste snying po lnga/ bdud rtsi ril bu mtshan ldan la bdud rtsi lnga tshang bas de rnams blug go /de lta bu'i rnam rgyal bum pa g.yas dang / las bum g.yon du bkod pa'i rnam rgyal gyi steng dung chos gzungs thag dang bcas pa'ang lag len ltar bzhag bsangs sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa ring ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bzas mgul pa dkris pa/ phyi bum pa la nang gzhal yas khang gi rnam par gyur pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ de'i phyir rol gyi shar dang grwa bzhir pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/

lho nub gnyis dang sgo bzhir pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ nang gi byang du pad+ma dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa rwa gdengs pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog char sprin gyi mdog ltar gnag cing / zhes pa nas/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka nas srog dag pa'i lam nas brgyud/ yum gyi mkhar babs pas thig le bcu gnyis su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i lha bcu gnyis su gyur te/ yum gyi pad+ma nas phyir 'thon nas gdan so so'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba/ zhes sogs nas/ thams cad kyang thod pa dang sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar/ las thams cad pa'i bum par paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du maṃ sngo nag yongs su gyur pa las/ ma he sngon po rus pa'i drwa bas rgyab g.yogs pa/ rmig pa 'bar bas sa rko ba rwa sngon po gdengs pa/ sma ra rno zhing lce 'gyur ba/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros pas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje 'jigs byed gcer bu sku mdog mthing nag ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can/ rwa sngon po rno zengs pa la rus pa'i rgyan khrol ba/ phaiṃ zhes pa'i sgra sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa mtshan ma gyen du bsgrengs pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing / thod pa rlon pa dang sbrul gyi 'phyang 'phrul byas pa/ khrag gi thig le dang zhag gi zo ris dang /

thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas ma he'i rwa bar dang / g.yon brkyang bas tshang ra'i steng nas brdzis pa/ mi'i khrag dang tshil dang zhag la dges pa/ khams gsum za bar nus pa/ de thams cad kyi mig tu k+ṣiṃ dang 'khor lo las sa yi snying po/ rna bar dz+riṃ dang / rdo rje las phyag na rdo rje/ snar khaṃ dang rin po che las nam mkha'i snying po/ lcer gaṃ dang pad+ma las 'jig rten dbang phyug dpral bar thakaṃ dang ral gri las sgrib pa rnam sel/ lte bar rwa los mngon rtogs yid bzhin gter mdzod las/ lte bar saṃ dang 'khor lo las kun tu bzang po dkar po gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu zhes dang / yang mngon rtogs de nyid kyi gzhal yas khang gi 'og gzhi chos 'byung bskyed pa'i skabs su kun bzang dkar po rdor dril 'dzin par gsung zhing / tshar chen rin po che'i lhan thabs las skye mched byin rlabs skabs rdo rje 'byung bas 'khor rdor gang rung gis 'thus so snyam/ saṃ dang rdo rje las kun tu bzang po/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum kyi dkyil 'khor/ dpa' bo gcig pa dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mchod nas bstim/ dbang lha spyan drangs mchod dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba la/ ral gri gshin rje gshed yab yum rnams la don yod grub pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ces brjod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra wā maṇ+ḍal la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar brjod cing / lha sngags la pad kor/ mchod sngags la so so'i phyag rgya/ mthar se gol gtogs pa dang / shap+ta la rol chen bya/ yid 'byung / dur khrod rgyan gyi nas/ 'jigs mdzad sku la phyag mtshal lo/

/bar dang / gti mug rdo rje nas/ gshed po bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bar gyis bstod pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga sogs mnyes mchod rnams mdun bskyed ltar bya/ oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wa ri bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum dpa' bo gcig pa dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod dbul/ gzungs thag slob dpon gyis pad kor dang bcas pas blangs te/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ gtso bo'i sngags gsum po brgya rtsa re dang / 'khor rnams la rang rang gi sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs dang / las bum gyi lha la/ oṃ āḥbighān ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa brgyad bzla'o/ /de nas mchod bstod gong ltar byas/ dung chos kyi chu phul bas lha rnams 'od du zhu ba'i chur gyur par bsam/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum bzla'o/ /'di kha cig las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bgegs mthar bskyed sogs rwa lugs kyi dgongs pa yin min rwa chen gyi dkyil chog la gzigs par zhu/ bum bskyed kyi skabs su phyi bum pa la nang gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa rgyud gzhung nas ma bshad gsungs pa rnams/ slob dpon dha ri ka pa dang / pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta'i bde mchog gi rgya gzhung dang / dze ta ri'i tshe dpag med kyi rgya gzhung rnams la gzigs par zhu zhing / bod kyi sngags 'chang snga ma mang po phal cher kyang 'di ltar bzhed par snang / des na rig pa'i rgyal pos/ ma mthong phyir na med pa min/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang tshad mar bzung bar rigs so/ /lnga pa slob ma sta gon ni/ skabs su bab pa'i tshe/ rwa chen gyi yi ge gzhir bzhag la bla ma'i gsung sgros kyis brgyan nas/ bum bskyed skabs su chu nyid lhar bskyed dam/ yang na chu yi steng du lha so so/

/gdan dang bcas pa bskyed pa gang yin gyi/ /gsal kha'i yig cha tshad ma gzigs sam ci/ /bum pa'i nang du badz+ra bhai ra wa/ /sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /bskyed dang las bum ming 'dogs mi 'gal lam/ /las bum zhes pa'i nges tshig ji ltar yin/ /bum pa'i lha rnams yan lag bzhi rdzogs su/ /bsgrubs nas mchod bstod skabs su gtso bum gyi/ /lha rnams kun la bstod tshig bshad snang mod/ /las bum lha la bstod tshig gang yin cing / /lugs 'dir lha ni so so'i bum pa las/ /logs su rnam rgyal bshad 'di ji ltar yin/ /lha grangs dang mthun bum pa bshams pa'i tshe/ /gtso bum nyid la rnam rgyal mi zer ram/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ rwa lo chen pos phyi bum pa la nang gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i dus su lha gdan dang bcas pa bskyed nas/ bzlas pa dang mchod bstod tshar ba dang lha rnams 'od du zhu ba'i chur gyur par gsungs pas/ sngar chu lhar bskyed pa rnams phyis bzlas pa mchod bstod tshar ba dang 'od du zhu te/ chur gnas gyur pa dgongs bzhed yin par snang ngo / /bla med du bum pa sta gon gyi tshe chu lhar bskyed pa dang / mi bskyod pa chu dbang gi dbang rdzas sgrub pa'i tshe yang chu lhar bskyed pa la mkhas pa thams cad dgongs pa mthun pas so/ /las bum dang gtso bum la khyad par shin tu che ste 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo zhal phyag yongs rdzogs dang / las bum gyi lha de zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yin zhing / bgegs bsal ba dang dri ma 'khrud pa sogs kyi sgo nas las bum du bzhag go /las bum gyi lha la rdor sogs bum bskyed gzhan rnams nas 'byung ba bzhin zur bkod byas kyang skyon med la/ 'on kyang da lta dkyus la ma bshad pa 'di'ang chad skyon du mi 'gyur te/ gtso bstod kyi khongs su song ba lag len bsdus pa'i lugs so/ /rwa chen gyis bzhed pas rnam rgyal du lha tshang ma bskyed cing gtso bum du gtso bo rang bskyed pas rnam rgyal dang gtso bum gyi khyad par so sor nges par 'chad do/

/dper na kun rig tu rigs lnga so so'i bum pa lnga/ de'i steng du rnam rgyal dang drug bshad nas rnam rgyal du lha so bdun po tshang ma dang / rigs so so'i dbus kyi bum par gtso bo rnam snang dang / shar gyi bum par sbyong rgyal dang phyogs gzhan gsum du yang rgyal mchog rin po che sogs kyi lha de bskyed pa lta bu'o/ /lugs 'di la yang bum pa drug bshams pa'i tshe gtso bo bum pa dang rnam rgyal bum pa gnyis tha dad du nges pas 'di dang / rwa chen gyi bzhed srol gnyis sgo mthun par mngon no/ /bshad par bya'o/ /gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshul ni/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis ljags rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar bsam zhing / pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas pa byas la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba bighān sha truṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba ling ghṛh+na pa ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis gtso bo la dbul/ oṃ dzi na dzika hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na dh+ṝka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a ro lika hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pradz+nyā dh+ṝka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mo ha ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dwe ṣa rā ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rā ga ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rā ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ murga ra dh+ṝka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṇ+ḍa dh+ṝka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+madh+ṝka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kharga dh+ṝka hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba bigh+nān sha truṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ ghṛh+ṇa pa ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'khor rnams la dbul/ oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra wa maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis spyi mchod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra bhai ra wa maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi 'thor zhing nang mchod dbul/

yang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang 'khyud rgyas mnyes mchod dang / de nas ḍā ma ru dang dril bu sogs rol chen bya zhing / gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ /zhes sogs yid byung dang / dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i nas/ 'jigs mdzad sku la phyag mtshal lo/ /bar gyis gtso bstod bsdus pa dang / gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /sogs 'khor gyi bstod pa dang / gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis phrin las bcol ba rnams bya/ yi dam chos skyong gzhan la 'bul bar 'dod na'ang / rang rang gi gzhung bzhin du bya/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥs byin gyis brlabs/ mdun du chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba mu khyud dang bcas par gyur/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bca' ba nas bzung bkug te bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ phyogs mtshams kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad du 'khod pa ni/ shar du brgya byin/ zhes pa nas/ rlung ras 'dzin pa'o/ /bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin la shar nub la g.yas g.yon gyi 'dab ma'i khyad par mi dgos/ steng du zla ba dkar po zhes dang / 'og tu tshangs pa gdong bzhi/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur gzhan thams cad 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /gi bar bya zhing / gtor sngags ni gsum sogs ci rigs so/ /las gshin gyi gtor chog bsdus pa ni/ sngar bzhin phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gi phung po chen por gyur/ mdun du pad+ma dang nyi ma dang ma he'i steng du ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus thod dbyug la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las las kyi gshin rje nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ma he'i gdong pa can/

dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas thod dbyug dang / g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dbu skra khams pa gyen du brdzes pa/ ling ga dmar po gyen du langs pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ gshin rje'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og 'jigs rung gshin rje'i grong khyer/ lcags mkhar sgo med mun khang nag po nas/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ kā la rū pa sā pa ri wā ra e h+ya hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha gshin rje gshed rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ra u da kā a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan/ lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa'i srin lag gnyis gshibs te brkyang ba dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang / oṃ kā la ru pa sa ma ya satwaṃ gyis dam la bzhag g.yas khro bo'i sdigs mdzub dang g.yon mchod pa so so dang gtor 'bul gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ kā la rū pa ghṛh+ne daṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ kā la rū pa sarba bigh+nan sha truṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+na sa ma ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum lam bdun gyis gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ kā la rū pa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod 'thor/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje nag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa rnams dang / 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyong / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen sol mthun rkyen sgrubs/ bdag la sdang zhing gdug pa'i sems 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad da lta nyid du bsad cing bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod la thal mo lan gsum brdab/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas bstod cing bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ 'chi bdag nag po lho phyogs kyi/ /rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas/ /srog la rngam pa'i gshin rje ni/ /nag po ma he'i gdan steng du/ /ya las byung ba'i dbyug pa ni/ /thod pas mtshan pa las byung ba/ /gting nas khros pa ma he'i gdong / /za byed zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /khros pas spyan rtsa dmar po 'khrugs/ /skra ser sma ra gyen du brdzes/ /lag g.yon zhags pas dgra bgegs chings/ /lag g.yas dbyug pas rdul du rlog /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i tshogs/ /bran dang bcas pa'i dus la babs/ /sha chen khrag zhag chen po yi/ /gtor ma rgya mtsho mchod par bzhes/ /rgyal bas bsgos pa'i dam tshig dang / /snying rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ /zung zhig chings shig rnam par sdoms/ /khug cig drongs shig dbang du bsdus/ /sod cig skrod cig brlag par gyis/ /chod cig gnon cig rmugs par gyis/ /thul cig choms shig rnam par shig /rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod/ /oṃ kā la rū pa dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod par bya'o/ /de nas des khas blangs par bsam mo/ /mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs ni spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /tshogs byed par spro na/ rwa chen gyi gzhung las tshogs gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la dkyil 'khor la skal ba gcig drangs/ phud la gtor ma gcig bca'/ tshogs la longs spyad/

de nas lhag ma bsdus la/ sngar phud la bshams pa'i gtor ma chang zan gsum byin gyis brlabs pa mtshungs/ oṃ ha ri ti piṇ+ḍa ka pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes brjod pas 'phrog ma la zan gsum gyi gtor ma sbyin/ oṃ hū ti ke a gha gra pa pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas chang phud kyi gtor ma phul lo/ /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi u tiṣ+ṭha bha liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swāhā/ zhes pas lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la gtor ma 'bul lo zhes gsungs pa bzhin bya'o/ /de nas sta gon gyi rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa rnams gsar pa spo ba'am/ kha gso ba gang yang rung ba byas la/ bsang sbyangs byin rlabs bsdus pa bya/ phyi mchod yid byung bstod pa/ mnyes mchod/ nang mchod rnams bum bskyed ltar bya/ 'on kyang / dpa' bo gcig pa/ zhes mi dgos/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ yig brgya tshar gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang / zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bzod gsol bya ba'am/ gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i/ zhes sogs tshig lhug bcas brjod kyang chog lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur kha gyen du bstan pa'i mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse sbyar la smin mtshams kyi thad kar 'ded pa'i tshul du byas la/ hūm̐ badz+ra ud tiṣ+ṭha/ sta gon gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad sang nyin spyan ma drangs kyi bar du nam mkha'i khams 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ slar yang sngar ltar mchod bstod rnams bya/ rten gzhan rnams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

bye brag tu yang gnas khang 'di nyid du bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog dang bcas pas brtan bzhugs bya/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod cing lag pa kha phyir bltas te bsnol ba'i mtheb srin gyis se gol gtogs nas/ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bdag la thim/ bdag gi mig tu sa yi snying po nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje/ 'gro ba thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'jam dpal khro bo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /ces sogs dang / bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /gdul dka' 'dul byed dpa' bo yis/ /shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis/ /ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog /bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /sogs/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /nas/ kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /bar tshar gsum/ bdag kyang sangs rgyas nas/ bstan la bya ba byed par shog /bar tshar gcig lha mo tshad ma sogs/ sta gon gyi nyin bkra shis bsdus pa 'di bya ste/ gar dbang rdo rje 'chang dang bai ta li/ /rol pa'i rdo rje don yod ye 'byung sbas/ /pad+ma badz+ra bal po bha ro ste/ /rgya bal paṇa grub dbang po'i bkra shis shog /rwa chen lo tsā thugs sras chos rab pa/ /ye shes seng ge 'bum seng dharmā dang / /dkon mchog seng ge shes rab rgyal mtshan te/ /rwa chen brgyud par bcas pa'i bkra shis shog

/rje btsun rga lo rong pa dus 'khor ba/ /bag ston tshul rgyal kun mkhyen shes rab dpal/ /dge ba rgyal mtshan shes rab zla ba'i dbang / /bod yul grub chen rnams kyi bkra shis shog /gangs khrod mkhas pa'i dbang po rdo ring pa/ /nges don bstan pa'i bdag po sgo rum pa/ /sa gsum grags pa'i dpal 'bar tshar pa rje/ /mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rnams kyi bkra shis shog /'jam mgon gshin rje'i gshed dngos rta ra ba/ /'jam dbyangs rnam sprul mkhas grub bslab gsum rje/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje dbang phyug rab brtan dpal/ /'jam dpal bstan 'dzin gsum gyi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba gnyis pa khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba/ /rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhabs/ /rgyal bas rjes bzung bzang po rgyal mtshan pa/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab gsum gyi bkra shis shog /mkhyen brtse nus ldan rmor chen chos kyi rje/ /mkhyen rab mtha' yas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /mkhyen brtse'i dbon rigs las sprul drin chen rje/ /mkhyen bzang rim byon rnams kyi bkra shis shog 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i bkra shis kha skong rta ra ba nas gnas gsar rdo rje legs pa'i mtshan can bar gyi shis brjod 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun blos sbyar/ dbang phyug brgyad ldan rgya ston rin po che/ /dbang phyug grags pa sdong ston shes rab dpal/ /shar nub brgyud pa'i srol 'dzin nyi zla ltar/ /yongs grags brgyud par bcas pa'i bkra shis shog /khyab bdag dus dgra'i dbang po ma he'i zhal/ /dran pas snying gi gdung sel ro langs yum/ /rigs bzhi yum bzhi khro rgyal sgo ba bcas/ /bcu gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog /'khrul 'khor mthar thug badz+ra bhai ra wa'i/ /rtsa bshad rgyud gzhung rim gnyis cha lag bcas/ /rgya bod mkhas grub bye ba'i bgrod pa'i lam/ /gsang chen zab mo'i chos kyi bkra shis shog /bdud sde'i dpung 'joms chos rgyal gzi ldan sras/

/bstan dgra'i gshed ma khrag 'thung tsa mun+d+ri/ /khams gsum dregs pa'i ded dpon phyogs skyong bcu/ /mthu ldan bstan srung rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog / bkra shis bsdus pa byings 'di 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad/ nor gyi dbang phyug sogs/ bgegs rigs stong phrag sogs/ nyin mo bde legs sogs rol mo'i sgra cher bya'o/ /drug pa thig tshon sta gon la/ thog mar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ thod pa la sogs pa'i nang du dbus su/ rdul tshon sngon po la hūm̐/ shar du dkar po la k+ṣe/ lhor ser po la ma/ nub tu dmar po la me/ byang du ljang gu la da bris te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dang phyogs bzhir yig mgo phyir bstan la bzhag de rnams kyi steng du thig skud rnams kyang / lag bsdog byas la so sor bzhag de rnams/ a kā ro nas nut+pan na twad bar gyis bstod par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan lnga'i steng du/ dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ma he khros pa'i gdong can gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ shar du k+ṣe las 'khor lo k+ṣes mtshan pa las gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lhor ma las rin po che mas mtshan pa las ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ nub tu me las pad+ma mes mtshan pa las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ byang du da las ral gri das mtshan pa las phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang khro bo'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing / so so'i rigs kyi bdag po'i cod pan can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i mig tu k+ṣiṃ/ rna bar dz+riṃ/ snar khaṃ/ lcer gaṃ dpral bar thaṃka/ lte bar saṃ/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ thugs kar hūm̐/

rang gi mig gnyis su dzaḥyig re re bsam/ mig gnyis kyi rdzi ma thur du rdib cing gyen du 'bar ba'i lta stangs kyis bltas pas/ sta gon gyi lha dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig tshon gshin rje gshed rigs lnga'i rnam par byon/ oṃ dip+ta ḍiṣ+ṭa aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ dam tshig gi thig tshon rnams la thim par bsam/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thig tshon rnams len zhing / lha rnams 'od du zhu bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdul phra rab las grub pa'i thig tshon du gyur ces brjod/ tshon skud sngo dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i rim pas slob dpon gyis las kyi rdo rje la re re nas gtad la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga so so'i ngo bor bsam/ de rnams gcig tu sgril nas bsgrims te/ oṃ āḥ.a nu rā ga ta sarba dhar+m+ma s+pha ra ṇa a nu rā ga ta sarba dhar+m+ma a d+yan+ta a nu pra bis+ṭa sarba dhar+m+ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ro gcig tu 'dres par bsams nas rdo rje'i lte ba la dkris te bdud rtsi cung zad byug la bzhag ye shes kyi thig gdab tshul ni rang dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas shar du kha bltas la tshangs thig rkang pa gnyis kyi bar du 'ong bar byas te gtso bo'i nga rgyal gsal btab/ las kyi rdo rjes dkyil 'khor gyi shar nas nub tu kha bltas la gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal du byas/ slob dpon gyis lag pa g.yon pas sngar gyi rdo rje la dkris pa'i thig skud de rdo rje khu tshur gyis lte ba'i thad du bzung zhing / dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod nas slob ma la gtad/ slob mas kyang de bzhin du brjod cing thig sne lag pa g.yas pas blangs la/ g.yon pas lte ba'i thad kar bzung slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mtheb srin gnyis kyis thig skud kyi steng nas bzung la gcus te 'og nas 'then nas/ gyen du gdab cing /

ngag tu/ nam mkha' gang ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ /khyed kyis 'gro don mdzad dus lags/ /khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar/ /thig skud sgra yis bskul ma 'debs/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing thig skud kyis sgra las kyang de ltar byung bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon par bsam/ yang thig skud kyi 'og nas bzung ste gcus la/ steng du 'then zhing thur du gdab/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang / ngag tu brjod pa dang sems kyi ting nge 'dzin de nyid kyis shes par bya'o/ /de nas g.yas bskor du/ slob dpon lhor gnas slob ma byang du gnas te tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ de nas slob mas slob dpon gyi rgyab nas bskor te dbang ldan du gnas/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i rgyab nas bskor te srin por gnas pas zur thig dang po gdab/ slob dpon mer gnas/ slob ma rlung du gnas te zur thig gnyis pa gdab bo/ /oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma hoḥ zhes brjod cing lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur kha gyen du bstan pa'i mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel mdzub mo gnyis rtse sbyar la smin mtshams kyi thad kar 'degs pa'i tshul du byas ye shes kyi thig nam mkhar bteg par bsam/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin la dbus kyi phur khung yod na tshon sna lngas rim pa bzhin dgang / dbang ldan kyi mtshams su sor bzhi'am mkhyid gang tsam shar phyogs su rdo rje khu tshur gyis phyin nas rim pa bzhin du thog mar dkar po thogs te/ 'di ni chos dbyings ye shes te/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /rgyal ba 'jam dbyangs rdo rje nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /oṃ bud+dha tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ ljang khu thogs la/ 'di ni bya grub ye shes te/ sems can /rgyal ba /rim pa gnyis par yang dag gnas/ /oṃ kar+m+ma tsi tra sa mā ya hūm̐/ dmar po thogs la/

'di ni kun rtog ye shes te/ /sems can /rgyal ba /rim pa gsum par yang dag gnas/ /oṃ pad+ma tsi tra sa mā ya hūm̐/ ser po thogs te/ 'di ni mnyam nyid ye shes te/ /sems can /rgyal ba /rim pa bzhi par yang dag gnas/ /oṃ rat+na tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ nag po thogs te/ 'di ni me long ye shes te/ /sems can /rgyal ba /kun gyi nang na yang dag gnas/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa mā ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod la thod pa'i ting phor gyis bkab/ rdo rjes mnan/ mi 'chugs par bya/ puṣ+pe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de nas slob ma la sogs pas dbus nas rim pa bzhin 'bri ste/ de yang sbom po bkye ni nad kyis thebs/ /phra mos nor ni rnam par 'jig /yon pos rnam grangs chad par 'gyur/ /phyogs 'khrul slob ma myos par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas shin tu legs par 'bri ste/ de'i tshul ni mngon rtogs rgyas pa bzhin no/ /thig tshon skabs su byang shar dbang ldan gyi/ /mtshams nas sor bzhi'i tshad tsam shar phyogs su/ /phyi nas rim bzhin dkar ljang dmar ser dang / /nag po'i tshon rnams rdo rje khu tshur gyis/ /bkye nas lhag ma rgyud dang mngon rtogs ltar/ /bri zhes rwa chen lo tsā'i dbang chur bshad/ /'di dang mthun pa'i phyag len ji ltar yod/ /'don bya'i tshig dang 'gal ba spong tshul cing / /lha rnams bri skabs gtso bo'i mdun phyogs su/ /gti mug gshin rje gshed po bris snang mod/ /gtso zhal shar bstan byed na 'di 'thad kyang / /phyag len lho bstan mdzad na mi 'gal lam/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ rwa chen gyi dbang chu 'dir phyi nas rim bzhin/ dkar ljang dmar ser/ nag po'i rtsig pa rnams so so'i tshigs bcad brjod nas 'bri bar gsungs pa bzhin/ tshar chen rin po che'i lhan thabs su'ang phyag len de ltar bshad la/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs su rtsig pa nang nas rim bzhin nag ljang dmar ser dkar po bshad pa'i ngag 'don de mdun bskyed la brjod pas bri 'don gnyis ma mthun kyang /

mdun bskyed kyi rtsig pa 'bri tshul bsgyur bar mi bya ste/ rwa chen rang gi dgongs bzhed ye shes kyi go rim dang bstun pa'o/ /yang na bri 'don gnyis mthun par byas nas mdun bskyed la nang nas rim pa bzhin/ nag po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang khu/ dkar po'i rtsig pa zhes brjod na legs/ gtso bo'i zhal gzigs phyogs/ rtog pa dang po'i dngos bstan ltar mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo thams cad zhal lho bstan du nges sam snyam na dngos bstan spyir btang ba la de ltar yin mod/ shugs bstan dmigs kyis bsal na/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i zhal shar bstan yang yod de/ rtog pa dang por dkyil 'khor bzhengs tshul dang bzhengs nas der sgrub pa po bdag nyid 'jug cing sngags bzla ba dngos su bstan pa 'di'i shugs las dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas der slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing / dbang len pa dang slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur na yang bstan bde'i tshe na/ sgo gcig pa ni dbye bar bya/ /zhes pa de dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo gcig pu dbye ba'i gnad kyis gtso bo'i zhal yang dkyil 'khor gyi shar la gzigs pa grub cing rgyu mtshan de ltar na/ dbang bskur dang 'brel ba'i tshe bcu gsum ma lta bu la gtso bo'i mdun du gti mug gshin rje gshed bri bar mdzad pa'i phyag len ni skyon med cing 'brel chags pa yin no/ /de skad du rwa chen nyid kyi lag len khrigs chags las/ shar phyogs dkar la lho ni ser/ /nub dmar byang ljang dbus su ni/ /tshon ni nag pos bri bar bya/ /dbang bskur byed na shar sgo phye/ /gzhan ni gsum po re gas bcad/ /ces gsungs la de'i don yang lha rang gi ngos nas drag po gtso che yang / dbang bskur ba/ rjes gzung dang 'brel ba'i las yin pas de la phyogs kyi rten 'brel shar bstan shes pa yin nam snyam du kho bo cag sems so/ /de la dbang chur/ rang nyid dbang len pa ni lho'i lag steng nas len par gsungs pa dang /
