cung zad mi mthun pa yod de 'og tu 'chad do/ /des na rtog pa dang po'i dngos bstan ltar dkyil 'khor bris nas sgrub bsnyen byed pa sogs drag las dang 'brel pa kun la/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i zhal lho bstan yin pa 'thad cing / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis spyir btang lha 'di'i zhal lho bstan grangs tshod gtso che yang byung ba yin la/ 'on kyang de'i dkyus dbang dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor la shor na phyogs kyi rten 'brel cung zad go log pa tsam du 'gro bas dbang gi tshe na gtso bo dang shar gyi gti mug gshin rje gshed zhal sprod du byas nas gtso zhal shar drang por bstan na legs pa'i char 'gro ba yin no/ /bla ma gong ma rnams phyag len la shar gyi lha rnams dkar po dang / gti mug gshin rje gshed lho drang por bris nas gtso zhal lhor bstan pa dang zhal sprod mdzad pa yang / phyogs kyi rten 'brel cung zad ma gtogs don la las chags pa la sgrib byed kyi nor 'khrul ye med pas lugs 'di la 'gal ba cher med tshul kyang dpyod ldan dag gis rtogs par mdzod cig sngar gyi dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa'i mtshams su slebs pa dang / de nyid kyis kha phyed la tsho pra brtag cing rtsig rgyun sbrel nas rol chen bya/ mthar rdul tshon rnams nyer spyod lngas mchod la lhag ma rnams kyi/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o/ /de dag gis ni sta gon gyi cho ga ma tshang ba med par bshad zin to// ༈ /gsum pa dngos gzhi la/ rwa chen gyi gzhung las/ nub gsum pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la bzhi ste/ sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga bdag bskyed dang bcas pa mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor mchod bstod gtor ma bcas pa dang / dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang / dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ sngon du 'gro ba dang / bdag bskyed dngos dang / bum pa sgrub pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dang po/ sngon du 'gro ba la/ bum pa 'bul ba'i tshul ni/

las kyi rdo rjes spos dang rol mor bcas pas sna drangs/ slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bum pa bco lnga yod na gtso bum bzung la/ g.yon pas dril bu gsil gzhan rnams kyis bum pa lhag ma rnams khyer la/ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥbarjod cing dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas pa'i mthar/ gtso bo'i mtshan ma'i thad du bum pa ma reg tsam 'bul tshul byas la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po yab yum gyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañji btsugs pa'am/ yang na shar du bzhag de bzhin du gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i bum pa rnams kyang lha de dang de la 'bul tshul dang so so'i sngags brjod cing / lha de dang des bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod la phyogs mtshams rnams su bzhag rnam rgyal bum pa la lha sngags yongs rdzogs brjod pa'i mthar/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pas bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod la dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du bzhag las bum las sngags brjod pa'i mthar/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen pos bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi bgegs dang bar chad thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes brjod la dkyil 'khor gyi lho sgor bzhag bum pa gnyis las med na thog mar rnam rgyal bum pa bskor tshul sogs gong dang 'dra ba las/ gtso bo la 'bul tshar ba'i rjes su rigs bzhi yum bzhi sgo srung rnams la g.yas bskor gyis 'bul tshul byas la/ de dang de'i sngags dang mtshan la/ dbang bskur du gsol/ btags pa brjod nas/ rang gi g.yon dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas su bzhag las bum ni gong bzhin la rang gi g.yas dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon du bzhag de nas spyi mchod/ sgos mchod rnams gong du sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor du zlum po khur yug gam ras bris ltar na gru bzhir bshams/ de'i mthar phyogs mtshams brgyad du mda' brgyad dam bcu la brten pa'i tshon skud kyi drwa ris dang /

grangs de snyed kyi ral gri me long dar tshon la sogs pas kyang bskor bar bshad pas spros pa la dga' na bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas mda' drwa phyed tshul la rtsibs bcu ma dang brgyad ma gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad dang shar nub gnyis dang lhag ste dang bcas pa'i mda' 'dzugs rten 'jim pa sogs las grub pa bcu cha snyoms par bzhag la/ de dag la mda' zhe 'gre ring thung med pa btsug pa la phyogs skyong bcu'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i dar dang me long re btags/ tshon skud sna lnga'i gru gu'i sne byang shar gyi mda' rtsar dkris la/ de shar gyi mda' g.yas ma'i rtse mor khyer/ g.yon ma'i rtsa ba dang / shar lho'i rtse dang / lho'i rtsa ba dang / lho nub kyi rtse dang / nub g.yas ma'i rtsa ba dang / g.yon ma'i rtse dang / nub byang gi rtsa ba dang / byang gi rtse dang / byang shar gyi rtsa bar phyin la yar dkri/ shar gyi mda' g.yas kyi rtsa ba dang / g.yon ma'i rtse dang / shar lho'i rtsa ba dang / lho'i rtse dang / lho nub kyi rtsa ba dang / nub g.yas ma'i rtse dang / g.yon ma'i rtsa ba dang / nub byang gi rtse dang / byang gi rtsa ba dang / byang shar kyi rtse dang / shar lho'i rtse dang / nub g.yas kyi rtse dang / byang gi rtse dang / shar g.yon ma'i rtse/ lho nub kyi rtse dang / nub byang gi rtse dang / shar g.yas ma'i rtse dang / lho'i rtse dang / nub g.yon ma'i rtse dang / byang shar gyi rtse rnams su phyin pa'i skud lhag mda' de'i rtsa bar drangs nas bzhag pas steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i rnam pa 'byung / rtsibs brgyad byed na mda' brgyad btsugs la/ shar gyi mda' la dar dkar po dang dmar skya btags/ nub kyi mda' la dkar po dang ser skya btags/ gzhan rnams la gong bzhin btags la/ dang por dbang ldan gyi mda'i rtsa ba la tshon skud kyi sne mo btags la/ de nas shar gyi mda'i rtse mor khyer nas dkris/ de bzhin du shar lho'i mda'i rtsa ba dang /

lho'i rtse mo dang / lho nub kyi rtsa ba dang / nub kyi rtse mo dang / nub byang gi rtsa ba dang / byang gi rtse mo dang / de ka nas byang shar gyi rtse mo dang / shar gyi rtsa ba dang / shar lho'i rtse mo dang / lho'i rtsa ba dang / lho nub kyi rtse mo dang / nub kyi rtsa ba dang / nub byang gi rtse mo dang / byang gi rtsa ba dang / byang shar gyi rtse mo dang / de nas shar kyi rtse mo dang / de nas mda' gnyis gnyis bor te/ lho nub kyi rtse mo la dkris/ de bzhin du byang gi rtse mo dang / shar lho'i rtse mo dang / nub kyi rtse dang / byang shar gyi rtse dang / lho'i rtse dang / nub byang gi rtse dang / shar gyi rtse dang / de nas re re bzhin du/ shar/ shar lho/ lho/ lho nub/ nub/ nub byang / byang / byang shar gyi rtse rnams la dkris re byas nas 'khor mor bskor ba'i lhag ma byang shar gyi mda'i rtsa bar drangs nas bzhag pas/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i rnam pa 'byung ngo / /tshon skud kyi drwa ris 'di ni gsang sngags spyi khog nas kha skongs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed bsdus pa'i bar sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bya/ gsum pa ni/ gong du bum bskyed kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar skabs 'dir slar yang bum pa bsgrubs par gsungs pa spros pa la dga' na de ltar bya zhing / ma grub kyang chad pa'i skyon med par mngon no/ /dngos gzhi bum sgrub byed na bdag mdun gyi/ /mtshams su bya bar bshad 'di dgongs dbyings ci/ /mdun bskyed rdzogs rjes byas na 'gal med dam/ /'di lan lon pa'i sngags 'chang e yod na/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ sta gon gyi nyin bum bskyed byas pa'i bum pa sta gon de gang gi sta gon yin na/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su sngar bsgrubs zin pa'i bum chu nus ldan dgos pa de nyid sta gon gyi nyin tshags su tshud par byas pa la/ bum pa sta gon gyi tha snyad 'dogs dgos pas/

dngos gzhi bum sgrub ma byas kyang skyon med cing / rwa chen gyis bdag mdun gyi mtshams su bum sgrub bshad pa 'di ni/ thog mar bdag bskyed bum bskyed gnyis sngon 'gro'i tshul du byas nas sgrub mchod dngos gzhi la zhugs na legs shing 'brel chags pa la dgongs shing / khyad par lugs 'di la bdag mdun bsre ba mi mdzad pas/ bdag mdun gyi mtshams su cho ga rigs mi mthun gyis bar chod kyang 'gal ba med pa'i gnad kyis kyang yin te/ dper na kyai rdor man ngag lta bu/ dngos gzhi'i tshe bdag mdun bsre dgos pas/ bdag mdun gyi mtshams su bum sgrub byas na cho ga rigs mi mthun gyis bar bcad par 'gro bas mtshams der cho ga gzhan nges par byar mi rung la/ 'o na gang du bya zhe na/ sngar bshad pa ltar bum rdzas kyi ldang 'kho ba dang bstun pas bsgrub dgos pa byung na/ mdun bskyed sgrub mchod kyi bya ba kun rdzogs zin pa dang / bdag 'jug gi bar der bum sgrub kyi phyag len mdzad dgos pa yin la/ lugs 'dir ni/ mdun bskyed rdzogs rjes byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /gtso bor ni bdag mdun gyi mtshams su bya ba nyid legs te/ bdag mdun bsre mi dgos pa gzhir bzhag la/ bum bskyed dgos na mtshams der skabs su bab cing 'brel chags pas so/ /gnyis pa mdun bskyed dngos ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa nas/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dngos gzhi nyi ma dang por/ rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ snying kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sta gon gyi lha'i phyi 'brang gi bgegs thams cad bskrad par gyur/ zhes dang rdo rje gsor dril bu drag tu dkrol/ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ bzla zhing rol chen bya/ de nas rol mo bzhag la mtshan sngags gcig sngon 'gro'i mchod pa lngas mchod/

sgo ba bzhi'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug bya/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ zhes sogs ye shes pa spyan 'dren man chad sta gon gyi skabs bzhin bya'o/ /skabs 'dir dam pa 'ga' zhig gi gsungs las/ bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsre bar bzhed kyang / rwa chen gyi yi ge na mi gsal bas btang snyoms su bzhag go /bcu gsum dkyil 'khor yan lag bzhi rdzogs su/ /mdun du bskyed 'di bskyed rim rnal 'byor du/ /khas len nus pa 'di dang bdag bskyed la/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong tshul khyad par yod dam ci/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ bdag mdun gnyis cho ga'i babs gcig pa 'di bskyed rim kyi rnal 'byor du 'dus so snyam na ma yin te/ bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor ni/ mnyam gzhag gi rnal 'byor yin la/ mdun bskyed ni thun mtshams kyi bya bar gsungs pas so/ /'o na ci zhe na/ bdag mdun gnyis dgos pa'i gtso bo mi 'dra bas/ mdun bskyed kyi dgos pa'i gtso bo ni mdun du lha bskyed nas mchod bstod rgyas par phul bas/ lha rnams mnyes pa las bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po gsog pa 'di yin pas/ bdag bskyed ltar sbyang gzhi rang gtso bor sbyong ba ni 'di'i dgos pa'i gtso bo ma yin no/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na/ bdag bskyed rig 'dzin gyi che ba dang / mdun bskyed mchod bstod kyi che bar rdo rje 'dzin pa spyi la grags pa ltar phyag len ma 'dres pa gal che zhing / bdag mdun gyi dgongs pa'i gtso bo yang ma 'dres par shes par bya'o/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na/ bla med kyi cho ga spyi pa rnams las bdag bskyed kyi skabs mchod bstod bsdus shing / mdun bskyed kyi skabs su mchod bstod rgyas par bshad pa mang la/ 'on kyang lugs 'dir bdag bskyed la yang mchod bstod rgyas par mdzad pa ni/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren nas bzung / rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs kyi bar yan chad tsam sbyang gzhi sbyong byed dang sbyar te ting nge 'dzin brtan pos mnyam bzhag gi rnal 'byor du byas na de man chad la bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso byas snang ba kun lhar gsal ba la mchod bstod rgyas par byas pas/

bsod nams rgya chen po gsog par 'gyur bas/ mngon rtog dkyus thog gcig la gong gi dgos pa gnyis ka tshang ba ni/ dkyil chog spyi pa'i lugs de spyir btang dang / 'di dmigs bsal gyi gnad dam pa bla ma'i man ngag tu byas nas 'chad shes na lugs gzhan dang 'gal ba med pa'i steng du/ nyams len gyi gnad shes pa'i dpyod ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i grangs su 'gro ba yin no/ /de nas phyi rol pa'i gtor ma gtong ba'i tshul ni rgyas par ni/ drug cu pa'i lag len ltar byed du rung bar gsungs pas/ de'i tshul ni gzhan zhig tu 'chad pas der shes par bya'o/ / bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'o/ /dkyus kyi lag len la sgrub khang gi phyi rol du sgrub pa po'i mdun du lcog rtse la sogs pa'i steng du/ chos 'byung gru gsum pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma bcu pa la phyogs skyong so so'i mtshan ma bkod pa'o/ /dri bzang gi chus/ rta ra ba'i zhal slob kyis mdzad pa ltar ro/ /gru gsum du byug pa'i dbus su me tog gi tshom bu bcu bkod pa gang rung gi steng du/ mañji la sogs pa'i khar lcags sder sogs kyi snod du zan gras drug cu rtsa bzhi lag len ltar rtsig pa'o/ / bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i drug cu pa na yod/ bsdu na gtor ma chu chang gis sbyangs/ zlum po gcig la mtheb kyu drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba rgyan dang bcas pa bshams/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga sbreng tshar du bshams/ gtor ma nang mchod/ las bum kyi chu'am nang mchod 'thor zhing / oṃ āḥbighān ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bgegs bsang ba nas/ ha ho hrīḥs byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar nang mchod kyi skabs ltar bya/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bcu pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa bsam/

hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar bkug la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī wi kri tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa in+d+ra duṣ+ṭaṃ sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs skyong ba bcu rang rang gi gnas nas bkug ste/ phyogs mtshams kyi pad 'dab bcur 'khod pa ni/ shar gyi g.yon 'dab la brgya byin mig stong dang ldan pa dmar skya glang po che la gnas pa/ g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba'o/ /lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la gnas pa dbyug tho dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ skra kham pa gyen du phyogs pa'o/ /nub kyi g.yas 'dab la chu lha dkar po sbrul la gnas pa/ g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis sbrul zhags 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du lus ngan ser po gter la gnas pa/ biñja pu ra dang ne'u le 'dzin pa'o/ /byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang la gnas pa rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gau rī la 'khyud pa mig gsum pa'o/ /shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la gnas pa/ bgrang 'phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /lho nub tu srin po sngo nag ro langs la gnas pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub byang du rlung lha dud kha sha ba la gnas pa/ lag pa gnyis kyis rlung ras 'dzin pa'o/ /shar gyi g.yas 'dab la zla ba dkar po ku mu ta'i steng du gnas pa/ ku mu ta 'dzin pa'o/ /nub kyi g.yon 'dab la tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa ser skya ngang pa la gnas pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na me thab dang mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis na dbyug pa dang / phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /tshar chen rin po che'i lhan thabs las/ bshams kyi skabs su 'dab bcu dang / bskyed chog la 'dab brgyad gsungs kyang bri sgom gnyis char mthun pa 'di kho bos bcos so/ /lus kyi phur bu 'debs pa'i phyag rgya bya zhing / oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥwi kṛ twa na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ in+d+ra duṣ+ṭāṃ sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra kwi li kwi la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyogs skyong bcu'i spyi bor phur bus btab pas/

grub pa'i dngul chus reg pa ltar rdo rje 'jigs byed ma he'i gdong pa can zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs dkar 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis rang rang gi gzhon pa la gnas pa'i skur gyur/ de rnams kyi mig tu k+ṣiṃ nas thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drangs/ sgo ba bzhi'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drangs/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /nas/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñja hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las lha bcu gsum la mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ de rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i 'od zer gyis sbu gus gtor ma drangs nas gsol bar bsam zhing / pad kor sngon du 'gro bas lag pa rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas pa bya zhing / oṃ in+d+ra ya hrīḥphaṭa phaṭa kyi bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin la/ swāhā zhes sbyar ba drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma phul/ dwa sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha ye swāhā/ pa d+yaṃ pra twits+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin du/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar dang / sngags kyi rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ rol chen bya zhing / gzugs sgra sogs kyi yid mchod dang / dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan pa'i/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ 'jig rten skyong ba 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa nas/

byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung ba dang stong grogs mdzod cig ces pa'i bar brjod/ yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyi bzod gsol/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dā sha dika lo ka pa la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes brjod cing go mtshon rol mo tshom rngams dang bcas pas gtor ma lho phyogs su bskyal/ drug cu rtsa bzhi mchod gtor dkyil 'khor gyi/ /phyi rol du bshams mchod dang bstod pa'i rjes/ /go mtshon rol mo dang bcas phyi rol du/ /gtor ma stob par bshad 'di ji ltar yin/ /kye rdor sogs las mdun bskyed sgrub mchod rjes/ /bzod gsol lhag chad kha skong bya bar bshad/ /lugs 'di de ltar ma bshad rgyu mtshan ci/ /mdun bskyed man chad cho ga rigs mthun nam/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du drug cu pa lag lan ltar bshams nas mgron bskyed pa nas mchod bstod gyi bar gyi cho ga rnams bya la/ de nas go mtshon rol mo dang bcas gtor ma phyi rol du bskyal nas/ rang gi nang du log ste 'dud kyi bstod pa bya bar bstan la tshul 'di ltar na/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i phyi rol gtor ma kun la mgron bskyed pa nas mchod bstod kyi bar/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du byas nas/ gtor ma stob pa nas/ khang pa'i phyi rol du/ las kyi rdo rje'am/ yang nas kun gyis 'ong nas 'bul ba'i tshul ston pa'o/ /yang na dgra phyogs la bla ma'i man ngag ltar 'phong ba yin no/ /de bas na 'di'i phyi rol gtor ma dang / kyai rdor pa rnams mdzad pa'i phyi rol gtor ma gnyis/ phyi rol gyi gtor ma'i rgyu mtshan la/ gnad mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cher yod pas/ gang grags tshod che ba de'i dkyus pa gzhan la sbyar bar mi bya'o/ /kyai rdor la bdag bskyed nas bzung ste phyi rol gtor ma yan gyi bar cho ga rigs mthun gcig tu byas te bdag 'jug gi gong du yig brgya ci rigs pa brjod pa'i rjes su sngar kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la lhag chad kyi nyes pa byung ba rnams bzod gsol byas na/

de nas bum sgrub dgos na skabs 'dir byas la/ bdag 'jug la 'jug pa yin no/ /lugs 'dir ni bdag 'jug yang rdzogs pa'i mthar sngar gyi bdag bskyed dang / mdun bskyed sgrub pa nas bzung mjug chog gi bar kun la thun mong du yig brgya ci rigs pa'i rjes su nongs pa bzod gsol mdzad pa yin pas/ mdun bskyed sgrub mchod kyi rjes su thog nyid du nongs pa bzod gsol ma byas kyang chog cing rwa chen gyis kyang ma bshad do/ /des na mdun bskyed man chad cho ga rigs mthun gcig tu bsam nas/ bar 'dir nongs pa bzod gsol mi byed pa ni ma yin no/ /yig brgya brjod cing nang du log la rol mo dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum bya/ slar lho sgo nas/ 'jam dpal dpal dang nas/ thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstod/ gsum pa la gnyis te bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang nyid lha'i lag pa'i steng na 'dug par mos la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pas cho ga rnams mdzad la/ las rnams thugs ka nas sprul pa'i ya man+ta ka phyag gnyis pas mdzad par bsam zhing / rang gi las rnams rang gis dngos su phyag bya'o/ /bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i tshul ni/ las kyi rdo rjes sgrub pa por thams cad la rnams rgyal bum pa'i chu dang man+ḍal gyi me tog bkram mo/ /slob dpon gyis gtso byas rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis bum chu cung zad 'thung zhing ku shas dbang chur bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang tshe/ rang nyid lho'i lag steng 'dug mos nas/ zhes gsungs lho 'di nang gi'am cha phyi ma dgongs/ nang gi yin na phyi 'jug ji ltar byed/ ces pa'i lan ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar sgrub bsnyen dang 'brel ba'i skabs dang / dbang dang 'brel ba'i skabs gnyis yod pa las dang po'i tshe lho sgo nas bzhugs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi lho'i lag pa'i steng du 'dug par bsam nas/

bdag mdun zhal sprod kyi tshul gyis sngags bzla ba de yin pas spyi babs lho'i lag steng ni dkyil 'khor gyi nang du yin pa las 'os med la/ dbang dang 'brel ba'i tshe rwa chen nyid kyis dbang bskur byed na shar rgo dbye zhes gsungs pa ltar/ slob dpon dang slob ma 'jug pa'i skabs gang yin kyang dbang len pa la shar sgo nas 'jug pa yinate/ thog mar shar gyi sgo nang nas gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis/ lha rnams la byin gyis brlabs par gsol ba gdab/ de bzhin du lho nub byang bcas la'ang gsol gdab kyi sngags rnams cho ga'i dkyus la snang zhing / de ni slob dpon slob ma gang 'jug kyang khyad par dbyer med pa'o/ /dbang dang 'brel ba'i tshe gtso bo'i zhal shar bstan gyi dbang du byas nas/ gtso bo'i mdun du shar gyi mgo bo bris pa/ 'jigs byed kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor rnying pa phal cher la 'dug pas kyang / dbang dang 'brel pa'i tshe shar sgo nas 'jug par grub bo/ /des na bdag nyid 'jug na lho sgo dbye zhes pas/ sgrub bsnyen dang 'brel ba'i dus su yin kyang / de'i bgros bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba la yang cung zad 'dres pa yin pas/ rjes 'jug chos kyi rjes 'brang gi mkhas pa dag gis/ rwa chen gyis dgongs pa'i dbyings rnams 'khrul med du skyong shes shing / 'bad pas sgrub nus pa/ dgongs pa can gyi tshig zur phran bu la dad pa'i rjes 'brangs ltar u tshugs rang yang ma yin pa'i 'phrul chags pa cig ces so/ /'di la phyi nang gi 'jug pa dang / dbang dngos dang po phyi 'jug la don tshan bcu bzhi yod pa las/ dang po khrus ni/ 'thor ba'i stengs ka byas te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang sngags dang bcas pa brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gi chu dang bcas pa'i tshom bu bdun pa 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du/

'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ e ma ho sangs rgyas slob dpon che/ /e ma ho chos dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /e ma ho khro bo 'jigs byed pa/ /ro langs ma yis kha sbyor ba'i/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa po/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dam tshig de nyid rim pa dang / /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /gshin rje sgrol ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bzhi pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum/ lnga pa ni/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs lan gsum/ drug pa ni/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i mig dar dmar po chings bar bsam la/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa ra ma na ye hūm̐/ zhes pas gdong bcing ba'i phyag rgya bya/ bdun pa ni/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i me tog gtad par bsam la/ u dum wa ra man+da ra/ /yongs 'du dang ni ma li ka /kar ni ka yi phreng ba ni/ /legs par nos te bus bzung zhig /a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ brgyad pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ zhes brjod cing gnas gsum du dri yi thig le lugs 'byung dang lugs bzlog tu bzhag pa'i tshul byas pas/ dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po aḥs mtshan pa/ snying kar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam/ dgu pa ni/ oṃ āḥbighān ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus gtor/ bcu pa ni/ dus 'di nyid nas khyod nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas rigs su chud pas na/ /ngas ni ye shes rdo rje sbyin/ /des ni sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di ni ma mthong ba'i/

/mdun du smra bar ma byed cig /bag med smras na nyams 'gyur te/ /de bas nan tan gsang bar mdzod/ /ces brjod pa ni gsang bar gdams pa'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ sa m+wa ya a/ zhes brjod pas/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems/ snying kar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa ta ya mi su ra te sa ma ya satwaṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro bar bsgom pa ni don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo mtshon pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ kyai bu sdug khyod su/ skal pa bzang po dang ldan pa bdag lags so/ /ci la dga'/ bde ba chen po la'o/ /de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ /sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /bcu gsum pa ni/ las kyi rdo rjes dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid par bsam la/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing / gti mug rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis yol ba'i nang du 'khrid do/ /bcu bzhi pa ni/ rgan pa'am/ dbang bskur ram yon tan che chung gi rim pas gral la/ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ zhes brjod cing bzhag go /phyi 'jug nang 'jug yol ba'i phyir 'jug dang / /yol ba'i nang du 'jug la ngos 'dzin nam/ /slob ma dkyil 'khor nang du gang tshe bcug /dkyil 'khor ma bcug dbang rnams bskur ram ci/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ rwa chen po'i dbang chu 'di'i dgongs pa sor bzhag nas/ khrus dang maṇ+ḍal dang gsol gdab nas bzung / pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ gyi bar rnams slob ma 'jug pa'i tshe yol ba'i phyi rol du bya ba'i cho ga yin pas/ yol ba'i phyi 'jug dang / na ma te hūm̐ la sogs pa sku gsung thugs kyi phyag bya ba nas bzung / khyod kyi yi dam gyi lha ni zhes sogs lha ngo bstan pa dang / rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor tshig tsam gyi bstan pa'i bar rnams ni/ yol ba'i nang du zhugs nas bya ba'i cho ga yin pas/ yol ba'i nang 'jug gi tha snyad mdzad nas/

dkyil 'khor nyid kyi nang du bcug pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i sgo bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'khrid par bsam nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi phyag byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bye nas/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du sleb par mos pa yin pas/ 'di nas bzung dbang gi cho ga ma grol gyi bar la gzhal yas khang gi nang du gnas par bsam dgos pa yin no/ /gnyis pa nang 'jug la bdun yod pa las/ dang po/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i sgo ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'khrid par bsam zhing / na maḥte hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ zhes pas sku gsung thugs kyi phyag bya/ oṃ badz+ra ur+gha sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pas sgo rnams phye la/ shar sgo nas gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol ba'i yid kyis thal mo spyi gtsug tu sbyar la/ oṃ sarba ta th+wa ga ta pū dza u pas+d+ya na ya/ āt+ma naṃ nir+ya tā ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi at+ma/ mo han+ta kṛta a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa mi maṃ/ lho phyogs nas ser sna gshin rje gshed kyis nga rgyal gyis/ dbang bskur ba gsol ba btab pa'i yid kyis thal mo dpral bar sbyar la/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ta/ āt+ma naṃ nir+ya tā ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga tā sid+dha āt+ma pi shu nan+ta kṛta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ zhes dang / nub phyogs nas 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis chos ston pa gsol ba btab pa'i yid kyis thal mo mgrin par sbyar la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra war+dha āt+ma ya naṃ nīr+ya tā ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi āt+ma/ rā gan+ta kṛta dharmāḥ tsakra pra warta ya maṃ/ zhes pa dang / nub/ byang phyogs nas phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis/ 'phrin las 'grub par gsol ba btab pa'i yid kyis thal mo spyi bor sbyar la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi āt+ma/

ir ṣ+yan ta kṛta karma ku ru maṃ/ zhes dang / de nas 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal gyis/ dngos grub thams cad 'grub par gsol ba btab pa'i yid kyis/ thal mo snying kar sbyar la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa mā ya/ kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta swa bha wā badz+ra a tsar+ya sā da naṃ/ bhan+dha nan/ ka ro mi/ sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu maṃ/ zhes pas phyag bya zhing / dkyil 'khor la bskor ba bya'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dang po ni/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ gnyis pa nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ snying kar rdo rje bzhag la/ gshin rje gshed po deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur/ /nga yi bstan pa'i gsang ba 'di/ /dam tshig med pa'i mi rnams dang / /gang yang gzhan la smras gyur na/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ /yang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na/ 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gas par byed do/ /gsum pa gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum chu nas khyor ba g.yon par cung zad blugs par 'thung la/ 'di ni khyod kyi bdud rtsi ste/ /ma srung bsreg par byed pa'i dug /bsrungs na dngos grub 'byung ba ste/ /'thung zhig rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu/ /oṃ pañca a mṛ ta u ḍa ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ bzhi pa bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyis/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de yang khyod kyis bya dgos so/

/khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig gal te byas na ya nga ba ma spangs pa/ 'chi'i dus byas nas rdo rje dmyal ba chen por ltung bar gyur ta re/ man+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung cig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa kha bskang / gsum pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad sgyu mar shes pa'i ngang nas/ rang nyid rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ badz+ra bhai ra wa phyag gnyis par gyur pa'i rkang mthil du dzheṃ me'i rang bzhin/ snying gar sa yi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ snying gi nang du 'jam dpal gzhon nu/ mgrin par chu yi dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po as mtshan pa/ spyi bor rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po has mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos pas rkang mthil gyi me 'bar te lus thams cad gang / sdig pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad bsregs/ snying ga'i sa dmar po tshig mgrin pa'i chu bskol/ mgo bo'i rlung gis mnan/ rkang pa'i rlung gis bteg me'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par char bzhin du babs pa thim par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar shub bus brjod cing gsal btab/ rol chen dang bcas pas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol/ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥ'i mthar/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha a be sha ya/ satwaṃ bha ya/ satwaṃ bha ya/ raḥraḥraḥ tsa la ya/ tsa la ya/ hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃ/ lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pas brjod/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/

tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan par bya/ bzhi pa ni/ bdag 'jug gi skabs 'dir mi dgos/ lnga pa ni/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal stangs kas bzung dril bu tshigs bcad kyi mtshams su dkrol zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /gshin rje gshed dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma zhugs par gyis/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams rim pa de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni de bzhin shog /lan gsum brjod/ nam mkha'i kha dog brtag pa ni bdag 'jug gi skabs 'dir mos pa tsam gyis chog de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas la sogs kyi/ gsol btab smon tshig 'di bdag 'jug tshe/ /mdun bskyed gtso bos gsungs bar mos pa'am/ /yang na rang gis brjod pa tsam zhig yin/ /gal te dbang bskur zhu dus gsol btab 'di/ /slob dpon nyid kyis mdzad pa bdag 'jug tshe/ /mdun bskyed gtso bos brjod par bsam snyam nam/ /'deb yul 'deb po gcig tu thal min nam/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ 'di gtso bos gsungs par bsam mam zhe na min te/ bdag gi slob ma bzhugs par bgyi zhes pa dang 'gal/ rang gi yang ni de ltar brjod mi rigs/ 'o na sa sus gsungs rgyu yin snyam na/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i las kyi gshed po des gsung rgyu yin no/ /drug pa ni/ lha ngo bstan pa'i phyir/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan pa'i/ /nas/ ma he'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bar dang / gti mug rdo rje nas/ gshed po bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bar gtso 'khor gyi bstod pa bya/ de nas me tog lha yi gtsug tu phul bar bsgoms la/ oṃ pra tits+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod la dor/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos me tog rang gi rna ltag g.yon du bzhag par bsams la/ sems dpa' stobs po che 'di bzung zhig pra ti gṛh+na swa mi maṃ satwa ma hā ba la ya/ bdun pa ni/

mig 'bras gnyis su/ oṃ bsam la/ gshin rje gshed pos deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni btson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ zhes gsungs zhing gdong g.yogs dkrol te/ oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu ma hā maṇ+ḍal pra be sha ya phaṭa/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /khyed ni sangs rgyas rigs su skye/ /khyod kyi yi dam gyi lha ni gzhal yas khang gi dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ces bya ba zhal dgu phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi pa de yin pas sgrubs shig ces gsungs par bsam/ bla ma las dbang len pa'i tshe bla mas brjod pa gzhir bzhag la/ bdag 'jug gi tshe 'di yang las kyi rdo rjes brjod par bsam na legs pa yin no/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad sku dang tsa ka li lta bu ma yin par snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar mngon sum lta bur mthong ba yin no/ /zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag byas par mos la thal mo sbyar nas/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag gis de ring mthong / /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /oṃ ma hā maṇ+ḍal hoḥ zhes pa ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o/ /gsum pa dbang dngos la bzhi las/ dang po la gsum gyi dang po rig dbang la gsum las dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa'i mjug tu/ dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /sogs dang / ji ltar sangs rgyas chos chen pos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag kyang mgon pos dbang bskur zhing / /nyid kyi mchog kyang stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa bran mchod ni/

las bum gyi chus 'thor ba'i stangs ka byas la/ oṃ āḥbighān ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas lus ngag yid gsum la gnas pa'i bgegs bskrad/ rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyis nam mkhar dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje 'chang gis 'gro skyabs phyir/ /yon tan 'byung gnas byin pa ltar/ /de bzhin slob ma 'di rnams la/ /dbang mchog dam pa sbyin par mdzod/ /ces pas lha la gsol ba btab bo/ /bu de dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin na dbang bskur cig ces gnang ba sbyin par bsam/ las kyi rdo rjes rnam rgyal dang las bum bteg nas bzung / gzhan rnams kyis me tog gi char 'bebs shing rol mo byas la/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs sh+lau ka gsum gyis shis pa brjod/ gsum pa lnga dang / de re re la gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /dngos gzhi'i yon phul gsol gdab bgegs bsangs nas/ bcu gsum dkyil 'khor nam mkhar spyan 'dren pa'i phyag len lhan thabs nang du gsal bar bshad/ dbang chur mdun du dkyil 'khor gsal byas la/ /zhes pa tsam las spyan 'dren tshul mi snang 'di gnyis dgongs gzhi so sor yod dam ci/ mchod dang gsol btab yul gyi yi dam lha/ /spyan drangs nyid dang mdun bskyed ga la 'jog /de ltar spyan drangs byas pa'i dkyil 'khor de/ /mthar ni gang la bstim dang gang tshe bstim/ /spyan drangs byas pa'i dgongs pa ji ltar yin/ /bsam bya'i don rnams 'khrul med cis kyang ces/ /bum gnyis bteg nas me tog char 'babs shing / /bkra shis glu dbyangs brjod pa'i phyag len 'di'i/ dgos pa gang yin rgyud las ji ltar bshad/

/bum pa nyid la brjod dam rang la yin/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ rwa tshar gnyis kyi gsung mi mthun pa lta bu zhig byung yang 'gal ba gtan med de/ rwa chen po'i bzhed pa 'di slob ma dbang bskur la dgos/ tshar chen rje'i lhan thabs su gsungs tshul 'di ni bdag 'jug la dgongs pa yin la/ de ltar spyan drangs mchod gsol bkra shis pa'i lha tshogs de dag gang la bstim gyi gsal kha ma byung yang rang gi go tshod ni/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo dang / bla ma dbyer med pa de la/ slob ma des dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin nus ni dbang bskur cing ces gnang ba byung par bsams nas/ spyan drangs pa rnams mdun bskyed la bstim pa'am/ yang na mi dmigs par bsam pa tsam gyis chog gam snyam mo/ /rwa chen gyi dgongs pa bum pa la bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol yin pa'i dbang du mdzad nas rwa'i rjes 'brangs rnams bum pa la shis brjod mdzad/ rang gi go tshod ni/ phyis kyi bde mchog gi dbang gi yig sna 'ga' zhig tu bum pa bteg te/ bkra shis brjod pa'i skabs 'dir gtso bo'i thugs ka nas dbang lha rnams spros te/ rigs lngas bum pa thogs te dbang bskur ba'i sta gon mdzad/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod par bsam pa yin zhes bshad la/ tshul 'di ltar na/ rnam rgyal bum pa 'degs pa ni/ rigs lngas dbang bskur ba'i sta gon mdzad pa de'i gnad dang / las bum 'deg pa ni/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad par bsam pa de'i gnad dang / bkra shis brjod pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod par bsam pa de'i gnad kyis yin par snang bas 'bring po re legs kyang snang / thugs kyi rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /zhes lan gsum gyi gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa ni/ rigs pa'i dbang lnga'i skabs su/ re re la nang gi dbang dang / phyi'i dbang dang / dbang gi rtogs pas brjod pa gsum du yod pa las/

dang po mi bskyod pa chu dbang gi ngag 'don ni/ oṃ swa bhā wā shud+dhaḥ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin sogs kyi/ /gsol ba btab ste chu dbang cod pan sogs/ /yongs rdzogs rang rang gsol btab yin pa'am/ /'on te nang dbang so so'i gsol btab yin/ /rigs dbang lnga sku gsung thugs sogs kyi/ /'don pa bsgyur ba'i gsol btab 'di ltar na/ /slob dpon rigs lnga so so'i rnam pa ru/ /go 'phos dgos pa'i bshad pa ma yin nam/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ ji ltar sangs rgyas sogs kyis slob ma'i dbang spyir gsol gdab song bas rigs dbang so so la gsol gdab mi dgos so snyam na 'gal ba med de/ so so'i gsol gdab 'di nang dbang so so'i sngon 'gro tsam yin pas so/ /rig dbang phyi ma rnams kyi sngon 'gro nang dbang so sor yang / de nyid bla ma dkyil 'khor kyi dbus ni gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs pa 'ba' zhig ngag 'don la mdzad pas/ de ltar na bla ma go mi 'pho bar/ gtso bo'i rnam pa can du bzhugs pa la/ rigs lnga so so'i yon tan gyi ldog pa tshang ba'i sgo nas dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin sogs kyis gsol ba gdab pa la 'gal ba med de/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo ni/ rigs lnga so sor phyi na mi bskyod pa'i rigs gtso che yang / don la rigs lnga char gyi yon tan gyi ldog pa ma lus pa tshang ba'i rigs kun gyi bdag por bya rig pa yin no/ /sar+b+ba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shudho3haṃ/ rang nyid mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum mā ma kī sngon mo/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ de nyid bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi zhal nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar 'thon pa/

dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa las rje btsun 'jam dpa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser ral gri dang po ti bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog char sprin gyi mdog ltar nag cing / zhes pa nas/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /de'i pang nas yum rdo rje ro langs ma/ zhes pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de'i mig tu byang chub sems dpa' sa yi snying po/ rna bar phyag na rdo rje/ snar nam mkha'i snying po/ lcer 'jig rten dbang phyug dpral bar sgrib pa rnam sel/ lte bar kun tu bzang po/ spyi bor sku rdo rje/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje/ slar yang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum gyi rnam par/ nang dbang bskur tshe slar yang gtso bo yi/ /thugs ka'i 'od 'phros ye lha spyan 'dren pa'i/ /ngag 'don lhan thabs nang du bshad snang ba/ /slar yang zhes pa'i tshig nus ji ltar 'chad/ /ces pa'i lan ni/ thog mar 'od zer gyi thugs kar drangs nas yum gyi mkhar babs te 'jigs byed sogs su bskyed pa la slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa yin no// spyan drangs/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam pas rang nyid yum gyi pad+mar rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas zhugs te gnyis su med par gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ yum gyi pad+ma nas phyir 'thon te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'khod par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wā shūd+dhas/

dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ skad cig gis mi bskyod pa/ rang nyid yum gyi pad+ma nas thon rjes/ dkyil 'khor dbus dang lho ba'i lag sogs su/ /'khod tshe dkyil 'khor lha dang dbyer med du/ /'dres ba yin nam gnad gzhan ji ltar 'chad/ /ces pa'i lan ni/ des tshe dbang gi dbus kyi re mig gi dbus drang po na/ mdun bskyed gyi gtso bo bzhugs kyang re mig de'i gong thams cad mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo des sgrib pa ma khebs pa med pas slob ma dang dbang rdzas re mig dbus ma'i nang du 'khod pa la skyon gyi klan ka med do/ /de bzhin du lho'i re mig gi lag steng du ser sna gshin rje gshed bzhugs kyang lag pa'i gdan de rgya che bar yod pa lho'i lag steng du/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas 'khod pa la blo la mi bde ba mi dgos so// sku mdog sngon po zhes pa nas/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar dang / de yongs su gyur pa las dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog char sprin gyi mdog ltar nag cing zhes pa nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam pas zhes dang / dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu yum gyi pad+mar rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas zhugs te/ zhes pa nas/ yum gyi pad+ma nas phyir 'thon pa'i dbang rdzas kyi rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bum pa'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /bum lugs 'dir dbang rdzas lha la dbang bskur dang / /rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab mi snang / /ye shes gzhug dang dbang bskur dus mnyam mam/ /'on te rgyas gdab rten med nyid du 'dod/ /ces pa'i lan ni/

phyi dbang sngon dang nang dbang rjes la yod tshe yan lag bzhi rdzogs dngos su yod kyang / 'dir nang dbang sngon la byas pas ye shes pa gzhug pa dang lhan cig rgyas gdab zo las dngos su mi snang ngo // pa'i dbang mchog blang bar mdzod/ /bum pa dbu rgyan rdo rje sogs kyi dbang / /blang bar mdzod cig tshig rnams rigs dbang lnga/ / bskur bar gdams pa tsam mam skur tshig dngos/ /gang yin mkhas pa dag gis dpyad pa'i gnas/ /gal te bskur bar gdams pa tsam yin na/ /'di skabs dbang rdzas thogs pa bshad 'di ci/ /'on te bsdu tshig yin na de tsam gyis/ /dbang don 'phrod par khas len bum pa ci/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ 'di ni dbang bskur bar gdams pa tsam las dbang bskur dngos ma yin no// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mi bskyod pas gtso byas pa'i rigs lnga yum bzhi/ sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbarjod pas dbang gi lha/ /spyan 'dren tshul 'di dbang chur bshad mod kyi/ /de lta na yang tshig de'i bsam bya dang / /shes byed khung dang 'brel ba dgos pa dgos/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ 'di skabs kyi bsam bya dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu zhag sgrogs dril bu'i rnam pa can spros nas dbang lha mdun gyis nam mkhar spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ spyan 'dren gyi tshig yin pa'i shes byed kyi sbyong rgyud na gsal lo// rigs lngas byin gyis rlob yum bzhi'i bum pa thogs te/ dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che/ /khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /gsang ba gsum ni 'byung ba'i gnas/ /byin cig sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /oṃ badz+ra u ta ka a bhi ṣiñca su ra taṃ satwaṃ a hāṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/

/sems can ma lus kun gyi rang bzhin mchog gyur pa/ /skyed byed gyis bskyed bde ba 'byung ba ji lta ba/ /de ltar dbang bskur mchog gi deng 'dir bkra shis shog /lha mo rnams kyis oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang / rig ma rnams kyis oṃ sa twa su saṃ gra ha/ badz+ra rat+na ma nu ta raṃ/ badz+ra dhar+m+ma gā ya mi/ badz+ra kar+m+ma ka rod bha we/ khro bo rnams kyis/ oṃ āḥbighān ta krita hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lus ngag yid gsum la gnas pa'i bgegs bskrad/ dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun de spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar song / rkang mthil yan chad gang / sgrib pa dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams rang gi lus la thim pa ni/ rnam par shes pa la mi bskyod pa/ gzugs kyi phung po la rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba la rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'du shes la snang ba mtha' yas/ 'du byed la don yod grub pa/ sa yi khams la sangs rgyas spyan ma/ chu'i khams la mā ma kī/ me'i khams la gos dkar mo/ rlung gi khams la dam tshig sgrol ma/ mig la sa'i snying po/ rna bar phyag na rdo rje/ snar nam mkha'i snying po/ lcer spyan ras gzigs/ lus la sgrib pa rnam sel/ yid la kun tu bzang po/ lha mo drug po gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la thim/ tho ba gshin rje gshed lag pa g.yas/ dbyug pa gshin rje gshed rkang pa g.yas/ pad+ma gshin rje gshed rkang pa g.yon/ ral gri gshin rje gshed lag pa g.yon pa la thim/ de ltar phung khams skye mched lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin mi bskyod pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha bstim pa'i skabs/ /gshed po bzhi ma gtogs pa'i khro bo dang / /sems dpa'i nang tshan byams pa 'jam dbyangs gnyis/ /gang la thim gyi gsal kha mi snang cing /

/zhes pa'i lan ni/ 'dir gsal kha mi snang yang / bla med gzhan gyi nyams len las/ yid 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ tshig kun tu bzang po/ rtsa byams pa zhes dang / zhal rta mgrin/ rdo rje bdud rtsi thal sbyor/ dpung pa g.yas pa mi g.yo ba/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i 'gros sbyar na/ rang rang gi byang gzhi'i gtso bo gang du yod pa der bstim pa las 'os med do/ /'di bar gyis mchod/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar na dbang bskur ba lnga las chu'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga las zhe sdang gi sgrib pa dag phung po lnga las rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga las me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ sku lnga las mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag go /zhes brjod/ gnyis pa dbu brgyan gyi dbang la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dpal ldan yon tan rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /yon tan rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /ces lan gsum/ gnyis pa la gsum las dang po ni/ swa bhā wa brjod/ rang nyid mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ de nyid bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi zhal nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam las yum gyi pad+mar 'thon pa dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa las rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser ral gri dang po ti bsnams pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing / zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de yongs rigs dbang phyi ma rnams su lha bskyed skabs/ /rgyu yi 'jam dpal sngon du btang ba las/ /gshin rje gshed bzhir bskyed 'di bdag bskyed dang /

/'gal ba min nam tshad ldan gang nas bshad/ /ces pa'i lan ni/ lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i mngon rtogs ni/ 'khor rnams la rgyu'i 'jam dpal gyis bshad tshod med pa la/ dbang gi skabs su rigs bzhi la rgyu'i 'jam dpal bshad pa ni/ bdag skyed kyi skabs dang cung zad 'gal bar dgos la/ 'on kyang chu dbang gi tshe rgyu'i 'jam dpal las byung bas/ de'i 'bros rigs dbang phyi ma rnams la yang sbyar ba yin zer ba las 'os med dam snyam ste dpyad par bya'o// su gyur pa las rang nyid ser sna gshin rje gshed sku mdog ser po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser ba/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ ces pa nas/ g.yon gsum pas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ ces pa'i bar bskyed/ de'i mig tu byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje/ slar yang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ser sna gshin rje gshed yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam pas rang nyid yum gyi pad+mar ser sna gshin rje gshed yab yum du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas zhugs te gnyis su med par gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ yum gyi pad+ma nas phyir 'thon te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho'i lag pa'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ yang / swa bhā was/ dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dbang rdzas dbu rgyan/ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ rin 'byung ser po mchog sbyin dang mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ 'od dpag dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ don yod grub pa ljang gu skyabs sbyin dang mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon dang mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can rnams su gyur/

de rnams bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi zhal du zhugs zhes pa nas/ gsum pas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ de'i mig tu byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po zhes pa nas/ byang chub gyi sems kyi rnam pas dbang rdzas dbu rgyan yum gyi pad+mar ser sna gshin rje gshed yab yum du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas zhugs te gnyis su med par gyur/ yum gyi pad+ma nas phyir 'thon pa'i dbang rdzas kyi ser sna gshin rje gshed yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dbu rgyan dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /dbu rgyan dbang mchog blang bar mdzod/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi snying ga na 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ rigs lngas byin gyis brlabs/ yum bzhis bum pa thogs te/ sangs rgyas kun dngos cod pan dbang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid rab bsgrub phyir/ /cod pan mchog gis dbang bskur bas/ /'khor los bsgyur rgyal mgon dbang bskur/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra rat+na ku la mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca su ra ta stāṃ a haṃ/ dbu rgyan gyon/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rig ma rnams kyis glu blangs/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badz+ra ud da ka a bhi ṣiñca su ra ta satwaṃ a ho/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyi gtso byas pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha rnams rang gi phung khams skye mched so so la thim pas rang nyid rin chen 'byung ldan gyi skur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar na dbang bskur ba lnga las dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/

nyon mongs pa lnga las nga rgyal dang ser sna'i sgrib pa dag phung po lnga las tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ sku lnga las rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo ser sna gshin rje gshed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag go /gsum pa rdo rje'i dbang la gnyis las dang po ni/ dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /gsung gi rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /lan gsum/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ swa bha was bsangs/ rang nyid mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang / zhes sogs nas bzung gong bzhin la/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'dod chags gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po nas/ gsum pa na 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ ces pa'i bar bskyed/ de'i mig tu nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ces pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ bla ma dang sogs gong bzhin la/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed yab yum du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas zhes sogs dang / gnyis pa ni/ phyir 'thon te dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu rgyu ma'i steng du 'khod/ swa bha was/ dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po sogs nas/ yum gyi pad+ma nas zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ phyir 'thon pa'i dbang rdzas kyi 'dod chags gshin rje gshed yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje'i dbang mchog blang bar mdzod/

/dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi snying ka nas sogs gong bzhin la/ yum bzhis bum pa thogs te/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje mchog gis dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a ti pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod sogs gong bzhin la/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ nas/ so so la thim pas kyi bar gong bzhin la/ rang nyid 'od dpag med kyi skur gyur/ mchod pas mchod/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar na dbang bskur ba lnga las rdo rje'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga las 'dod chags kyi sgrib pa dag phung po lnga las 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga las so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ sku lnga las 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag go /bzhi pa dril bu'i dbang la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dpal ldan phrin las rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /'phrin las rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /lan gsum/ gnyis pa la gsum las dang po ni/ swa bha was sbyang / rang nyid mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad gcig gis don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa sogs gong bzhin la/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid phrag dog gshin rje gshed sogs dang / nor bu 'dzin pa'i bar/ de'i mig tu nas/ thugs rdo rje'i bar/ slar yang nas/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ zhes sogs/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed yab yum du gsal ba'i zhes pa tsam ma gtogs gong bzhin la/ gnyis pa ni/ phyir 'thon te dkyil 'khor gyi byang du rkang pa'i steng du 'khod/

swa bhā was/ dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis don yod grub pa'i sogs nas/ yum gyi pad+ma nas zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ phyir 'thon pa'i dbang rdzas kyi phrag dog gshin rje gshed yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /dril bu'i dbang mchog blang bar mdzod/ /dzaḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ yum bzhis bum pa thogs te bar gong bzhin la/ dril bu 'di ni dril bu che/ /chos kyi dril bu bla med don/ /stong nyid ye shes sgra sgrog pa/ /dril bu'i dbang bskur bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ā/ a hi ta sa ma ya bha ga wan/ me pan ni/ hi to bha wan/ byang chub sems sogs gong bzhin la/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan zhes dang / rang nyid don yod grub pa'i skur gyur/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyi mchod/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar na dbang bskur ba lnga las dril bu'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga las phrag dog gi sgrib pa dag phung po lnga las 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga las bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ sku lnga las don yod grub pa'i ngo bo phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag go /lnga pa mig dbang la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /sku yi rdo rje bdag mdzod cig /lan gsum/ gnyis pa la gsum las dang po ni/ swa bhā wa brjod/ rang nyid mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ zhes sogs gong bzhin las/

de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid gti mug gshin rje gshed nas/ pad+ma 'dzin pa'i bar bskyed/ de'i mig tu nas/ thugs rdo rje'i bar/ slar yang sogs gong bzhin la/ gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ zhes dang / gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum du gsal ba'i zhes 'don pa bsgyur nas/ gnyis pa ni/ phyir 'thon te dkyil 'khor gyi shar du mgo bo'i steng du 'khod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /ming gi dbang mchog blang bar mdzod/ /dzaḥhūm̐ nas/ yum bzhi'i bum pa thogs te/ bar gong bzhin la/ rdor dril lhan cig tu g.yas kyis bzung nas/ spyi bor dkrol la/ ming gi dbang bskur chen po mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i ming / /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a ti pa ti satwaṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣe k+ta sa ma ya shrīḥhūm̐/ rang gi gsang ming dran tsam byas la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sogs gong bzhin la/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes dang / rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur gyur zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyi mchod/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar na dbang bskur ba lnga las ming gi dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga las gti mug gi sgrib pa dag phung po lnga las gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga las chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ sku lnga las rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag go /gshin rje gshed rigs lnga char 'jam dpal las bskyed pa dang / dbang rdzas lnga char la nang dbang bskur ba rnams rwa lugs kyi zab khyad yin pas/ gzhan dang gzhan dag gis rgyas mi 'gebs shing bsre bar mi bya'o/ /rigs drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang la/ nang dbang bskur ba sogs med pas/

rang nyid skad cig gis rigs lnga'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa mā ya satwaṃ e ṣa dha ra ya mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing rdo rje lag tu byin la snying kar bzung nas/ snying kha'i nang du rdo rje sems dpa' ma bral bar bsgom pa ni/ ma rig pa nyon mongs pa lnga dang / phung po lnga sbyangs nas/ rig pa ye shes lnga dang sku lnga ru byas pa ni/ rigs pa'i dbang lnga ste/ rdo rje slob ma'i las thams cad la dbang bar byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dbang la bzhi las/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa'i rjes su/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs brjod/ kye ho khyed kyi bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la rang dang gzhan gyi don/ /rdzogs phyir rdo rje slob dpon dbang / /thugs rje'i stobs dang ldan pas sbyin/ /mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /mgon pos bdag la stsal nas kyang / /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon phrin las yongs su bzung / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa bsrung ba bla med pa/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rtag tu slob dpon bdag 'gyur gsung / /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rang nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser ral gri dang po ti bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

de'i thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyem ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsum du bdag sgrubs shig /lan gsum/ de nyid bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gsal ba'i yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi bha gar babs pas/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyem ma sku mdog sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ de'i mig tu byang chub sems dpa' sa yi snying po nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje/ slar yang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen po yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam pas/ rang nyid yum gyis pad+mar rdo rje dang yab yum du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas zhugs te gnyis su med par gyur/ yum gyi bha ga nas phyir 'thon/ sngar gyi dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'khod/ gnyis pa brtul shugs dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje lag pa g.yas su gtad par bsams la/

'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /phyag na rdo rje'i lag tu gtad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu chongs/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing / rdo rje smin mtshams du g.yas su lan gsum gsor nas snying kar bzung / thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyem bdag bdag po'i tshul/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /rdo rje snying kar 'gying ba dang bcas bzung / thog ma dang tha ma dang bral ba'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig tu shes par gyis la zungs shig ces brjod/ a las byung ba'i dril bu gtad pa/ lag pa g.yon pas dkrol la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu chongs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bshad/ /oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ā/ dril bu dku g.yon par kha gyen du bstan nas bzung la/ āḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa dam par byed par 'gyur/ /srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa bsten par byed pa dril bu gsung gi dam tshig tu shes par gyis la zungs shig rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen por gsal ba'i pang du/ yum nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ nu ma rgyas pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa gcig dang mnyam par sbyor bar gyur/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes gnang ba byin la/ phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/

/shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /rnam dag par ni byed pa yin/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni brten bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor ba/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su grags/ /yid kyis lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /phyag rgya 'di ni snang stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo sku'i dam tshig tu shes par gyis la zungs shig de ltar na/ rdo rje rig stong dbyer med thugs/ dril bu grags stong dbyer med gsung / phyag rgya snang stong dbyer med sku yi dam tshig ste/ brtul zhugs dam tshig gsum dang mi 'bral ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzod cig ces brjod/ gsum pa dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yum bzhi/ rdo rje thugs dang thugs kyi dam tshig dang / /dril bu gsung dang gsung gi dam tshig sogs/ /khyad par med na phyag rgya sku yi rjes/ /phyag rgya'i de nyid brjod 'di ji ltar 'thad/ /ces pa'i lan ni/ rang gi bsam tshod ni bla med kyi dkyil chog spyi ltar ni/ rdo rje thugs dang thugs kyi dam tshig la khyad par phye dgos shing phyi ma gnyis la yang 'gre la/ 'dir de dag 'dres par snang mod/ 'on kyang don la 'gal ba med de/ thog mtha' dang bral ba'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje thugs su bshad nas/ de de ltar yin pa'i sgrub byed du/ rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje'i de kho na nyid brjod pa byung nas/ 'phral du sgrub bya sgrub byed kyi rim pa ma gtogs don brtags na gcig tu babs pas/ rwa chen po'i gsung 'di dag la ni don la 'khrul pa'i dri ma ye med do// sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rigs lngas byin gyis rlobs/

yum bzhis bum pa thogs te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las 'byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta ud ta ka a bhi ṣiñca su ra ta satwaṃ a haṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis gang zhig sogs nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbu brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha rnams rang gi lus la thim pa ni rnam par shes pa la mi bskyod pa/ zhes pa nas/ ral gri gshin rje gshed lag pa g.yon pa la thim/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin dang / de ltar phung po khams skye mched lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis me tog gi char 'bebs shing khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol bar gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing rang gi spyi bor me tog gtor/ bzhi pa dag pa brjod pa ni/ gzhal yas dkyil 'khor lha gnyis so sor phye ba yis/ /bshad tshul ltar na lha rnams bzhugs pa'i brten/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi'i gzhal yas khang nyid la/ /dkyil 'khor ces byar 'jog pa mi rigs sam/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ dkyil chog phal cher las/ dkyil 'khor gyis de kho na nyid dang lha'i de kho na nyid gnyis so sor bshad pa dang / gsol btab du yang / 'khor lo lha'i de nyid dang / /zhes dang / brtag gnyis su yang / dkyil 'khor dang dkyil 'khor can zhes pa'i rnam gzhag so sor bshad cing / dbang chu 'dir yang / gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dag pa la dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang / lha'i dag pa la lha'i de kho na nyid du gsungs pas/ rten gzhal yas khang nyid la dkyil 'khor dang / brten pa lha rnams la dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i dkyil 'khor can zhes 'jog pa yin no//

khang pa ni/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa lam gyi chos rnam par dag pa yin la/ dur khrod ni lus dang 'jig rten gyi chos rnam par dag pa yin zhing / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'o/ /zhes dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang / lha rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang / yon tan dang phrin las thams cad dag pa'i ngo bo yin zhing / zhes lha'i de kho na nyid dang / de thams cad rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs la tshang ba'o/ /dag pa brjod skabs lha dang dkyil 'khor gnyis/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la tshang zhes pa'i/ /ngag 'don 'di la 'bru 'grel ji ltar 'chad/ /rim bzhin sku dang thugs la tshang yin nam/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ dbang chu'i dpe kha cig tu/ sku dang thugs la tshang zhes pa 'byung yang / da lta 'don bya la sku gsung thugs la tshang ngo zhes pa mdzad la/ rang gi blo tshod ni/ dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang pa ni sems rnam par dag pa yin pas/ bla ma'i thugs la tshang / lha rnams ni phung khams skye mched rnam par dag pa yin pas/ sku la tshang / de bas na gsung la tshang rgyu'i ngos 'dzin zur pa mi 'thad snyam du sems so/ /zhes brjod pa slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid do/ /gsum pa mtha' brten rjes gnang la/ bco lnga las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las mched pa'i sku zhig thim par bsam la/ nyin re bzhin du dus bzhi ru/ /'dod lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa/ /gyur na mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub 'dod phyir yi dam zung / /zhes sku'i rjes gnang dang / gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba spros pas rang gi khar zhugs thugs ka nas sngags 'khor gyi yig 'bru rnams la thim par gyur/ nye snying snying po rtsa sngags tshar gsum re brjod cing / me tog cung zad gtor la/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/

/bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsung gi rjes gnang dang / gsum pa ni/ gri gug g.yas su byin par bsam la/ gri gug gi phyag rgya dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi gri gug che/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /las kyi gri gug dam pa 'di/ /rmongs pa'i mgo bo gcod phyir khyer/ /g.yon du thod pa byin par bsams la/ thod pa 'dzin tshul dang / dngos dang dngos med rnam rtog gi /mgo bo pad+ma'i snod du ni/ /bdud rnams rnam pa bzhi yi khrag /dngos grub phyir ni btung bar bya/ /zhes thugs kyi rjes gnang dang / bzhi pa ni/ lag pa g.yas su thod dbyug byin par bsam la/ dbyug pa 'phyar tshul dang / rdo rje thod dbyug dbyug pa'i sgras/ /bdud dang gshin rje 'dar zhing 'gyel/ /khams gsum ma lus 'joms pa yi/ /dpa' bo'i mtshan ma 'di zungs shig /ces las gshin dam rtags kyi rjes gnang dang / lnga pa ni/ sdug pa'i gdong du bltas nas ni/ /bltas par gyur pa'i bde ba de/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phul na ni/ /skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur/ /bud med kun gyis yongs bskor la/ /kun nas brtse ba'i bde ba de/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phul na ni/ /skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur/ /dge ba'am yang na mi dge ba'i/ /las rnams byas pa gang yin pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phul na ni/ /skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur/ /ces brjod pa'i rjes gnang dang / drug pa ni/ mchog gi dngos grub thams cad ni/ /brtul zhugs mchog gis bsgrub par bya/ /de phyir gshin rje 'joms pa yis/ /brtul zhugs rnam pa kun tu spyod/ /phal cher dngos grub mchog rnams ni/ /brtul zhugs med na mi 'grub pas/ /gshin rje 'joms pa'i brtul zhugs 'di/ /legs spyod mchog gi dngos grub sgrubs/ /zhes brtul zhugs kyi rjes gnang dang / bdun pa ni/ ji ltar dbang bskur la sogs pas/ /sangs rgyas la sogs thob pa bzhin/

/byang chub spyod tshogs gzhan rnams dang / /'dul sogs dge bas de ltar min/ /de bas dam tshig bus srung shig /rtag tu sdom pa yang bsrung ngo / /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' zhing / /de las gzhan pa'i dam tshig bsrung / /dkon mchog gnod pa gsad bya zhing / /bud med kun la spyad par bya/ /pha rol nor ni blang bya zhing / /rtag tu brdzun gyi tshig kyang smos/ /rnal 'byor rgyud las gang gsungs pa/ /de yang cho ga bzhin du srungs/ /rnal 'byor rgyud las gang gsungs cho ga bzhin/ /bsrung rgyu'i ngos 'dzin gang yin rnam 'byor rgyud/ /rgyud sde bzhi ru phye ba'i gsum pa'am/ /'on te thabs kyi rgyud la 'jog gam ci/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ dkon mchog gnod pa gsad bya zhing / /bud med kun la spyad par bya/ /zhes sogs gzhan don du gdug pa can bsgral ba dang / mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bud med kun la spyad pa sogs blang bya yin pa des dmigs bsal gyi tshul du bstan nas/ spyir btang yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud las/ khyod kyi srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin pa yang blang mi bya/ /brdzun dang 'dod log spyod pa rnams/ /dngos grub 'dod pas bya ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi rtsa ba bzhi yang / gzhan don gyi ched sogs dgag dgos med par bya ba ni/ srog la babs kyang bsrung ngo zhes ston pa la/ rnal 'byor rgyud la gang gsungs pa/ /de yang cho ga bzhin du gsungs/ /zhes pa 'di byung ba yin no/ /'di rgyud sde bzhi ru phye ba'i gsum pa de rang yin no/ /zhes dam tshig gi rjes gnang dang / brgyad pa ni/ rdo rje mig la byugs pa'i rnam pa dang / ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hri praṃ/ zhes mig thur gyi rjes gnang dang / dgu pa ni/ me long gi ngos su bltas la/ āḥchos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/

/dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag 'byung / /rdo rje 'jigs byed de nyid ni/ /me long gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs pa/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la gnas/ /khyod ni 'dren pa'i spyan ldan pas/ /ngo bo med cing gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /zhes mig thur me long gnyis ni sems can don byed kyi rjes gnang dang / bcu pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa'i lag pa gnyis khu tshur kha gyen du bstan nas/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ rkang pa gnyis kyi bar du 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra bha ga raṃ/ g.yas su dung / oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ g.yon du dril bu/ āḥ pang du po ti rnams byin par bsams la/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med pa/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun tu dri med gang bar gyis/ /zhes dung dang / yangs pa'i pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i rigs lnga so so'i phyag mtshan bcas la/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du tshig rkang gong 'og gsum ma 'dra ba la/ rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen 'khor lo pad+ma'i 'khor lo sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes chos bshad kyi rjes gnang dang / bcu gcig pa ni/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /phyi lam de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar bsgrub par gyis/ /zhes dngos grub kyi rjes gnang dang / bcu gnyis pa ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu byin par bsam la/ zhi ba'i sems kyis zhi ba ste/ /nad la sogs pa zhi bar byed/ /rgyas pa'i sems kyis rgyas pa ste/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byed/ /rin chen char sprin rab bskor bya/ /rjes su chags pa'i sems kyis ni/

/dbang gi las ni yang dag bsgrub/ /bsad pa'i sems kyis drag po ste/ /me yi char sprin dbab par bya/ /zhes phrin las bzhi'i rjes gnang dang / bcu gsum pa ni/ khaṃ las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ral gri byin par bsams la 'phyar tshul dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /las kyi ral gri gcig pu'i mchog /bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir zung / /oṃ badz+ra kharga hūm̐/ zhes ral gri'i rjes gnang dang / bcu bzhi pa ni/ ho las byung ba'i mda' lnga gzhu gcig byin par bsams la/ chos rnams thabs dang shes rab tu/ /gzhu dang mda' yis rnam mtshon te/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi 'bral bar/ /tshar gcod pa dang rjes su zung / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ya swa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ya mi/ zhes brjod la mda' gzhu lag pa gnyis kyis phyogs mtshams steng 'og tu bskor ba'i phyag rgya bya/ zhes mda' gzhu'i rjes gnang dang / bco lnga pa ni/ bsgral bar gyur pa'i yul rnams ni/ /'khrul 'khor dang ni ting nge 'dzin/ /sman gyis kyang ni bya ba ste/ /de ltar thabs rnams sna tshogs kyis/ /bsad bskrad dbye mnan rengs rmugs dang / /tshar gcod rjes gzung las mdzod cig /ces drag po'i rjes gnang ngo / /dngos grub phrin las bzhi drag po'i rjes gnang rnams la tshig tsam gyis chog de ltar na dkyil 'khor bzhi las phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ dbang bzhi las bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ sgrib pa bzhi las lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sgrib pa dag bskur ba'i gnas ni spyi bos mtshon pa'i lus la bskur/ bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang bar byas/ bla ma sprul pa'i skur dmigs pa las dbang blangs/ dpe zhing sa shin tu sbyangs pa dang 'dra/ sprul sku thob rung gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o/ /bum dbang cha lag dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa gsang dbang la bzhi las/ dang po ni/

maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa'i mjug tu/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du sogs brjod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/ /bdag gis bla med byang chub thob/ /de phyir gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /mgon pos rjes su gzung bar mdzod/ /ces lan gsum/ mig dar 'ching ba'i stangs ka tsam byas la/ a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa ni/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / phyag rgya rdo rje ro langs mar gsal ba'i mig tu sa yi snying po nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje'i bar dang / yab kyi gsang gnas nas/ gnyis ka'i bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ skye mched sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams dang / bla ma rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ bde ba'i sgra ha ha si si kun du ru badz+ra dh+rika ces bya ba'i sgra byung bas/ gshin rje gshed rigs lnga yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ srog dag pa'i lam nas brgyud thabs kyi rdo rje las 'thon/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ta badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems yum gyi pad+ma las phyung nas/ bla ma rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mthe bong dang srin lag gis rang gi lce thog tu bzhag gsum pa ni/ btung ba rin chen dam pa 'di/ /rdo rje'i lus ni sgrub byed par/ /bu khyod rtag par shes gyis la/ /yid las byung ba'i chu 'di 'thung / /oṃ badz+ra dh+rika hūm̐/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing 'thung nas lus sems thams cad bde bas gang / e ma bde ba chen po'o/ /zhes spyan drangs nas rang nyid gsung rnam par dag pa 'dod chags gshin rje gshed du sgom/

rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dbyings su dag cing gsal stong gi ye shes bskyed par bsams la/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag 'dis bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo zhes pa nas/ e ma bde ba chen po'o/ /zhes pa'i bar shib bur brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar dgrol ba'i stangs ka byas/ bzhi pa ni/ g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa seng ge'i rna ba ltar byas la/ g.yas rdor dril bsnol nas lag pas spyi bor skrol zhing / steng phyogs su brkyangs nas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas la/ srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las ston/ /srid pa mchog tu zhi ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /'di ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa mā ya satwaṃ/ bhur+bhu wa swa/ ngas lung bstan pa 'di la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis lung bstan par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang / phyag rgya'i stobs zab mo 'di la dad par gyis shig dbang gi rtogs pa brjod pa ni/ de ltar na dkyil 'khor bzhi las bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ dbang bzhi las gsang ba'i dbang thob/ sgrib pa bzhi las ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sgrib pa dag bskur ba'i gnas ni lces mtshon pa'i ngag la bskur/ rang byin gyis brlabs pa sgom pa la dbang / bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur dmigs pa las dbang blang / dpe zhing sa shin tu sbyangs pa la sa bon btab pa dang 'dra/ longs sku thob rung gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la gsum las/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur skabs su slob ma rnams/ rdo rje 'jigs byed nyid du bsgoms pa'o/ /'on te lha gzhan gang du bskyed pa yin/ /'di la yig char gsal kha gzigs sam cing / /slob ma 'dod chags gshin rje gshed bsgoms la/

/mig dar 'ching phye zhes dbang chur gsung 'di ni/ /dgongs pa gang yin dgos pa ji ltar yod/ /'di nyid ma byas kyang ni chog gam ci/ /gsang dbang bla ma yab yum snyoms zhugs las/ /byung ba'i byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /bskur ba min nam bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bskur bar bshad la go ba ji ltar yod/ /ces pa'i lan ni/ dbang chu na gsal kha mi snang yang / bum dbang gi mtha' brten lha bsgom pa'i rjes gnang sbyin pa nas slob ma rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal bar gyur pas/ de'i rgyun da lta yang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi nga rgyal las 'os med pa yin no/ /dbang chur slob ma 'dod chags gshin rje gshed du bsgoms pa la mig dar phye zhes pa tsam las mi snang yang / rgya rton gyi dbang gi yig sna las/ dbang rdzas byang chub kyi sems med pas lus thams cad gang / ngag gi dri ma dag nas 'dod chags gshin rje gshed du bsgoms nas/ gdong g.yogs phye zhes gsungs pas/ dbang rdzas mgrin pa nas myangs pa la brten/ ngag gi dri ma dag nas slob ma gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo 'dod chags gshin rje gshed du gyur par bsams la/ gdong g.yogs phye ba yin te/ bya ba dang byed las 'brel chags par snang ngo / /dkyil chog gzhan ltar na/ byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i tha snyad byed/ de bas mgrin pa nas myang ste lus la khyab pas/ dus gsum gyi rtog pa rags pa 'gag ste/ myong ba khyad par can skyes pa na gsang dbang thob pa yin pas/ rdzas gsang ba byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du bskur bar 'chad dgos la/ 'dir bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du bskur bar bshad pa ni/ dbang rdzas bsgrub pa na yum gyi mkha' dang / yab kyi rdo rje mnyam par sbyar nas sgrub pa la dgongs pa'o/ /yang na bla ma yab yum snyoms 'jug byas pa las byung ba'i gsang rdzas byang chub kyi sems te/ sngar snyoms 'jug gi sgras rigs lnga yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/
