yab kyi zhal du zhugs pa sogs las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems yin pas/ rnam pa byang chub kyi sems su gnas kyang / ngo bo bha ga red/ bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga yab yum kyi dkyil 'khor yin pas/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du bskur zhes bshad pa yin te/ bha ga ni bcom pa dang skal ba sogs mang po la 'jug pa'o// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ 'bru lngas mig dar 'ching / 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ bla ma rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis rang la phyag rgya zhig gnang ba'i srin lag g.yon nas rang gi g.yas kyi bzung bar mos la/ khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo/ /khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /zhes brjod la phyag rgya gtad do/ /de nas phyag rgya des/ rtog pa med dam zhes dri ba ni/ dri chen dri chu la sogs pa/ /btsog za de dag yid ches sam/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga la yang 'o byed par/ /bu khyod spro ba yin nam ci/ /zhes brjod/ rang gi lag pa nas dam du bzung ste lan btab par bsam la/ dri chen dri chu la sogs pa/ /btsog za de ltar yid ches so/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga la yang 'o byed par/ /lha mo bdag ni cis mi spro/ /zhes lan bya/ rang rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / phyag rgya rdo rje ro langs mar gsal ba'i mig tu sa'i snying po nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje bar/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs su 'dug la/ bla mas yab yum gyi srin lag g.yas pa bzung zhing gsung bar mos la/ gzungs ma 'di ni yid 'ong ma/

/bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis dgongs/ /'khor lo rim pas sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /zhes brjod/ de nas yum de gos dang bral te lag pa gnyis kyis/ dri zhim pos bgos pa'i pad+ma'i 'gram nas bzung ste che ba brjod pa/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /bde ba cho ga bzhin bsten pa/ /de yi mdun na nga gnas te/ /sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spangs pa/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /twaṃ bhañca mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes brjod nas/ pang du 'khyud/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs gong bzhin la/ gnyis ka'i spyi bor bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte ba la haṃ/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte ba la oṃ/ snying ka chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte ba la hūm̐/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte ba la oṃ/ gsang gnas bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte ba la phaṭa/ skye mched sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams sbyor bas mnyes par byas/ rang dang phyag rgya lha'i skur gsal bar gyur/ ha ha si si kun tu badz+ra dh+rika snyoms 'jug la sems bzung nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod par gyur/ yab kyi spyi bo'i haṃ las/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas babs te/ mgrin pa'i oṃ la phog pas dga' ba/ de snying kha'i hūm̐ la phog pas mchog dga'/ de lte ba'i oṃ la phog pas dga' bral/ de gsang gnas kyi phaṭa la phog pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par gyur/ hig ces brjod pas/ thig le de lte ba nas yar byon pas dga' ba/ snying kar byon pas mchog dga'/ mgrin par byon pas dga' bral/

spyi bor 'o ma lud pa bzhin lud de lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad la khyab pas bde chen gyi ye shes skyes/ de'i ngo bo byung gnas 'gro sa smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa don gyi ye shes lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o/ /mkha' gsang byin brlabs nas 'di'i bar shib bur brjod/ de nas bla ma rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis mdzad par bsams la/ dril gsil me tog gtor rol mo drag tu brdung / ā li kā li/ lan kha yar brjod do/ /ye shes de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos rdo rje'i glu'i sgo nas ngo sprod par bsam la/ e ma rnal 'byor pa yis ji srid du/ /byang sems 'byin par mi byed par/ /de srid thob 'gyur rgyun mi chad/ /dga' ba las skyes bde gzhan ci/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni lhung gyur na/ /phung po rnam shes brgyal ba las/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la yod/ /mkha' khams rdo rje'i kun sbyor dang / /reg bcas kyi ni rmad byung tshe/ /bde ba skyed par byed pa gang / /de ni bde chen mchog byed pa'o/ /dga' bral dag gi dbus su ni/ /mtshon pas ltos la brtan par bya/ /pad+ma'i nam mkhar rdo rje yi/ /lte bar gnas pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rdo rje skyil krung dag gi sems/ /nor bu'i nang du sems ltos la/ /ye shes skye ba gang yin de/ /ye shes ngo bo zhes pas brgyan/ /chags pa ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar dmigs pa ma yin no/ /gang tshe rnam shes ye shes mthong / /bde la gnas bya 'gyur mi bya/ /thun gcig yang na nyin gcig gam/ /zla phyed zla ba lo dang ni/ /bskal pa bskal pa stong du yang / /ye shes mngon sbyor gyis gnas bya/ /zhes brjod do/ /'bru gsum brjod cing mig dar dkrol/ gsum pa mtha' brten sbyin pa ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral ba/ /khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig

/bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyi nas shi ba yod min te/ /sdug bsngal srid las mya ngan 'das/ /srid pa gtan du mya ngan 'das/ /srid pa gtan du dngos grub 'gyur/ /rang bdag yongs su spangs nas ni/ /dka' thub dpyad par mi bya ste/ ji ltar bde ba bzung nas ni/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur bar/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris/ /khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas ni/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /sngags bshad tshul gyis cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu bshad/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan btags drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /ces dbugs dbyung ngo / /de ltar na dkyil 'khor bzhi las kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ dbang bzhi las shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sgrib pa bzhi las yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sgrib pa dag bskur ba'i gnas ni/ snying gas mtshon pa'i yid la bskur/ pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang / bla ma chos kyi skur dmigs pa las dbang blangs/ dpe zhing sa shin tu sbyangs pa la sa bon btab/ rkyen chu lud kyis bran pa dang 'dra/ chos sku thob rung gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o/ mchog dbang gsum pa shes rab ye shes dbang / dngos dang ye rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bskur ba min nam byang sems dkyil 'khor du/ /bskul bar bzhed la'ang go ba ji ltar yod/ /ces pa'i lan ni/ dkyil chog spyi ltar na phyag rgya dang mnyam sbyor gyi go don las bha ga'i dkyil 'khor zhes 'chad la/ 'dir ni rwa chen gyis kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du bskur bar bshad pa ni/ spyi bo'i haṃ las babs pa'i byang sems de gzugs su snang bas kun rdzob byang sems kyi tha snyad bya zhing /

byang sems de nyid kyis lus kyi rtsa 'khor thams cad khyab cing gang ba'i byed pas ye shes nyams su myong ba la/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi ngo bor 'jog pa 'di la dgongs pa yin no/ /dbang bzhi pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum 'bru lnga'i mig dar bcings/ 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun du bcas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos gsum pa'i ye shes de nyid bzhi pa'i tshig gis sgo nas ngo sprod mdzad par bsams la/ shib bu'i ngag gis/ brtan g.yo'i dngos po ma lus pa/ /bsgom par bya ba'i dus nyid na/ /blos ni yongs su mi sgom ste/ /kun gyi mtshan nyid ma shes na/ de kho na nyid sgom min te/ dngos po thams cad yongs shes nas/ de ni sgom par yongs su grags/ /zhes gsungs pa de'i don ni/ bzhi pa 'di la sogs pa gnas lugs ngo sprod gyi bzhi ba'i rigs can kun ni/ spyir sems kyi gnas lugs ngo sprod pa tsam dang mi 'dra pa'i khyad par chen po yod de/ spyir gnas lugs ngo sprod pa dang / gnas lugs rtogs pa'i lta ba dang 'brel ba'i dbang dang grol byed ni/ rgyud 'og ma gsum la yang yod cing / bla med rang gi dbang 'og ma rnams la yang yod la/ dbang bzhi pa 'dir gnas lugs ngo sprod pa ni/ gzhi dbang gi ye shes gyi steng du sprod pa sogs kyi khyad chos dang ldan dgos pas so/ /de yang gzhi gang gi steng du sprod pa ni brtag gnyis las/ ye shes 'di ni zhes pas dbang gsum pa'i dus su skyes pa'i ye shes kyi steng du ngo sprod pa bstan/ gnas lugs gang ngo sprod pa ni/ ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ /ces pas sangs rgyas rnams gyi thugs rgyud ji ltar bzhugs pa'i 'bras dus kyi gnas lugs nyid ngo sprod par bstan/

de ltar ngo 'phrod pa las phan yon gang 'byung ba ni/ khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes pas sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i gnas lugs zab mo de mngon du 'gyur ba bstan pa yin no/ /de ltar na brtag gnyis las/ bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes gsung pa las/ bzhi pa de yang / zhes pas mtshon bya don bstan/ de bzhin no/ /zhes pas mtshon byed dpe'i steng du mtshon bya don nyid ngo sprod pa bstan pas/ 'bras dus kyi mtshon bya don 'dir mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes gyi steng du ngo sprod dgos pa yin no/ /de la gnas lugs yul dang / ye shes yul can yin pas sngar bshad pa dang 'gal lo snyam na mi 'gal te/ gnas lugs bshad pa ni gnas lugs mjal ba'i blo 'byung bas/ phal sgras tsam la gnas lugs ngo sprad kyang / don la gnas lugs mjal ba'i ye shes de nyid ngo sprod par 'gro bas so/ /kha cig de bzhin no zhes pa dbang bzhi pa/ rgyud 'dir sbas pa'i shes byed du mdzad pa mthong yang / mtshon bya dang mtshon byed kyi bstan tshul sngar bshad pa de dpyod ldan gyis dgongs dgos shing / khyad par bla med spyi 'di la dbang bzhi pa dngos su bskur ba yod phyin dbang bzhis dngos su ston byed kyi rgyud tshig kyang yod pa sha stag tu nges so/ /mdor na dbang bzhis 'dir gsum pa'i ye shes kyi steng du 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ma lus pa sku gsum kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan ngo sprod tshul yang shes par bya ste/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi chad dang 'gog pa med/ /yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas 'di nyid ni/ /bdag 'dod tshad mas yongs bgos blo can rnams kyang 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gyi yan lag dang po gsum ni/ dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi lha sku mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa gsal la ma 'gag pas/

de yang yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa de'i thugs rgyud 'dzag med kyi bde bas gang ba dang gsum gyi steng du tshang bar ngo sprod/ yan lag bzhi pa rang bzhin med pa chos kyi sku ni/ bde ba'i de'i ngo bo la bltas ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pa sogs kyi spros pa'i mtha' gang du yang ma grub pa'i dbyings nam mkha' lta bu de'i steng du tshang bar ngo sprod/ yan lag lnga pa drug pa bdun pa sprul sku'i khyad chos rnams ni/ dbyings nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang las dmigs med kyi snying rjes rgyud yongs su gang ba dang / snying rje'i dbang gi sems can gyi don rgyun mi 'chad par byed pa dang / rgyun ma chad pas rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde'i 'gog pa med pa dang gsum gyi steng du tshang / de'i ngo bo na gsal stong zung 'jug brjod bral blo 'das phyag rgya chen po'i ngang las mnyam par gzhag 'bru gsum gyi gdong g.yogs byed/ gsum pa gzengs bstod pa ni/ de ring khyed bdag legs par rnyed/ /mi yi srid pa don dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs su skyes/ /sems nyid rin chen 'byung ba'i gter/ /phun sum tshogs pa nye bar gnas/ /gsang sngags mnyam med sems las grub/ /zag med bde ba'i dkyil 'khor che/ /mthong ba 'am ni zhugs gyur pas/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /byang chub sems mchog rmad byung brnyes/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gnas mchog /bdud bzhi 'joms shing sdug bsngal gyi/ /skye rga na 'chi 'joms par byed/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid dag pa/ /phyag na rdo rje da gyur te/ /de ltar na dkyil 'khor bzhi las don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ dbang bzhi las bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ sgrib pa bzhi las lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag bskur ba'i gnas ni snying khas mtshon pa'i lus ngag yid gsum la bskur/ phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang /

bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi skur dmigs pa las dbang blangs/ dpe zhing sa shin tu sbyangs pa la sa bon btab/ rkyen chu lud kyis bran/ 'bras bu ston thog phun sum tshogs pa dang 'dra/ ngo bo nyid sku thob rung gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o/ bum dbang zhing sa sbyangs dang gsang ba'i dbang / sa bon btab pa sogs kyi dpe 'di la/ /don dang mthun pa'i 'chad tshul ji ltar yod/ /gsang dbang dus su gang gis sa bon btab/ /sher dbang chu lud bran dang 'dra tshul cig /bzhi pa ston thog phun sum tshogs pa dang / /des don sbyor ba'i rda mtshan ji ltar yin/ /zab don gnad kyi bshad pa dgos par dogs/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ dbang gi ye shes skye ba rgyu sa bon dgos/ sa bon de yang zhing sa gshin pa la 'debs dgos pas/ thog mar phung khams skye mched la dag bya dag byed ngo sprod pa'i sgo nas bum dbang bskur te/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis bsdus pa'i phung khams skye mched rnams la ma dag pa tha mal du 'dzin pa sbyangs nas/ dag pa lha'i rnam rol du bsgyur ba ni dpe zhing sa sbyangs pa dang 'dra/ de nas bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems slob ma'i khar phyin pa/ mgrin pa na ya ra la wa'i dbyibs can gyi rtsa yod pa'i bar gyi byang sems rnams dang 'dres shing 'phel bas/ lus thams cad la khyab pa'i tshe gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i myong ba khyad par can skyes/ de tsam na dbang gi ye shes skye ba'i nyer lan gyi rgyu grub cing / grogs lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen dang 'phrad pa na skye ba la sngon du phyogs pas/ des sa bon btab pa dang 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin la/ de nas sher dbang bskur ba na phyag rgya gtad de/ 'du shes gsum ldan gyi sgo nas snyoms par zhugs pas/ sngar gsang dbang gi dus bla mas gnang ba'i byang sems lus thams cad la khyab cing 'dres pa'i byang sems kyi nus pa thams cad spyi bo'i haṃ la 'dus pa de las byang sems kyi rgyun babs te/

dga' bzhi nyams su myong zhing khyad par lhan skyes kyi ye shes nyams su myong ba ni gsang dbang gi dus su btab pa'i sa bon gyi nus pa de rdol ba yin pas/ des myu gu sngon po 'khrungs pa dang 'dra 'di dang ḍom+bi lugs gyi dbang chur gnyis su rkyen chu lud kyis bran pa dang 'dra ba bshad pa ni/ sher dbang gi cho gas sngar gsang dbang gi dus su thems pa'i sa bon de'i nus pa brdol ba'i lhan cig byed rkyen byed pa'i cha nas chu lud dang 'dra bar dgongs la/ cho ga'i lag rjes sher dbang dag gi ngo bo ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi myong ba gsar du skyes pa de yin pas/ myu gu 'thon pa dang dpe don sbyor ba legs so/ /de nas dbang bzhi pa bskur ba ni/ gsum pa'i ye shes de nyid la tshig gi sgo nas mthar thug 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyi gnas lugs kyi don ngo sprod pas/ sngar gyi ye shes de'i rgyun bskyangs pa las sku gsum yan lag bdun 'byung bar go zhing / khyad par ye shes de nyid kyi sangs rgyas rnams don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'bras dus kyi mtshon bya don gyi ye shes dang dbyer med ro gcig tu skyong lugs ngo 'phrod pas/ des 'bras bu ston thog phun sum tshogs pa dang 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin no// rjes kyi bya ba la bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /sogs lan gsum du brjod/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa rgyas pa'i mjug tu/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /sogs dang / deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum brjod/ de nas dbang blang ba'i yul dang / len pa po dang / len pa'i tshul gsum ka rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i ngang las/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs kas bzung / tshigs bcad kyi mtshams su dril bu bcad gtub tu dkrol zhing /

gdangs dang bcas pas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yi dkyil 'khor du/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bas slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur dgos na rwa chen dang rje rta ra ba sogs kyi gsung rab bzhin la bla ma dam pa'i phyag len gyis brgyan te bshad par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul tshul dang tshogs byed par spro na sngar sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ re zhig dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol mi byed na/ mchod pa rnams kha gso ba'am/ gsar pa bshams pa gang rung byas la/ phyi mchod sogs sta gon gyi rjes chog ltar dbul la/ gsum pa ni/ yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /ces dang / thal mo snying khar sbyar la/ bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa la sogs pa dang / sems sgrib pa dang ma bral ba'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / bying rgod du gyur pa dang / cho ga lhag pa dang / ma tshang ba thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/ zhes nongs pa bzod par gsol/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i nas/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa'i tshogs thams cad ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas pa'i bar du brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

zhes brjod/ gtor mgron gshegs gsol man sta gon dang 'dra'o/ /bzhi pa nub tha ma dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa gsar pa bzang zhing rgya che ba bshams la rjes chog gi mchod bstod rnams rgyas par byas pa'i rjes su yi ge brgya pa ci mang bzlas/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor gyi mchod gtor mda' drwa sogs bsdus/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad du langs te thal mo sbyar la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /sogs dang / bdag las dang po pa sogs kyis bzod gsol bya/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa dang bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams la dmigs te/ gdangs dang bcas pas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag la thim/ zhes brjod cing / chos nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag nas/ chos thams cad ni skye ba med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni gnas pa med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni 'gag pa med pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing rdo rje'i rtses sngar thog mar bris pa'i dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa nas bzung ste/ rtsig pa rnams 'khor mor bshig de nas shar gyi tshangs thig nas gtso bo'i mtshan ma'i bar thal byung du ri mo bya/ de bzhin du lho dang nub dang byang rnams kyi sgo'i thad nas ri mo byas/ gtso bo sogs lha bcu gsum gyi mtshan ma'i rdul tshon blangs nas rang ngam/ slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes ku sha la sogs pas rdul tshon rnams rim bzhin bsdus/ thig gi shul chang ngam/ las bum gyi chus byug ras gtsang ma sogs kyis phyis la rjes mi mngon par bya/ de'i shul du me tog gi char phab/

shis pa brjod cing rol chen bya'o/ /de dag gi skabs su/ las bsags pa 'bras bu dang ldan pa'i phyir bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs pa'i tshul ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar ram spros pa la dga' na tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i lam rim dang bkra shis rgyas pa 'di dag kyang bya ste/ sid+dhiṃ ku ru/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi/ /thugs rje 'phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i dngos/ /smin grol mchog gi lam ston drin chen rje/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso/ /rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' yab yum dang / /khro bo khro mo gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad la/ /brtse chen thugs rje'i dbyings nas dgongs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi zab gsal ting 'dzin gyis/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun dngos gshin rje gshed/ /ma he'i zhal can dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /snang stong dbyer med bde chen ngang du bsgrubs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod bstod gtor ma yis/ /dges pa skyed cig gang de'i dkyil 'khor du/ /zhugs nas dbang bzhis bdag rgyud sbyangs pa sogs/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gdul dka' 'dul mdzad khro rgyal gshin rje gshed/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog dpal chen bhai ra wa/ /ma rnams don du tshe 'dir 'grub par shog /de ma thob kyi tshe rabs kun tu yang / /mi khom gnas su nam yang mi skye zhing / /khams drug ldan pa'i skyon med rdo rje'i lus/ /dal 'byor bco brgyad tshang ba thob par shog /thun mong lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs te/ /rgyud sde'i rtser son dpal ldan dus dgra yi/ /dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhis smin byas te/ /dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung bar shog /tha mal skye shi bar do'i snang zhen kun/

/rang sems spros bral dbyings su thag chod nas/ /de nyid rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /'char byed zab mo'i rnal 'byor rnam bzhi la/ /sgro 'dogs chod nas thun bzhir bsgom pa'i mthus/ /gzugs sku sgrub byed bsam don tshogs rdzogs shing / /gang snang lha yi 'khor lo shar gyur nas/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i nyams len mthar phyin shog /dag pa'i zhing mchog bla ma lhar bcas la/ /phyag mchod yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsags shing / /'gro la tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms pa yis/ /sbyor ba sngon 'gros bdag rgyud sbyong bar shog /zab mo'i sngags kyis spros kun 'od gsal du/ /mkha' la na bun dengs pa ltar thim nas/ /de nyid ngang du mnyam par gzhag pa yis/ /'chi ba chos sku'i lam du khyer bar shog /dus me 'khrugs pa'i rdo rje'i gur khang du/ /'khor los sgyur ba khro bcu'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /phyogs bcur rgyu ba'i gdug can 'byung po'i tshogs/ /bsrung dang bzlog pa'i 'phrin las kun 'grub shog /e dbyings dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ /byang phyogs yongs su dag pa'i gzhal med khang / /sgom pas snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong ba dang / /gang du 'tshang rgya'i zhing khams dag byed shog /mngon byang lnga las rgyu ba'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi skur langs te/ /rnal 'byor dang pos bar do'i snang ba kun/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i lam du khyer bar shog /'jam pa'i dbyangs las rigs gsum spro bsdu yis/ /nyi ma sa bon phyag mtshan rnam rol gyis/ /dga' ba gsum las brtan g.yo 'khor 'das kyi/ /khyab bdag dpal ldan 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa ma he'i zhal/ /yab yum zhal bzang sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /skye ba sprul sku'i lam khyer zab mo yi/ /rjes su rnal 'byor nyams su len par shog /yab yum mngon dga'i 'khyud dang tsum+bha nas/ /chu skyes rdo rje rol ba'i tsaṇ+ḍa lis/

/bzhu ba'i bde gshegs byang chub sems kyi dngos/ /dhū ti'i lam nas zhugs pa'i sprin gyi bcud/ /shes rab pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur babs pa las/ /'ongs pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha'i khyon gang bas/ /phung khams skye mched ma dag snang ba kun/ /sbyong byed shin tu rnal 'byor 'grub par shog /de dag dam tshig dkyil 'khor chen po la/ /ye shes 'khor lo dbyer med rgyas btab ste/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myong la sogs pa yi/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i lam mchog mthar phyin shog /de ltar rgya chen bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / /zab gsal zung du 'jug pa'i ting 'dzin la/ /ring du sbyongs shing brtan pa thob byas nas/ /sngags kyi 'khor lo'i bzlas brjod mthar phyin shog /bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin de yi bsam gtan dang / /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg 'khrul 'khor sbyor ba yis/ /grub pa chen po brgyad dang lam chen bzhi/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan bde sgrub par shog /'bum phrag gshin rje gshed rgyud snying po'i don/ /o ḍi ya nar ye shes mkha' 'gro mas/ /grub pa mchog brnyes rol pa'i rdo rje la/ /legs par gdams pa'i snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig /rwa chen brgyud par bcas pa'i gsang ba'i gtam/ /zab pa las kyang ches zab zhal gyi bcud/ /rdzogs rim zab mo'i nyams len mthar phyin nas/ /'jam dpal rdo rje tshe 'dir 'grub par shog /'khor lo rnam lnga'i 'byung ba'i rlung rnams ni/ /nyi zla'i lam nas dhū ti'i las sna ru/ /chos 'byung chu skyes kha sbyar dbus zhugs pas/ /las su rung zhing dbu mar 'jug par shog /a thung phyag mtshan sa bon ti la ka /rwa rtse'i rnal 'byor mchog gi tsaṇ+ḍa lis/ /haṃ yig bzhu bas rtsa mdud kun grol nas/ /dwangs ma mchog gi bde chen skyed par shog /dngos dang ye shes phyag rgya'i chu skyes kyi/ /ge sar las 'ongs bde chen sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /yas babs mas brtan bdud rtsi'i dga' ston gyis/

/lhan skyes ye shes nyams su myong bar shog /chos rnams kun gyi gnas lugs gdod ma'i gshis/ /blo 'das brjod bral phyag rgya chen po'i ngang / /mtha' dbus mnyam rjes med pa'i rnal 'byor las/ /nam yang mi g.yo rtogs pa mthar phyin shog /rnam kun mchog ldan 'od gsal 'gyur med dbyings/ /mkha' dbyings shar ba'i dbang po'i gzhu ris bzhin/ /cir yang 'char ba'i ngo mtshar rol rtsed la/ /rnam shes sems ni lhug par skyong bar shog /de ltar ting 'dzin brtan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /shun chen gos gyon rus rgyan drug gis spras/ /bdud rtsi bza' zhing cang te'u mi rkang 'bud/ /stag smyon zhon nas dug sbrul thod du bcings/ /hūm̐ phaṭa sgra sgrog mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ /kun 'dar kun bzang spyod pas yul kun tu/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang lhan cig par/ /myul bas nang gi sa lam bsgrod par shog /de nas bla ma lha yis lung bstan pa'i/ /pad+ma can sogs nye rgyu'i mtshams sbyar nas/ /tshe gcig lus la gegs med bde blag tu/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par shog /go 'phang mchog 'di dus 'dir ma thob na/ /rang sems skye med rdo rje 'jigs byed do/ /tshangs bug nas thon dag pa'i mkha' spyod du/ /bsgrod nas lam mchog mtha' ru phyin par shog /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du/ /bla ma rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dkyil 'khor pas/ /byin gyis brlabs pa cir snang dge sbyor gyi/ /bskul mar shes pas dga' bdes 'tsho bar shog /rgya bod mkhas grub bye bas bsgrod pa'i lam/ /gshin rje gshed dpal lam mchog zab mo 'di/ ches cher rgyas shing ring du mi nyams par/ /skal bzang skye bo'i nyer 'tshor gnas gyur cig /de nyid skyong bar zhal bzhes srung ma'i gtso/ /las kyi gshin rje dam can rgya mtshor bcas/ /mthu stobs drag shul ldan pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs byed shog

/ces dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs lha bcu gsum gyi bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim rwa khrid mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi lam gyi rim pa dang / sbyar ba'i smon lam gyi rab tu byed pa lam bzang grub pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di ni dpal gshin rje gshed ma he'i zhal gyi rnal 'byor pa blo gsal rgya mtshos dge 'phel ri bo'i spo la gnas pa'i tshe sbyar ba grub par gyur cig shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza gā taṃ// ༈ /swa sti pra dza bh+yaḥ rab 'byams zhing nas thugs rje'i dri bzhon gyis/ /legs par bskyod pa'i char sprin 'dus pa ltar/ /nam mkha'i khyon yangs gang ba'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rab khros dpal ldan dus dgra'i lha tshogs ni/ /gur gum chu 'bebs lha rdzas me tog 'thor/ /rdza rnga'i sgra sgrogs shis brjod glu dbyangs len/ /hūm̐ phaṭa pheṃ sgras bdud kyi klad pa 'gems/ /e ma de ring snying dbus bdud rtsi sbyor/ /khyab bdag sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang / /mgon des 'khyud pa'i bde ster bai ta li/ /lam 'di'i shing rta'i srol byed la li ta/ /don yod rdo rje ye 'byung sbas pa'i zhabs/ /pad+ma badz+ra bal po bha ro dang / /'jam dbyangs rnam sprul rje btsun rdo rje grags/ /rwa chen brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma yi/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas deng 'dir bdag cag skyongs/ /thun mtshams sprin gyi 'od chags li khri'i spor/ /bai ḍūr sprin sngon gsar pas gtibs pa lta'i/ /dang po'i mgon po dpal ldan 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gang de'i rdo rje gsum gyi zlos gar las/ /bskrun pa'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo gshin rje gshed/ /rab 'jigs ma he'i zhal can bcom ldan 'das/ /yum mchog ro langs dga' mar rtag rol ba'i/ /khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po'i bkra shis shog /rje btsun yab yum sbyor ba'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /thon pa'i rigs bzhi'i khro rgyal yum chen bzhi/ /sgo bzhi skyong ba'i gtum chen gshed po bzhi/

/bcu gsum lha yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ni/ /mthong thos dran pas bdud dgra'i snying 'gems shing / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub chu rgyun gyi/ /skal bzang snying la bdud rtsi'i dpal ster ba/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog /stong nyid rdo rje'i rwa bas yongs bskor ba'i/ /'jigs rung dur khrod brgyad kyis gang ba'i dbus/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer gzhal med khang / /khrag zhag rba klongs 'khrug pa'i klongs dkyil du/ /thod rus zlum por brtsigs pa'i pho brang mchog /phyag mtshan me stag tshwa tshwa 'phro ba yis/ /lha rnams phyogs mtshams kun tu gtams pa'i grong / /byang phyogs rnam par dag pa'i bkra shis shog /dus dgra'i rgyud rgyal 'bum phrag bsdus pa'i bcud/ /rtsa bshad man ngag rgyud kyi nying khu'i mchog /rgya bal gangs can mkhas grub brgyud pa yi/ /zhal gyi pad+mo las 'ongs dbang bzhi dang / /dam tshig sdom pa rim gnyis zab mo'i lam/ /mtshan mo rgyu sogs spyod pa rnam gsum las/ /phun tshogs dge legs ji snyed mchis pa des/ /bdag cag byang chub bar du shis pas skyongs/ /gshin rje gshed dpal rgyud don zab mo'i bcud/ /bla ma'i drin las legs par rtogs gyur nas/ /thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor mchog la gzhol ba sogs/ /lam bzang gang 'di'i lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /'chad dang nyan dang sgom zhing rtogs pa dang / /mthong thos dran reg dad gus bskyed pa la/ /dge mtshan ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ /bdag cag tshe rabs kun tu skyong gyur cig /rab 'byams rgyud sder 'phrul 'khor mthar thug ni/ /gshin rje gshed rgyud gtso bor bsngags pa yi/ /rab tu khros pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi/ /sgrub thabs lnga dang rig sngags rnam pa gsum/ /rtsa ba'i 'phrul 'khor bdun dang yan lag gi /'phrul 'khor bcu phrag brgyad dang zung gnyis kyis/ /las chen bcu gnyis thogs med sgrub nus pas/

/rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /lho phyogs lcags mkhar 'bar ba'i grong khyer du/ /'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i bka' yis nyer bsgos pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po las kyi gshin rje'i gtso/ /gtum drag mthar byed ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /phyogs bcu skyong ba'i srung ma mthu rtsal can/ /srid gsum spyod pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la/ /mthu stobs ji snyed mchis pa'i dge mtshan des/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bsrung ba'i bkra shis shog /ces dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi 'khor lo'i shis brjod 'chi med sprin gyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni ma he'i zhal gyi rnal 'byor pa blo gsal rgya mtshos dge 'phel ri bo'i spo la gnas tshe sbyar ba// //maṅga laṃ// //gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs ci rigs pa brjod cing me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya/ dga' ston bzang pos thams cad tshim par bya'o/ /de ltar byas pa'i 'bras bu ni/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rgyal zhing gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur ro// ༈ /dpal chen dpal gyur 'jam dpal khros pa'i sku/ /thugs rjes 'dul mdzad rdo rje grags pa yi/ /dbang gi chu bo chos kyi rab mchog don/ /bsdebs pas 'khrul pa gang mchis bzod par gsol/ /ma 'khrul dge ba gnam lcags rdo rje'i rwas/ /dmus long dbang med lam 'jug mig phug nas/ /thar pa chen po'i khang bzang nyams dga' bar/ /sems can thams cad rol pas 'jug par shog /rab dkar kha bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /rab 'jigs dus dgra'i chos skor mang byon yang / /rab mchog phul byung rwa chen lo tsā'i lugs/ /rab 'byams phrin las grub pa'i rgyun 'di byung / /skabs der rkang 'thung ngos kyi srin bu ltar/ /rwa pa'i brgyud pa dag la bsten bzhin du/ /rwa chen gsung rab ring du 'dor byed pa/ /de yi byin rlabs brgyud pa mkha' dbyings deng /

/'ga' dag rwa lo chen po'i yi ge la/ /brtan par rlom yang dus 'khor kyai rdor sogs/ /rang rang mos pa'i rgyud sde gzhan bsres nas/ /'chad pa'ang dbang dug bsdus pas gos min nam/ /'dir ni rwa lo rdo rje grags pa yi/ /sgrub dkyil gzhung gi tshul du tshad mar bzung / /cung zad mi gsal ba dang ngag 'don sogs/ /de gsung gzhan dang lugs 'di'i brgyud pa yi/ /bla ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun ji bzhin du/ /gsal byed lhan thabs tshul du bris pa la/ /bsre bslad rang bzo'i skyon gyis dben pa'i phyir/ /dpyod ldan skal bzang rnams kyis nyams len mdzod/ /de ltar gsal byed zab don rab gsal 'dis/ /mi gsal the tshom mun nag kun sel zhing / /skal bzang snying gi ut+pal bzhad pa dang / /gsang chen pad mtsho'i 'dzum dkar cis mi g.yo/ /legs byas lho yi dri bzhon phreng ba 'dis/ /rdor 'dzin dang po'i las can snying dbus kyi/ /tsha gdung bsal nas gsang chen bsil g.yab kyis/ /'jam dbyangs bdud rtsi'i dga' ston thob gyur cig /ces dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs bcu gsum ma'i mngon dkyil rwa chen gyis mdzad pa dang / de'i lhan thabs tshar chen gyis mdzad pa gnyis lhan cig tu bkod/ brgyud 'debs lam rim bkra shis rgyas pa rnams kyang de'i khongs nas thon par bya/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed chos skor la dri ba'i rang lan dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i dga' ston las dka' gnad mtha' gcod rnams mchan bur btab nas nag 'gros su bklag chog mar bkod pa 'di ni sa skya pa kun blos 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i sgrub mchod brgya tshar grangs bsogs bgyis skabs gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang chen po la gang ci'i dka' gnas rnams dogs gcod zhus par dka' gnas 'ga' zhig la zhib bsher dang bcas gsung shog tu khyon pa'i mthar/ nged rang nas thon pa'i 'jigs byed kyi dbang lung man ngag rnams yongs rdzogs khyed rang la 'phrod pa yin pas/

des na rwa pod sogs lugs 'di la mkho ba'i yig cha rnams la zhib 'jug bgyis ngos mngon dkyil nag 'gros ma khungs thub cig gyis zhes bka' yig gnang ba thob pa la brten nas/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rwa chen gyi bzhed pa bzhin bkod pa 'di la/ 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs med snyam yang / bdag blo skyes sbyangs yon tan gyis dben zhing / sdig sgrib nyes ltung spyi dang dkor sgrib kyis mog por byas stabs 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dgongs pa dang 'gal tshe/ des mtshon dus gsum du bsags pa'i nyes pa rnams mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i sdig pa dang lhan cig bshags shing / 'di'i mchod brjod nas bzung sgrub dkyil yongs rdzogs rwa chen dang tshar chen gyi gsung la ngag 'don dmigs bsal bzo dgos rnams ma gtogs gzhan de dag sor bzhag pa ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos/ des na sangs rgyas gsung rab dang / /mkhas pa rnams kyi bstan bcos kyi/ /tshig don la ni byin rlabs yod/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin yin no/ /'di'i dge bas sems can thams cad bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 112 kun dga' blo gros/ rwa tshar gnyis thun min gyi bzhed pa 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i mngon dkyil lhan thabs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 111
